unilateral aplasia of pectoralis major muscle

name: abnormal facility in opposing the shoulders
abnormal facility in oppose the shoulder
HP:0005259.def: Increased range of shoulder movement related to aplasia or hypoplasia of the clavicles that results in the ability to approximate the shoulders in front of the chest.

name: abnormal synovial membrane morphology
abnormal synovial membrane morphology
HP:0005262.def: Any structural anomaly of the synovium, which is a membrane that lines the cavity of synovial joints and consists of a lining layer of macrophage-like synoviocytes and fibroblast-like synoviocytes, as well as a sublining of connective tissue. Synovial cells are thought to contribute to joint homeostasis by secreting various factors such as hyaluronic acid and lubricin important for joint lubrication and function, as well as disposing of the waste products.

name: gastritis
gastritis
HP:0005263.def: The presence of inflammation of the gastric mucous membrane.

name: abnormal jejunum morphology
abnormal jejunum morphology
HP:0005265.def: An abnormality of the jejunum, i.e., of the middle section of the small intestine.

name: intestinal polyp
intestinal polyp
HP:0005266.def: A discrete abnormal tissue mass that protrudes into the lumen of the intestine and is attached to the intestinal wall either by a stalk, pedunculus, or a broad base.

name: premature delivery because of cervical insufficiency or membrane fragility
premature delivery because of cervical insufficiency or membrane fragility
miscarriage
miscarriage
HP:0005268.def: A pregnancy that ends at a stage in which the fetus is incapable of surviving on its own, defined as the spontaneous loss of a fetus before the 22th week of pregnancy.

name: prominent nasolabial fold
prominent nasolabial fold
HP:0005272.def: Exaggerated bulkiness of the crease or fold of skin running from the lateral margin of the nose, where nasal base meets the skin of the face, to a point just lateral to the corner of the mouth (cheilion, or commissure).

name: absent nasal septal cartilage
absent nasal septal cartilage
HP:0005273.def: Lack of the cartilage of the nasal septum.
synonym: failure of development of nasal septal cartilage
failure of development of nasal septal cartilage

name: hypoplastic nasal tip
hypoplastic nasal tip
synonym: decreased size of tip of nose
decreased size of tip of nose

name: depressed nasal bridge
depress nasal bridge
HP:0005280.def: Posterior positioning of the nasal root in relation to the overall facial profile for age.

name: hypoplastic nasal bridge
hypoplastic nasal bridge
synonym: decreased size of bridge of nose
decreased size of bridge of nose

name: internal carotid artery hypoplasia
internal carotid artery hypoplasia
synonym: decreased size of internal carotid artery
decreased size of internal carotid artery

name: intimal thickening in the coronary arteries
intimal thickening in the coronary artery
arterial dissection
arterial dissection
HP:0005294.def: A separation (dissection) of the layers of an artery.

name: pseudocoarctation of the aorta
pseudocoarctation of the aorta
HP:0005295.def: Pseudocoarctation is a congenital anomaly of kinking, or buckling, of the aorta without a pressure gradient across the lesion. It is characterized by elongation and kinking of the aorta at the level of the ligamentum arteriosum.

name: premature occlusive vascular stenosis
premature occlusive vascular stenosis
HP:0005297.def: Peripheral arterial stenosis with onset before the age of 50 years.

name: obsolete atrioventricular canal defect with right ventricle aorta and pulmonary atresia
obsolete atrioventricular canal defect with right ventricle aorta and pulmonary atresia
persistent left superior vena cava
persistent leave superior vena cava
HP:0005301.def: A rare congenital vascular anomaly that results when the left superior cardinal vein caudal to the innominate vein fails to regress.

name: carotid artery tortuosity
carotid artery tortuosity
HP:0005302.def: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of the carotid arteries.

name: aortic arch calcification
aortic arch calcification
HP:0005303.def: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the arch of aorta.

name: cerebral venous thrombosis
cerebral venous thrombosis
HP:0005305.def: Formation of a blood clot (thrombus) inside a cerebral vein, causing the obstruction of blood flow.

name: capillary hemangioma
capillary hemangioma
HP:0005306.def: The presence of a capillary hemangioma, which are hemangiomas with small endothelial spaces.

name: large vessel vasculitis
large vessel vasculitis
HP:0005310.def: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) affecting large arteries such as the aorta and branches of the aorta.

name: agenesis of pulmonary vessels
agenesis of pulmonary vessel
HP:0005311.def: A developmental defect characterized by the lack of formation of the pulmonary blood vessels.

name: pulmonary aterial intimal fibrosis
pulmonary aterial intimal fibrosis
HP:0005312.def: Formation of excess fibrous connective tissue in the tunica intima (innermost layer) of arteries in the pulmonary circulation.

name: arterial fibromuscular dysplasia
arterial fibromuscular dysplasia
HP:0005313.def: An arterial lesion that is characterized by either intimal fibroplasia, with neointimal lesions of cells and matrix deposition, or medial fibroplasia, in which there is loss of smooth muscle cells and increased deposition of collagen and proteoglycans in the medial layer.

name: anomalous branches of internal carotid artery
anomalous branch of internal carotid artery
increased pulmonary vascular resistance
increase pulmonary vascular resistance
HP:0005317.def: Pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) more than 3 wood units, as defined by the current definition of pulmonary hypertension. 95% of individuals have a PVR of less than 2.4 wood units.

name: cerebral vasculitis
cerebral vasculitis
HP:0005318.def: Inflammation of the blood vessels within the brain.

name: lack of facial subcutaneous fat
lack of facial subcutaneous fat
synonym: lack of facial fat below the skin
lack of facial fat below the skin

name: mandibulofacial dysostosis
mandibulofacial dysostosis
HP:0005321.def: A type of craniofacial dysostosis associated with abnormalities of the external ears, mirognathia, macrostomia, coloboma of the lower eyelid, and cleft palate. This is a bundled term that is left in the HPO now for convenience with legacy annotations but should not be used for new annotations.

name: hemifacial hypertrophy
hemifacial hypertrophy
HP:0005323.def: Unilateral overgrowth of facial tissues, including muscles, bones and skin.
synonym: increase in size of half of face
increase in size of half of face

name: disturbance of facial expression
disturbance of facial expression
HP:0005324.def: An abnormality of the gestures or movements executed with the facial muscles with which emotions such as fear, joy, sadness, surprise, and disgust can be expressed.

name: extension of hair growth on temples to lateral eyebrow
extension of hair growth on temple to lateral eyebrow
HP:0005325.def: A pattern of hair growth in which there is hair extending from the temples to the lateral eyebrows.
synonym: unusual hairline with hair growth on temples extending to lateral eyebrow
unusual hairline with hair growth on temple extend to lateral eyebrow

name: progeroid facial appearance
progeroid facial appearance
HP:0005328.def: A degree of wrinkling of the facial skin that is more than expected for the age of the individual, leading to a prematurely aged appearance.

name: recurrent mandibular subluxations
recurrent mandibular subluxation
HP:0005332.def: Recurrent partial dislocations of the mandible.

name: sparse lateral eyebrow
sparse lateral eyebrow
HP:0005338.def: Decreased density/number and/or decreased diameter of lateral eyebrow hairs.
synonym: limited hair on end of eyebrow
limited hair on end of eyebrow

name: abnormality of complement system
abnormality of complement system
HP:0005339.def: An abnormality of the complement system.

name: autonomic bladder dysfunction
autonomic bladder dysfunction
HP:0005341.def: Abnormal bladder function (increased urge or frequency of urination or urge incontinence) resulting from abnormal functioning of the autonomic nervous system.

name: abnormal carotid artery morphology
abnormal carotid artery morphology
HP:0005344.def: Any structural abnormality of the carotid arteries, including the common carotid artery and its' arterial branches.

name: abnormal vena cava morphology
abnormal vena cava morphology
HP:0005345.def: An abnormality of the structure of the veins that return deoxygenated blood from the body into the heart, i.e., the superior vena cava and the inferior vena cava.

name: tracheal cartilaginous sleeve
tracheal cartilaginous sleeve
HP:0005347.def: Tracheal cartilaginous sleeve (TCS) is a rare congenital airway malformation in which distinct tracheal rings are replaced by a continuous cartilaginous segment. Vertically fused C- or O-shaped cartilaginous rings can extend from the subglottis to the carina or bronchus with little to no pars membranacea posteriorly. Comment:Tracheal cartilaginous sleeve has been associated with various craniosynostosis syndromes.

name: inspiratory stridor
inspiratory stridor
HP:0005348.def: Inspiratory stridor is a high pitched sound upon inspiration that is generally related to laryngeal abnormalities.

name: severe t - cell immunodeficiency
severe t - cell immunodeficiency
HP:0005352.def: A primary immune deficiency that is characterized by defects or deficiencies of T-lymphocytes that causes specific susceptibility to intracellular micro-organisms.

name: recurrent herpes
recurrent herpes
HP:0005353.def: Increased susceptibility to herpesvirus, as manifested by recurrent episodes of herpesvirus.

name: lack of t cell function
lack of t cell function
HP:0005354.def: Complete inability of T cells to perform their functions in cell-mediated immunity.

name: decreased circulating complement factor i concentration
decrease circulate complement factor i concentration
HP:0005356.def: Concentration of the complement component factor I in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: defective b cell differentiation
defective b cell differentiation
HP:0005357.def: Reduced functionality of the process in which a precursor cell type acquires the specialized features of a B cell. A B cell is a lymphocyte of B lineage with the phenotype CD19-positive and capable of B cell mediated immunity.

name: aplasia of the thymus
aplasia of the thymus
HP:0005359.def: Absence of the thymus. This feature may be appreciated by the lack of a thymic shadow upon radiographic examination.

name: susceptibility to chickenpox
susceptibility to chickenpox
HP:0005360.def: Increased susceptibility to chicken pox, as manifested by recurrent episodes of chicken pox.

name: humoral immunodeficiency
humoral immunodeficiency
HP:0005363.def: A general term referring to a defect in immunity resulting from impaired antibody production.

name: severe b lymphocytopenia
severe b lymphocytopenia
HP:0005365.def: A severe form of B lymphocytopenia in which the count of B cells is very low or absent.

name: recurrent streptococcus pneumoniae infections
recurrent streptococcus pneumoniae infection
HP:0005366.def: Increased susceptibility to streptococcus pneumoniae infections as manifested by a history of recurrent infections by streptococcus pneumoniae.

name: abnormality of humoral immunity
abnormality of humoral immunity
HP:0005368.def: An abnormality of the humoral immune system, which comprises antibodies produced by B cells as well as the complement system.

name: decreased circulating complement factor h concentration
decrease circulate complement factor h concentration
HP:0005369.def: Concentration of the complement component factor H in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: abnormality of b cell physiology
abnormality of b cell physiology
HP:0005372.def: An abnormality of the physiological functioning of B cells.

name: cellular immunodeficiency
cellular immunodeficiency
HP:0005374.def: An immunodeficiency characterized by defective cell-mediated immunity or humoral immunity.

name: recurrent haemophilus influenzae infections
recurrent haemophilus influenzae infection
HP:0005376.def: Increased susceptibility to Haemophilus influenzae infections as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection by Haemophilus influenzae.

name: recurrent meningococcal disease
recurrent meningococcal disease
HP:0005381.def: Recurrent infections by Neisseria meningitidis (one of the most common causes of bacterial meningitis), which is also known as meningococcus.
synonym: increased susceptibility to neisseria meningitidis infections
increase susceptibility to neisseria meningitidis infection

name: defective b cell activation
defective b cell activation
HP:0005384.def: A reduced ability of a B cell to become activated, i.e., the change in morphology and behavior of

name: recurrent protozoan infections
recurrent protozoan infection
HP:0005386.def: Increased susceptibility to protozoan infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of protozoan infection.

name: combined immunodeficiency
combine immunodeficiency
HP:0005387.def: A group of phenotypically heterogeneous genetic disorders characterized by profound deficiencies of T- and B-cell function, which predispose the patients to both infectious and noninfectious complications.

name: depletion of components of the alternative complement pathway
depletion of component of the alternative complement pathway
HP:0005389.def: An abnormal reduction in the components of the alternative complement pathway, such as the C3 protein or its cleavage products.

name: recurrent opportunistic infections
recurrent opportunistic infection
HP:0005390.def: Increased susceptibility to opportunistic infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of infection by opportunistic agents, i.e., by microorganisms that do not usually cause disease in a healthy host, but are able to infect a host with a compromised immune system.

name: susceptibility to coronavirus 229e
susceptibility to coronavirus 229e
HP:0005396.def: Increased susceptibility to coronavirus 229e, as manifested by recurrent episodes of coronavirus 229e.

name: reduction of neutrophil motility
reduction of neutrophil motility
HP:0005400.def: An abnormal reduction of the cell motility of neutrophils.

name: recurrent candida infections
recurrent candida infection
HP:0005401.def: An increased susceptibility to candida infections, as manifested by a history of recurrent episodes of candida infections.

name: obsolete primary t - lymphocyte immune abnormalities
obsolete primary t - lymphocyte immune abnormality
t lymphocytopenia
t lymphocytopenia
HP:0005403.def: An abnormally low count of T cells.
synonym: decreased numbers of circulating t cells
decreased number of circulate t cell

name: increased b cell count
increase b cell count
HP:0005404.def: An abnormal increase from the normal count of B cells.

name: recurrent bacterial skin infections
recurrent bacterial skin infection
HP:0005406.def: Increased susceptibility to bacterial infections of the skin, as manifested by recurrent episodes of infectious dermatitis.

name: decreased proportion of cd4 - positive helper t cells
decreased proportion of cd4 - positive helper t cell
HP:0005407.def: A decreased proportion of circulating CD4-positive helper T cells relative to total T cell count.

name: obsolete markedly reduced t cell function
obsolete markedly reduce t cell function
chronic intestinal candidiasis
chronic intestinal candidiasis
HP:0005411.def: Persistent overgrowth of Candida albicans in the gastrointestinal tract.

name: increased alpha - globulin
increase alpha - globulin
HP:0005413.def: An abnormally increased level of circulating alpha-globulin. Alpha globulins are a group of serum proteins defined by their mobility on serum electrophoresis. The alpha1-protein fraction is comprised of alpha1-antitrypsin, thyroid-binding globulin, and transcortin. Ceruloplasmin, alpha2-macroglobulin, and haptoglobin contribute to the alpha2-protein band. The alpha2 component is increased as an acute-phase reactant.

name: decreased proportion of cd8 - positive t cells
decreased proportion of cd8 - positive t cell
HP:0005415.def: A decreased proportion of circulating CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cells relative to total number of T cells.
synonym: decreased proportion of cd8+ t cells
decreased proportion of cd8+ t cell
decreased proportion of cd8 - positive , alpha - beta t cells
decreased proportion of cd8 - positive , alpha - beta t cell

name: decreased circulating complement factor b concentration
decrease circulate complement factor b concentration
HP:0005416.def: Concentration of the complement component factor B in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased t cell activation
decrease t cell activation
HP:0005419.def: Decreased or impaired activation of T cells in response to a mitogen, cytokine, chemokine, cellular ligand, or an antigen for which it is specific.

name: recurrent gram - negative bacterial infections
recurrent gram - negative bacterial infection
HP:0005420.def: Increased susceptibility to infection by gram-negative bacteria, as manifested by a medical history of repeated or frequent infections by these agents.

name: decreased circulating complement c3 concentration
decrease circulate complement c3 concentration
HP:0005421.def: Concentration of the complement component C3 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: absence of cd8 - positive t cells
absence of cd8 - positive t cell
HP:0005422.def: Lack of detectible CD8-positive T cells

name: dysfunctional alternative complement pathway
dysfunctional alternative complement pathway
HP:0005423.def: An abnormality of the functioning of any aspect of the alternative complement pathway.

name: absent specific antibody response
absent specific antibody response
HP:0005424.def: Absence of specific immunoglobulins directed against a specific antigen or microorganism.

name: recurrent sinopulmonary infections
recurrent sinopulmonary infection
HP:0005425.def: An increased susceptibility to infections involving both the paranasal sinuses and the lungs, as manifested by a history of recurrent sinopulmonary infections.

name: recurrent systemic pyogenic infections
recurrent systemic pyogenic infection
HP:0005429.def: Increased susceptibility to systemic pyogenic infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of systemic pyogenic infections.

name: recurrent neisserial infections
recurrent neisserial infection
HP:0005430.def: Recurrent infections by bacteria of the genus Neisseria, including N. meningitidis (one of the most common causes of bacterial meningitis).

name: transient hypogammaglobulinemia of infancy
transient hypogammaglobulinemia of infancy
HP:0005432.def: At birth, newborns are endowed with maternal antibodies. IgG production normally begins at the age of two months. A delay in recovery from this physiological hypogammaglobulinemia between the 3rd and the 6th month of life, and of recovery period between 18 and 36 months defines transient newborn hypogammaglobulinemia.

name: impaired t cell function
impaired t cell function
HP:0005435.def: Abnormally reduced ability of T cells to perform their functions in cell-mediated immunity.

name: recurrent infections in infancy and early childhood
recurrent infection in infancy and early childhood
HP:0005437.def: Recurrent infections at an early age with improvement in later childhood.

name: maxillozygomatic hypoplasia
maxillozygomatic hypoplasia
synonym: decreased projection of zygomaticomaxillary bone complex
decreased projection of zygomaticomaxillary bone complex
decreased size of zygomaticomaxillary bone complex
decreased size of zygomaticomaxillary bone complex

name: sclerotic cranial sutures
sclerotic cranial suture
HP:0005441.def: An increased density in the cranial sutures following obliteration.

name: widely patent coronal suture
widely patent coronal suture
HP:0005442.def: The presence of a coronal suture (the cranial suture that separates the frontal and parietal bones) that is not ossified but rather wide open at an age when it is normally closed.

name: enlarged posterior fossa
enlarge posterior fossa
HP:0005445.def: Abnormal increased size of the posterior cranial fossa.

name: obtuse angle of mandible
obtuse angle of mandible
HP:0005446.def: Abnormally flat (obtuse) angle of the mandible. The angle of the mandibular, located at the junction between the body and the ramus of the mandible, is normally close to being a right angle. This terms describes an abnormal increase of this angle such that the mandible appears flatter than normal.

name: calvarial osteosclerosis
calvarial osteosclerosis
HP:0005450.def: An increase in bone density affecting the calvaria (roof of the skull).

name: absent / hypoplastic paranasal sinuses
absent / hypoplastic paranasal sinus
HP:0005453.def: Aplasia or hypoplasia of the paranasal sinuses.

name: absent ethmoidal sinuses
absent ethmoidal sinus
synonym: failure of development of ethmoid sinuses
failure of development of ethmoid sinus

name: premature closure of fontanelles
premature closure of fontanelle
HP:0005458.def: Normally, the posterior and lateral fontanelles are obliterated by about six months after birth, the anterior fontanelle closes by about the middle of the second year. This term refers to the situation in which the fontanelles close at an inappropriately early time point.
synonym: early closure of the bregma sutures
early closure of the bregma suture
early closure of the cranial sutures
early closure of the cranial suture
premature closure of the bregma sutures
premature closure of the bregma suture
premature closure of the cranial sutures
premature closure of the cranial suture

name: calcification of falx cerebri
calcification of falx cerebri
HP:0005462.def: The presence of calcium deposition in the falx cerebri.

name: craniofacial osteosclerosis
craniofacial osteosclerosis
HP:0005464.def: Abnormally increased density of craniofacial bone tissue.

name: facial hyperostosis
facial hyperostosis
HP:0005465.def: Excessive growth (overgrowth) of the facial bones, that is of the facial skeleton.
synonym: increase in size of the facial bones
increase in size of the facial bone

name: hypoplasia of the frontal bone
hypoplasia of the frontal bone
synonym: decreased size of bone of forehead
decreased size of bone of forehead

name: flat occiput
flat occiput
HP:0005469.def: Reduced convexity of the occiput (posterior part of skull).

name: fusion of middle ear ossicles
fusion of middle ear ossicle
HP:0005473.def: Bony fusion of malleus, incus, and stapes.

name: decreased calvarial ossification
decrease calvarial ossification
HP:0005474.def: Abnormal reduction in ossification of the calvaria (roof of the skull consisting of the frontal bone, parietal bones, temporal bones, and occipital bone).

name: widely patent sagittal suture
widely patent sagittal suture
HP:0005476.def: The presence of a sagittal suture (the cranial suture that separates the left and right parietal bones) that is not ossified but rather wide open at an age when it is normally closed.

name: progressive sclerosis of skull base
progressive sclerosis of skull base
HP:0005477.def: Progressively increasing bone density of the skull base without significant changes in bony contour.

name: decreased circulating ige
decrease circulating ige
HP:0005479.def: An abnormally decreased level of immunoglobulin E (IgE) in blood.

name: abnormality of the alternative complement pathway
abnormality of the alternative complement pathway
HP:0005482.def: A deviation in any aspect of the alternative complement pathway.

name: secondary microcephaly
secondary microcephaly
HP:0005484.def: Head circumference which falls below 2 standard deviations below the mean for age and gender because of insufficient head growth after birth.
synonym: development of small head that was not present at birth
development of small head that be not present at birth

name: small fontanelle
small fontanelle
HP:0005486.def: A fontanelle that is small for age.

name: prominent metopic ridge
prominent metopic ridge
HP:0005487.def: Vertical bony ridge positioned in the midline of the forehead.

name: postnatal macrocephaly
postnatal macrocephaly
HP:0005490.def: The postnatal development of an abnormally large skull (macrocephaly).

name: metopic suture patent to nasal root
metopic suture patent to nasal root
HP:0005495.def: The frontal suture divides the two halves of the frontal bone in infants and usually fuses by the age of six years. The suture runs from the bregma (the point on the skull at which the coronal suture is intersected perpendicularly by the sagittal suture) to the nasion or nasal root. This term applies if the suture is widely patent from bregma to nasal root.

name: midline skin dimples over anterior / posterior fontanelles
midline skin dimple over anterior / posterior fontanelle
chronic myelogenous leukemia
chronic myelogenous leukemia
HP:0005506.def: A myeloproliferative disorder characterized by increased proliferation of the granulocytic cell line without the loss of their capacity to differentiate.

name: hemoglobin barts
hemoglobin bart
HP:0005507.def: Normal adult hemoglobin is composed of two chains each of alpha and beta globin. Hb Barts (Hemoglobin Barts) is a tetramer with four gamma globin chains, and is essentially pathognomonic for one or another form of alpha thalassemia. Hb Barts has an extremely high affinity for oxygen, resulting in almost no oxygen delivery to the tissues.

name: monoclonal immunoglobulin m proteinemia
monoclonal immunoglobulin m proteinemia
HP:0005508.def: Presence of a monoclonal immunoglobulin M protein in the serum.

name: transient erythroblastopenia
transient erythroblastopenia
HP:0005510.def: A transient reduction in the number of erythroblasts in the circulation.
synonym: transient decrease in blood erythrocyte number
transient decrease in blood erythrocyte number

name: heinz body anemia
heinz body anemia
HP:0005511.def: Anemia characterized by abnormal intracellular inclusions, composed of denatured hemoglobin, found on the membrane of red blood cells.

name: impaired neutrophil killing of staphylococci
impaired neutrophil killing of staphylococci
HP:0005512.def: A reduction in the ability of neutrophils to kill the gram-positive bacteria, staphylococcus, which is commonly known as staph.

name: increased megakaryocyte count
increase megakaryocyte count
HP:0005513.def: Increased megakaryocyte number, i.e., of platelet precursor cells, present in the bone marrow.

name: t - cell lymphoma / leukemia
t - cell lymphoma / leukemia
HP:0005517.def: A type of T-cell lymphoma in which cancerous T-cells may present in the blood (leukemia), lymph nodes (lymphoma), skin or in multiple areas.

name: increased mean corpuscular volume
increase mean corpuscular volume
HP:0005518.def: Larger than normal size of erythrocytes.

name: chronic disseminated intravascular coagulation
chronic disseminate intravascular coagulation
HP:0005520.def: A chronic form of disseminated intravascular coagulation in which a persistent weak or intermittent activating stimulus is present and destruction and production of coagulation factors and platelets are balanced.

name: disseminated intravascular coagulation
disseminate intravascular coagulation
HP:0005521.def: Disseminated intravascular coagulation is characterized by the widespread activation of coagulation, which results in the intravascular formation of fibrin and ultimately thrombotic occlusion of small and midsize vessels.

name: pyridoxine - responsive sideroblastic anemia
pyridoxine - responsive sideroblastic anemia
HP:0005522.def: A type of sideroblastic anemia that is alleviated by pyridoxine (vitamin B-6) treatment.

name: lymphoid leukemia
lymphoid leukemia
HP:0005526.def: A malignant lymphocytic neoplasm of B-cell or T-cell lineage involving primarily the bone marrow and the peripheral blood. This category includes precursor or acute lymphoblastic leukemias and chronic leukemias.

name: reduced kininogen activity
reduce kininogen activity
HP:0005527.def: Reduction in the amount of kininogen, which functions as a cofactor in the contact phase of the intrinsic blood coagulation cascade.

name: bone marrow hypocellularity
bone marrow hypocellularity
HP:0005528.def: A reduced number of hematopoietic cells present in the bone marrow relative to marrow fat.

name: biphenotypic acute leukemia
biphenotypic acute leukemia
HP:0005531.def: A type of actue leukemia with features characteristic of both the myeloid and lymphoid lineages. These leukemias are for this reason are designated mixed-lineage, hybrid or biphenotypic acute leukemias.

name: transient myeloproliferative syndrome
transient myeloproliferative syndrome
HP:0005534.def: A unique clonal neoplastic disorder that is linked to trisomy 21, is restricted to neonatal period, and spontaneously regresses. It often has characteristics of megakaryocytic lineage and is associated with GATA1 mutations in myeloblasts.

name: exercise - induced hemolysis
exercise - induced hemolysis
HP:0005535.def: A form of hemolytic anemia that can be triggered by exertion.

name: decreased mean platelet volume
decrease mean platelet volume
HP:0005537.def: Average platelet volume below the lower limit of the normal reference interval.

name: t cell chronic lymphocytic lymphoma / leukemia
t cell chronic lymphocytic lymphoma / leukemia
HP:0005539.def: A form of lymphoid leukemia or lymphoma in which too many T-cell lymphoblasts are found in the blood, bone marrow, and tissues. Leukemia or lymphoma classification depends on which feature is more prominent.

name: red blood cell keratocytosis
red blood cell keratocytosis
HP:0005540.def: A form of poikilocytosis in which the abnormally shaped erythrocytes have notches that results in projections that look like horns.
synonym: distorted red blood cells resembling keratocytes
distort red blood cell resemble keratocytes

name: congenital agranulocytosis
congenital agranulocytosis
HP:0005541.def: Congenital onset of a marked decrease in the number of granulocytes.

name: prolonged whole - blood clotting time
prolonged whole - blood clotting time
HP:0005542.def: An abnormal prolongation (delay) in the time required by whole blood to produce a visible clot.

name: reduced protein c activity
reduce protein c activity
HP:0005543.def: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of vitamin K-dependent protein C. Protein C is activated to protein Ca by thrombin bound to thrombomodulin. Activated protein C degrades factors VIIIa and Va.

name: myeloproliferative disorder
myeloproliferative disorder
HP:0005547.def: Proliferation (excess production) of hemopoietically active tissue or of tissue which has embryonic hemopoietic potential.

name: chronic lymphatic leukemia
chronic lymphatic leukemia
HP:0005550.def: A chronic lymphocytic/lymphatic/lymphoblastic leukemia (CLL) is a neoplastic disease characterized by proliferation and accumulation (blood, marrow and lymphoid organs) of morphologically mature but immunologically dysfunctional lymphocytes. A CLL is always a B-cell lymphocytic leukemia as there are no reports of cases of T-cell lymphocytic leukemias.

name: abnormality of the metopic suture
abnormality of the metopic suture
HP:0005556.def: The frontal suture divides the two halves of the frontal bone of the skull in infants and children and generally undergoes fusion by the age of six. A persistent frontal suture is referred to as a \"metopic suture\".

name: abnormal zygomatic arch morphology
abnormal zygomatic arch morphology
HP:0005557.def: An abnormality of the zygomatic arch, also known as the cheek bone.

name: chronic leukemia
chronic leukemia
HP:0005558.def: A slowly progressing leukemia characterized by a clonal (malignant) proliferation of maturing and mature myeloid cells or mature lymphocytes. When the clonal cellular population is composed of myeloid cells, the process is called chronic myelogenous leukemia. When the clonal cellular population is composed of lymphocytes, it is classified as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, hairy cell leukemia, or T-cell large granular lymphocyte leukemia.

name: abnormality of the kinin - kallikrein system
abnormality of the kinin - kallikrein system
imbalanced hemoglobin synthesis
imbalanced hemoglobin synthesis
HP:0005560.def: Normal hemoglobin synthesis is characterized by production of equal amounts of alpha and beta globins. This term refers to a deviation from this pattern and is the main characteristic of the various forms of thalassemia.

name: abnormal bone marrow cell morphology
abnormal bone marrow cell morphology
HP:0005561.def: An anomaly of the form or number of cells in the bone marrow.
synonym: abnormality of bone marrow cell morphology
abnormality of bone marrow cell morphology
anomaly of the bone marrow cells
anomaly of the bone marrow cell

name: multiple renal cysts
multiple renal cyst
HP:0005562.def: The presence of many cysts in the kidney.

name: decreased numbers of nephrons
decreased number of nephron
HP:0005563.def: A reduction in the count of nephrons per kidney.

name: absence of renal corticomedullary differentiation
absence of renal corticomedullary differentiation
HP:0005564.def: A lack of differentiation between renal cortex and medulla on diagnostic imaging.

name: reduced renal corticomedullary differentiation
reduce renal corticomedullary differentiation
HP:0005565.def: Reduced differentiation between renal cortex and medulla on diagnostic imaging.
synonym: loss of definition of corticomedullary differentiation
loss of definition of corticomedullary differentiation

name: renal magnesium wasting
renal magnesium wasting
HP:0005567.def: High urine magnesium in the presence of hypomagnesemia.

name: increased renal tubular phosphate reabsorption
increase renal tubular phosphate reabsorption
synonym: increased percent tubular reabsorption of phosphorus
increase percent tubular reabsorption of phosphorus

name: non - acidotic proximal tubulopathy
non - acidotic proximal tubulopathy
HP:0005574.def: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption without bicarbonate loss.

name: hemolytic - uremic syndrome
hemolytic - uremic syndrome
HP:0005575.def: A thrombotic microangiopathy with presence of non-immune, intravascular hemolytic anemia, thrombocytopenia and acute kidney injury. A vicious cycle of complement activation, endothelial cell damage, platelet activation, and thrombosis is the hallmark of the disease.

name: tubulointerstitial fibrosis
tubulointerstitial fibrosis
HP:0005576.def: A progressive detrimental connective tissue deposition (fibrosis) on the kidney parenchyma involving the tubules and interstitial tissue of the kidney. Tubulointerstitial injury in the kidney is complex, involving a number of independent and overlapping cellular and molecular pathways, with renal interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy (IF/TA) as the final common pathway. However, IF and TA are separable, as shown by the profound TA in renal artery stenosis, which characteristically has little or no fibrosis (or inflammation). For new annotations it is preferable to annotate to the specific HPO terms for Renal interstitial lfibrosis and/or Renal tubular atrophy.

name: impaired renal ltubular reabsorption of chloride
impaired renal ltubular reabsorption of chloride
HP:0005579.def: Any impairment of reabsorption of chloride by the kidney in order to not lose too much chloride in the urine.

name: duplication of renal pelvis
duplication of renal pelvis
HP:0005580.def: A duplication of the renal pelvis.

name: tubular basement membrane disintegration
tubular basement membrane disintegration
HP:0005583.def: DIsruption and breaking up of the basement membrane of the tubules of the kidney.
synonym: disintegration of the tubular basement membrane
disintegration of the tubular basement membrane

name: renal cell carcinoma
renal cell carcinoma
HP:0005584.def: A type of carcinoma of the kidney with origin in the epithelium of the proximal convoluted renal tubule.
synonym: cancer starting in small tubes in kidneys
cancer start in small tube in kidney

name: hyperpigmentation in sun - exposed areas
hyperpigmentation in sun - expose area
synonym: increased pigmentation in sun - exposed areas
increase pigmentation in sun - expose area

name: patchy palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
patchy palmoplantar hyperkeratosis
HP:0005588.def: A focal type of palmoplantar keratoderma in which only certain areas of the palms and soles are affected.

name: giant melanosomes in melanocytes
giant melanosomes in melanocyte
HP:0005592.def: The presence of large spherical melanosomes (1 to 6 micrometer in diameter) in the cytoplasm of melanocytes.

name: macular hypopigmented whorls , streaks , and patches
macular hypopigmented whorl , streak , and patch
congenital alopecia totalis
congenital alopecia totalis
HP:0005597.def: Loss of all scalp hair with congenital onset.

name: facial telangiectasia in butterfly midface distribution
facial telangiectasia in butterfly midface distribution
HP:0005598.def: Telangiectases (small dilated blood vessels) located near the surface of the skin in a butterfly midface distribution.

name: congenital giant melanocytic nevus
congenital giant melanocytic nevus
HP:0005600.def: The giant congenital nevus is greater than 8 cm in size, pigmented and often hairy. A giant congenital nevus is smaller in infants and children, but it usually continues to grow with the child.

name: large cafe - au - lait macules with irregular margins
large cafe - au - lait macule with irregular margin
HP:0005605.def: Large hypermelanotic macules with jagged borders.

name: bilobate gallbladder
bilobate gallbladder
HP:0005608.def: The presence of a bilobed gallbladder, related to a duplication of the gallbladder primordium.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the femur
aplasia / hypoplasia of the femur
HP:0005613.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the femur.

name: accelerated skeletal maturation
accelerate skeletal maturation
HP:0005616.def: An abnormally increased rate of skeletal maturation. Accelerated skeletal maturation can be diagnosed on the basis of an estimation of the bone age from radiographs of specific bones in the human body.

name: thoracolumbar kyphosis
thoracolumbar kyphosis
HP:0005619.def: Hyperconvexity of the thoracolumbar spine producing a rounded or humped appearance.

name: hypermobility of interphalangeal joints
hypermobility of interphalangeal joint
HP:0005620.def: The ability of the interphalangeal joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

name: trapezoidal vertebral body
trapezoidal vertebral body
HP:0005621.def: An anomalous trapezoidal appearance of a vertebral body. A trapezoid is a four-sided shape that has two sides that are parallel and two sides that are not parallel. In this case, the two lateral sides of the vertebra are parallel, and the top and the bottom are slanted with respect to each other such that the vertebra is shorter in the fron or back than on the other side.

name: broad long bones
broad long bone
HP:0005622.def: Increased cross-section (diameter) of the long bones. Note that widening may primarily affect specific regions of long bones (e.g., diaphysis or metaphysis), but this should be coded separately.

name: absent ossification of calvaria
absent ossification of calvaria
HP:0005623.def: Absent ossification of the calvaria (vault of the skull).

name: posterior fusion of lumbosacral vertebrae
posterior fusion of lumbosacral vertebra
HP:0005626.def: Bony fusion of the posterior part of the L5 vertebral body with the sacrum.

name: type d brachydactyly
type d brachydactyly
HP:0005627.def: This type of brachydactyly is characterized by short and broad terminal phalanges of the thumbs and big toes.

name: decreased anterioposterior diameter of lumbar vertebral bodies
decrease anterioposterior diameter of lumbar vertebral body
hyperextensible hand joints
hyperextensible hand joint
HP:0005639.def: The ability of the joints of the hand to move beyond their normal range of motion.

name: intervertebral disk calcification
intervertebral disk calcification
HP:0005645.def: The presence of abnormal calcium deposition of the intervertebral disk.

name: bilateral ulnar hypoplasia
bilateral ulnar hypoplasia
HP:0005648.def: Underdevelopment of the ulna on both sides.

name: 2 - 5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
2 - 5 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0005650.def: A soft tissue continuity in the anteroposterior axis between the second to the fifth fingers that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints.

name: cortical sclerosis
cortical sclerosis
HP:0005652.def: Sclerosis (abnormal hardening) of cortical bone, characterized by increased radiodensity.

name: multiple digital exostoses
multiple digital exostosis
HP:0005655.def: Multiple exostoses originating in the fingers and toes.

name: positional foot deformity
positional foot deformity
HP:0005656.def: A foot deformity resulting due to an abnormality affecting the muscle and soft tissue. In contrast if the bones of the foot are affected the term structural foot deformity applies.

name: salmonella osteomyelitis
salmonella osteomyelitis
HP:0005661.def: Osteomyelitis caused by infection with the bacteria, salmonella.

name: massively thickened long bone cortices
massively thicken long bone cortex
HP:0005665.def: Extreme thickening of the cortex of long bones.

name: os odontoideum
o odontoideum
HP:0005667.def: Separation of the odontoid process from the body of the axis.

name: bilateral intracerebral calcifications
bilateral intracerebral calcification
HP:0005671.def: Deposition of calcium salts on both sides of the brain.

name: dupuytren contracture
dupuytren contracture
HP:0005679.def: An abnormality of the hand resulting from contracture of the palmar fascia with a fixed flexion deformity of the metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joints and the proximal interphalangeal (PIP) joints.

name: tongue - like lumbar vertebral deformities
tongue - like lumbar vertebral deformity
HP:0005680.def: A tongue-like protusion from the anterior aspect of lumbar vertebral bodies.

name: distal arthrogryposis
distal arthrogryposis
HP:0005684.def: An inherited primary limb malformation disorder characterized by congenital contractures of two or more different body areas and without primary neurologic and/or muscle disease that affects limb function.

name: patchy osteosclerosis
patchy osteosclerosis
HP:0005686.def: Patchy (irregular) increase in bone density. This can take on many forms depending on severity and distribution as can be seen on x-rays.
synonym: patchy increase of bone mineral density
patchy increase of bone mineral density

name: deformed humeral heads
deform humeral head
synonym: deformed head of long bone in upper arm
deform head of long bone in upper arm

name: dysplastic distal thumb phalanges with a central hole
dysplastic distal thumb phalanx with a central hole
joint hyperflexibility
joint hyperflexibility
HP:0005692.def: Increased mobility and flexibility in the joint due to the tension in tissues such as ligaments and muscles.
synonym: joints move beyond expected range of motion
joint move beyond expect range of motion

name: partial fusion of proximal row of carpal bones
partial fusion of proximal row of carpal bone
synonym: partial fusion of innermost row of wrist bones
partial fusion of innermost row of wrist bone

HP:0006486.def: An abnormality of the dental root.

bowing of the long bone

name: bowing of the arm
bowing of the arm

obsolete anomaly of the limb diaphyses morphology

abnormal limb epiphysis morphology

aplasia / hypoplasia of the humerus
HP:0006507.def: Absence (due to failure to form) or underdevelopment of the humerus.
