name: iris hypopigmentation
iris hypopigmentation
HP:0007730.def: An abnormal reduction in the amount of pigmentation of the iris.

name: chorioretinal dysplasia
chorioretinal dysplasia
HP:0007731.def: Abnormal development of the choroid and retina.

name: bone spicule pigmentation of the retina
bone spicule pigmentation of the retina
HP:0007737.def: Pigment migration into the retina in a bone-spicule configuration (resembling the nucleated cells within the lacuna of bone).

name: macular dystrophy
macular dystrophy
HP:0007754.def: Macular dystrophy is a nonspecific term for premature retinal cell aging and cell death, generally confied to the macula in which no clear extrinsic cause is evident.

name: obsolete slitlike anterior chamber angles in children
obsolete slitlike anterior chamber angle in child
opacification of the corneal stroma
opacification of the corneal stroma
HP:0007759.def: Reduced transparency of the stroma of cornea.

name: pericentral scotoma
pericentral scotoma
HP:0007761.def: A scotoma (area of diminished vision within the visual field) that surrounds the central fixation point.

name: retinal telangiectasia
retinal telangiectasia
HP:0007763.def: Dilatation of small blood vessels of the retina.

name: deep anterior chamber
deep anterior chamber
HP:0007765.def: Increased depth of the anterior chamber, i.e., the anteroposterior distance between the cornea and the iris is increased.

name: optic disc hypoplasia
optic disc hypoplasia
HP:0007766.def: Underdevelopment of the optic disc, that is of the optic nerve head, where ganglion cell axons exit the eye to form the optic nerve.

name: central retinal vessel vascular tortuosity
central retinal vessel vascular tortuosity
HP:0007768.def: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of retinal blood vessels (arteries, arterioles, veins, venules).

name: impaired smooth pursuit
impaired smooth pursuit
HP:0007772.def: An impairment of the ability to track objects with the ocular smooth pursuit system, a class of rather slow eye movements that minimizes retinal target motion.

name: vitreoretinopathy
vitreoretinopathy
HP:0007773.def: Ocular abnormality characterised by premature degeneration of the vitreous and the retina that may be associated with increased risk of retinal detachment.

name: chorioretinal scar
chorioretinal scar
HP:0007777.def: Fibrous connective tissue resulting from incomplete healing of a wound (i.e., a scar) located in the choroid and retina or the eye.

name: posterior retinal neovascularization
posterior retinal neovascularization
HP:0007778.def: A type of retinal neovascularization that affects the posterior pole of the retina.
synonym: neovascularization of peripheral and posterior retina
neovascularization of peripheral and posterior retina

name: cortical pulverulent cataract
cortical pulverulent cataract
HP:0007780.def: A type of cataract characterized by punctate, dust-like opacities within the cortical region of the lens.

name: obsolete butterfly retinal pigment epithelial dystrophy
obsolete butterfly retinal pigment epithelial dystrophy
posterior subcapsular cataract
posterior subcapsular cataract
HP:0007787.def: A type of cataract affecting the posterior pole of lens immediately adjacent to ('beneath') the Lens capsule.
synonym: posterior subcapsular opacities of the lens
posterior subcapsular opacity of the lens

name: patchy atrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium
patchy atrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium
HP:0007791.def: Wasting (atrophy) of the retinal pigment epithelium present in small, isolated areas.

name: granular macular appearance
granular macular appearance
HP:0007793.def: Mottled (spotted or blotched with different shades) pigmentary abnormality of the macula lutea.

name: anterior cortical cataract
anterior cortical cataract
HP:0007795.def: A cataract that affects the anterior part of the cortex of the lens.

name: conjunctival whitish salt - like deposits
conjunctival whitish salt - like deposit
HP:0007799.def: The presence of whitish deposits in the conjunctiva resembling salt. May be related to calcinosis.

name: increased axial length of the globe
increase axial length of the globe
HP:0007800.def: Abnormal largeness of the eye with an axial length > 2.5 standard deviations from population mean.
synonym: increased front to back length of eyeball
increase front to back length of eyeball

name: granular corneal dystrophy
granular corneal dystrophy
HP:0007802.def: The presence of central, fine, whitish granular lesions in the stroma of the cornea. This type of corneal dystrophy is usually asymptomatic and begins in childhood and shows a slow progression. Later in the course, the corneal epithelium and Bowman's layer may be affected. Histologically, the cornea shows a uniform deposition of hyaline material.

name: monochromacy
monochromacy
HP:0007803.def: Complete color blindness, a complete inability to distinguish colors. Affected persons cannot perceive colors, but only shades of gray.

name: horizontal pendular nystagmus
horizontal pendular nystagmus
HP:0007811.def: Nystagmus consisting of horizontal to-and-fro eye movements of equal velocity.

name: herpetiform corneal ulceration
herpetiform corneal ulceration
HP:0007812.def: The presence of one or more dendritic corneal epithelial ulcers characterized by a treelike branching linear pattern with feathery edges and terminal bulbs. Herpetiform corneal ulcers can be identified by fluorescein staining.

name: nongranulomatous uveitis
nongranulomatous uveitis
HP:0007813.def: A form of uveitis that is not associated with the formation of granulomas.

name: retinal pigment epithelial mottling
retinal pigment epithelial mottling
HP:0007814.def: Mottling (spots or blotches with different shades) of the retinal pigment epithelium, i.e., localized or generalized fundal pigment granularity associated with processes at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium.
synonym: focal hypopigmentation of the retinal pigment epithelium
focal hypopigmentation of the retinal pigment epithelium

name: abnormal distribution of retinal arterioles and venules
abnormal distribution of retinal arteriole and venule
horizontal supranuclear gaze palsy
horizontal supranuclear gaze palsy
HP:0007817.def: A supranuclear gaze palsy is an inability to look in a horizontal direction as a result of cerebral impairment. There is a loss of the voluntary aspect of eye movements, but, as the brainstem is still intact, all the reflex conjugate eye movements are normal.

name: central heterochromia
central heterochromia
HP:0007818.def: The presence of distinct colors in the central (pupillary) zone of the iris than in the mid-peripheral (ciliary) zone.

name: presenile cataracts
presenile cataract
HP:0007819.def: Presenile cataract is a kind of cataract that occurs in early adulthood, that is, at an age that is younger than usual.

name: lacrimal punctal atresia
lacrimal punctal atresia
HP:0007820.def: Congenital absence or closure of the opening of the lacrimal punctum.

name: total ophthalmoplegia
total ophthalmoplegia
HP:0007824.def: Paralysis of both the extrinsic and intrinsic ocular muscles.

name: obsolete cataracts develop in second or third decade
obsolete cataract develop in second or third decade
adult - onset night blindness
adult - onset night blindness
HP:0007830.def: Inability to see well at night or in poor light with onset in adulthood.

name: nonprogressive restrictive external ophthalmoplegia
nonprogressive restrictive external ophthalmoplegia
HP:0007831.def: Nonprogressive restriction of movement of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position. Residual eye movements are significantly limited.

name: pigmentation of the sclera
pigmentation of the sclera
synonym: pigmentation of the outer white part of the eyeball
pigmentation of the outer white part of the eyeball

name: progressive cataract
progressive cataract
HP:0007834.def: A kind of cataract that progresses with age.

name: s - shaped palpebral fissures
s - shaped palpebral fissure
synonym: s - shaped opening between the eyelids
s - shape open between the eyelid

name: long upper eyelashes
long upper eyelash
HP:0007840.def: Increased length of the upper eyelashes.

name: amyloid deposition in the vitreous humor
amyloid deposition in the vitreous humor
HP:0007841.def: Deposition of hyaline extracellular material (amyloid) into the vitreous humor, which can manifest as vitreous opacities and reduced visual acuity.
synonym: amyloid deposition in the vitreous humour
amyloid deposition in the vitreous humour

name: attenuation of retinal blood vessels
attenuation of retinal blood vessel
synonym: narrowing of blood vessels in back of eye
narrowing of blood vessel in back of eye

name: punctate opacification of the cornea
punctate opacification of the cornea
HP:0007856.def: Punctate opacification (reduced transparency) of the corneal stroma.

name: chorioretinal lacunae
chorioretinal lacuna
HP:0007858.def: Punched out lesions in the pigmented layer of the retina.

name: congenital horizontal nystagmus
congenital horizontal nystagmus
HP:0007859.def: Horizontal nystagmus dating from or present at birth.

name: retinal calcification
retinal calcification
HP:0007862.def: Deposition of calcium salts in the retina.

name: restrictive partial external ophthalmoplegia
restrictive partial external ophthalmoplegia
HP:0007867.def: Fibrosis of only some of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position.

name: choroidal hemangioma
choroidal hemangioma
HP:0007872.def: The presence of multiple hemangiomas in the choroid. These are generally reddish or orange or can have increased pigmentation maiking them difficult to distinguish from choroidal melanomas.

name: almond - shaped palpebral fissure
almond - shaped palpebral fissure
HP:0007874.def: A shape created by an acute downward arching of the upper eyelid and upward arching of the lower eyelid, toward the medial canthus, which gives the outline of the palpebral fissures the configuration of an almond. Thus, the maximum distance between the fissures is offset from, and medial to, the center point.
synonym: almond - shaped opening between the eyelids
almond - shape open between the eyelid

name: allergic conjunctivitis
allergic conjunctivitis
HP:0007879.def: Allergic Conjunctivitis is an allergic inflammation of the conjunctiva.

name: slowed horizontal saccades
slow horizontal saccade
HP:0007885.def: An abnormally slow velocity of horizontal saccadic eye movements.

name: absent extraocular muscles
absent extraocular muscle
HP:0007886.def: Congenital absence of the extraocular muscles.

name: iridescent posterior subcapsular cataract
iridescent posterior subcapsular cataract
HP:0007889.def: A type of posterior subcapsular cataract characterized by an iridescent color.

name: hypopigmentation of the fundus
hypopigmentation of the fundus
HP:0007894.def: Reduced pigmentation of the fundus, typically generalised. Fundoscopy may reveal a low level pigment in both RPE and choroid with clear visibility of choroidal vessels (pale/albinoid) or low pigment level in the RPE with deep pigment in choroid so that visible choroidal vessels are separated by deeply pigmented zones (tesselated/tigroid).

name: retinal nonattachment
retinal nonattachment
HP:0007899.def: Failure of attachment of the retina during development.

name: vitreous hemorrhage
vitreous hemorrhage
HP:0007902.def: Bleeding within the vitreous compartment of the eye.

name: paravenous chorioretinal atrophy
paravenous chorioretinal atrophy
HP:0007903.def: Chorioretinal atrophy along the retinal veins.

name: ocular hypertension
ocular hypertension
HP:0007906.def: Intraocular pressure that is 2 standard deviations above the population mean.

name: congenital bilateral ptosis
congenital bilateral ptosis
synonym: congenital drooping of both upper eyelids
congenital drooping of both upper eyelid

name: reticular retinal dystrophy
reticular retinal dystrophy
HP:0007913.def: A type of of patterned retinal dystrophy that shows a reticular pattern of pigmentation.

name: polymorphous posterior corneal dystrophy
polymorphous posterior corneal dystrophy
HP:0007915.def: This corneal dystrophy affects the posterior limiting membrane of the cornea and is characterized by polymorphous plaques of calcium deposits in the deep stromal layers of the cornea, and occasionally by vesicular lesions of the endothelium and edema of the deep corneal stroma.

name: obsolete small anterior lens surface opacities
obsolete small anterior lens surface opacity
tractional retinal detachment
tractional retinal detachment
HP:0007917.def: A type of retinal detachment arising due to a combination of contracting retinal membranes, abnormal vitreoretinal adhesions, and vitreous changes. It is usually seen in the context of diseases that induce a fibrovascular response, e.g. diabetes.

name: slow decrease in visual acuity
slow decrease in visual acuity
synonym: slow decrease in sharpness of vision
slow decrease in sharpness of vision

name: lacrimal duct aplasia
lacrimal duct aplasia
HP:0007925.def: A congenital defect resulting in absence of the lacrimal duct.

name: abnormal flash visual evoked potentials
abnormal flash visual evoke potential
HP:0007928.def: Anomaly of the visual evoked potentials elicited by a flash stimulus, generally a flash of light subtending an angle of at least 20 degrees of the visual field and presented in a dimly lit room.

name: peripheral retinal detachment
peripheral retinal detachment
HP:0007929.def: Separation of the inner layers of the retina (neural retina) from the pigment epithelium occuring near the outer limit (periphery) of the retina.

name: bilateral congenital mydriasis
bilateral congenital mydriasis
HP:0007932.def: Congenital abnormal dilation of the pupil on both sides.

name: broad lateral eyebrow
broad lateral eyebrow
HP:0007933.def: Regional increase in the width (height) of the lateral eyebrow.

name: restrictive external ophthalmoplegia
restrictive external ophthalmoplegia
HP:0007936.def: Fibrosis of the external ocular muscles such that the eyes of affected individuals are partially or completely fixed in a strabismic position. Residual eye movements are significantly limited.

name: reticular pigmentary degeneration
reticular pigmentary degeneration
HP:0007937.def: A type of retinal reticular pigmentation that forms a polygonal, netlike arrangement of hyperpigmented lines forming geometric patterns in the fundus.

name: blue cone monochromacy
blue cone monochromacy
HP:0007939.def: A form of monochromacy in which vision is derived from the remaining preserved blue (S) cones and rod photoreceptors.

name: limited extraocular movements
limited extraocular movement
HP:0007941.def: Limited mobility of the eye within its socket.

name: internal ophthalmoplegia
internal ophthalmoplegia
HP:0007942.def: Paralysis of the iris and ciliary apparatus.

name: congenital stapes ankylosis
congenital stapes ankylosis
HP:0007943.def: A form of stapes ankylosis with congenital onset.

name: unilateral narrow palpebral fissure
unilateral narrow palpebral fissure
HP:0007946.def: A fixed reduction in the vertical distance between the upper and lower eyelids with short palpebral fissures on one side only.
synonym: unequal size of opening between the eyelids
unequal size of open between the eyelid

name: pericentral retinitis pigmentosa
pericentral retinitis pigmentosa
HP:0007947.def: A subtype of retinitis pigmentosa in which, instead of the pathology starting in the mid-periphery like typical retinitis pigmentosa, the disease starts in the near periphery closer to the vascular arcades and tends to spare the far periphery.

name: dense posterior cortical cataract
dense posterior cortical cataract
HP:0007948.def: A type of posterior cortical cataract characterized by dense lenticular opacities.

name: peripapillary chorioretinal atrophy
peripapillary chorioretinal atrophy
HP:0007950.def: Chorioretinal atrophy concentrated around the optic papilla (i.e., the optic nerve head).

name: corneal opacity
corneal opacity
synonym: scarring or clouding of the cornea of the eye
scar or clouding of the cornea of the eye

name: optic atrophy from cranial nerve compression
optic atrophy from cranial nerve compression
pattern dystrophy of the retina
pattern dystrophy of the retina
HP:0007963.def: A spectrum of fundoscopic appearances characterized by the development of a variety of patterns of deposits predominantly in the macular area. The deposits are typically bilateral, relatively symmetrical, yellow/white and associated with changes at the level of the retinal pigment epithelium. With time, retinal atrophy may occur. A number of pattern dystrophy subtypes have been described including butterfly-shaped dystrophy, reticular dystrophy (net-like pattern) and fundus pulverulentus (granular, mottled pigmentation).

name: remnants of the hyaloid vascular system
remnant of the hyaloid vascular system
HP:0007968.def: Persistence of the hyaloid artery, which is the embryonic artery that runs from the optic disk to the posterior lens capsule may persist; the site of attachment may form an opacity. The hyaloid artery is a branch of the ophthalmic artery, and usually regresses completely before birth. This features results from a failure of regression of the hyaloid vessel, which supplies the primary vitreous during embryogenesis and normally regresses in the third trimester of pregnancy, leading to a particular form of posterior cataract.
synonym: persistent posterior fetal fibrovascular sheath of the lens
persistent posterior fetal fibrovascular sheath of the lens
persistent posterior foetal fibrovascular sheath of the lens
persistent posterior foetal fibrovascular sheath of the lens

name: lamellar cataract
lamellar cataract
HP:0007971.def: A congenital cataract in which opacity is limited to layers of the lens external to the nucleus (i.e., the perinuclear region), i.e., between the nuclear and cortical layers of the lens.

name: retinal dysplasia
retinal dysplasia
HP:0007973.def: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the retina.

name: hypometric horizontal saccades
hypometric horizontal saccade
HP:0007975.def: Saccadic undershoot of horizontal saccadic eye movements, i.e., a horizontal saccadic eye movement that has less than the magnitude that would be required to gain fixation of the object.

name: cerulean cataract
cerulean cataract
HP:0007976.def: Cerulean cataracts are a kind of congenital cataract having peripheral bluish and white opacifications in concentric layers with occasional central lesions arranged radially. Although the opacities may be observed during fetal development and childhood, usually visual acuity is only mildly reduced until adulthood, when lens extraction is generally necessary.

name: gaze - evoked horizontal nystagmus
gaze - evoked horizontal nystagmus
HP:0007979.def: Horizontal nystagmus made apparent by looking to the right or to the left.

name: obsolete concentric narrowing of visual field
obsolete concentric narrowing of visual field
electronegative electroretinogram
electronegative electroretinogram
HP:0007984.def: A dark-adapted bright flash electroretinogram in which the b-wave that is of markedly lower amplitude than the associated a-wave (source: Holder GE., Inherited Chorioretinal Dystrophies: A Textbook and Atlas; 2014; p.17; ISBN 978-3-540-69466-3).
synonym: reduced amplitude of dark - adapted bright flash electroretinogram b - wave
reduce amplitude of dark - adapted bright flash electroretinogram b - wave
reduced erg amplitude of b - wave
reduce erg amplitude of b - wave

name: retinal arteriolar occlusion
retinal arteriolar occlusion
HP:0007985.def: Blockage of retinal arteriole, generally associated with interruption of blood flow and oxygen delivery to affected regions of the retina.

name: macular hypopigmentation
macular hypopigmentation
HP:0007988.def: Decreased amount of pigmentation in the macula lutea.

name: intraretinal exudate
intraretinal exudate
HP:0007989.def: Retinal exudate within the retinal tissue itself.

name: hypoplastic iris stroma
hypoplastic iris stroma
HP:0007990.def: Underdevelopment of the stroma of iris.

name: malformed lacrimal duct
malformed lacrimal duct
HP:0007993.def: Congenital malformation of the lacrimal duct associated with incomplete development of the bony nasolacrimal canal or craniofacial anomalies.

name: peripheral visual field loss
peripheral visual field loss
HP:0007994.def: Loss of peripheral vision with retention of central vision, resulting in a constricted circular tunnel-like field of vision.

name: decreased corneal reflex
decrease corneal reflex
HP:0008000.def: An abnormally reduced response to stimulation of the cornea (by touch, foreign body, blowing air). The corneal reflex (also known as the blink reflex, normally results in an involuntary blinking of the eyelids.

name: foveal hyperpigmentation
foveal hyperpigmentation
HP:0008001.def: Increased amount of pigmentation in the fovea centralis.

name: abnormality of macular pigmentation
abnormality of macular pigmentation
HP:0008002.def: Abnormality of macular or foveal pigmentation.

name: peripheral opacification of the cornea
peripheral opacification of the cornea
HP:0008011.def: Reduced transparency of the peripheral region of the cornea.

name: central fundal arteriolar microaneurysms
central fundal arteriolar microaneurysms
HP:0008014.def: Microscopic aneurysms of the retinal arterioles near the central part of the fundus, visible as small round dark red dots on the retinal surface (not arising from visible vessels) that are by definition less than the diameter of the major optic veins as they cross the optic disc.

name: obsolete depigmented lesions of the retinal pigment epithelium
obsolete depigmented lesion of the retinal pigment epithelium
superior lens subluxation
superior lens subluxation
HP:0008019.def: Partial dislocation of the lens in a superior direction.

name: cystoid macular degeneration
cystoid macular degeneration
HP:0008028.def: A form of macular degeneration characterized by the presence of multiple cysts in the macula.

name: posterior y - sutural cataract
posterior y - sutural cataract
HP:0008031.def: A type of sutural cataract in which the opacity follows the posterior Y suture.

name: retinitis pigmentosa inversa
retinitis pigmentosa inversa
HP:0008035.def: Retinitis pigmentosa inversa is form of retinal degeneration characterized by areas of retinal/chorioretinal degeneration with pigment migration in the macular area (in contrast to retinitis pigmentosa which, at early disease stages, predominantly affects the retinal periphery).

name: absent anterior chamber of the eye
absent anterior chamber of the eye
HP:0008037.def: Absence of the anterior chamber of the eye owing to a developmental defect.

name: aplastic / hypoplastic lacrimal glands
aplastic / hypoplastic lacrimal gland
HP:0008038.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the lacrimal gland.

name: retinal arteriolar constriction
retinal arteriolar constriction
HP:0008043.def: Decreased retinal arteriolar diameters, which may decrease blood flow and slow oxygen delivery to regions of the retina.

name: abnormal retinal vascular morphology
abnormal retinal vascular morphology
HP:0008046.def: A structural abnormality of retinal vasculature.

name: abnormality of the vasculature of the eye
abnormality of the vasculature of the eye
abnormal line of schwalbe morphology
abnormal line of schwalbe morphology
HP:0008048.def: An abnormality of the line of Schwalbe.
synonym: abnormality of the line of schwalbe
abnormality of the line of schwalbe

name: abnormality of the extraocular muscles
abnormality of the extraocular muscle
HP:0008049.def: An abnormality of an extraocular muscle.

name: abnormality of the palpebral fissures
abnormality of the palpebral fissure
HP:0008050.def: An anomaly of the space between the medial and lateral canthi of the two open eyelids.
synonym: abnormality of the opening between the eyelids
abnormality of the opening between the eyelid

name: obsolete abnormality of the retinal pigment epithelium
obsolete abnormality of the retinal pigment epithelium
retinal fold
retinal fold
HP:0008052.def: A wrinkle of retinal tissue projecting outward from the surface of the retina and visible as a line on fundoscopy.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the iris
aplasia / hypoplasia of the iris
HP:0008053.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the iris.

name: abnormal morphology of the conjunctival vasculature
abnormal morphology of the conjunctival vasculature
HP:0008054.def: Any abnormality of the blood vessels of the conjunctiva.
synonym: abnormal morphology of the conjunctiva vasculature
abnormal morphology of the conjunctiva vasculature
abnormal vasculature of the conjunctiva morphology
abnormal vasculature of the conjunctiva morphology
abnormality of the vasculature of the conjunctiva
abnormality of the vasculature of the conjunctiva

name: aplasia / hypoplasia affecting the uvea
aplasia / hypoplasia affect the uvea
HP:0008055.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the uvea, the pigmented middle layer of the eye consisting of the iris and ciliary body together with the choroid.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the optic nerve
aplasia / hypoplasia of the optic nerve
aplasia / hypoplasia of the fovea
aplasia / hypoplasia of the fovea
HP:0008060.def: Congenital absence or underdevelopment of the fovea centralis.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia affecting the anterior segment of the eye
aplasia / hypoplasia affect the anterior segment of the eye
HP:0008062.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the anterior segment of the eye.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the lens
aplasia / hypoplasia of the lens
HP:0008063.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the lens.

name: ichthyosis
ichthyosis
HP:0008064.def: An abnormality of the skin characterized the presence of excessive amounts of dry surface scales on the skin resulting from an abnormality of keratinization.

name: abnormal blistering of the skin
abnormal blistering of the skin
HP:0008066.def: The presence of one or more bullae on the skin, defined as fluid-filled blisters more than 5 mm in diameter with thin walls.

name: neoplasm of the skin
neoplasm of the skin
HP:0008069.def: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the skin.

name: maternal hypertension
maternal hypertension
HP:0008071.def: Increased blood pressure during a pregnancy.

name: maternal virilization in pregnancy
maternal virilization in pregnancy
HP:0008072.def: Virilization (deepening of voice, facial hirsutism and scalp hair loss) with onset during pregnancy (usually towards the end of the first trimester) and regression several months post-partum.

name: low maternal circulating estriol concentration
low maternal circulating estriol concentration
HP:0008073.def: An abnormally low concentration of serum conjugated estriol as compared to normal values for gestational-age.

name: osteoporotic tarsals
osteoporotic tarsal
HP:0008076.def: Reduction in bone mineral density affecting any or all of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

name: absent fifth metatarsal
absent fifth metatarsal
HP:0008079.def: A developmental abnormality characterized by the absence of the fifth metatarsal bone.
synonym: aplasia of the fifth metatarsal bone
aplasia of the fifth metatarsal bone

name: hallux varus
hallux varus
HP:0008080.def: Medial deviation of the great toe owing to a deformity of the great toe joint causing the hallux to deviate medially.

name: pes valgus
pe valgus
HP:0008081.def: An outward deviation of the foot at the talocalcaneal or subtalar joint.

name: nonossified fifth metatarsal
nonossified fifth metatarsal
HP:0008087.def: The presence of a fifth metatarsal bone that has not undergone ossification at an age when ossification is usually visible.

name: abnormality of the fifth metatarsal bone
abnormality of the fifth metatarsal bone
HP:0008089.def: An anomaly of the fifth metatarsal bone.
synonym: abnormality of the 5th long bone of foot
abnormality of the 5th long bone of foot

name: widely spaced toes
widely space toe
HP:0008094.def: An overall widening of the spaces between the digits.

name: medially deviated second toe
medially deviate second toe
HP:0008096.def: Medial deviation of the second toe.

name: expanded metatarsals with widened medullary cavities
expand metatarsal with widened medullary cavity
delayed tarsal ossification
delay tarsal ossification
HP:0008103.def: Delayed maturation and calcification of any of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

name: plantar crease between first and second toes
plantar crease between first and second toe
HP:0008107.def: The presence of unusually deep creases (ridges/wrinkles) on the skin of sole of foot located between the first and second toe.

name: advanced tarsal ossification
advanced tarsal ossification
HP:0008108.def: Precocious (accelerated) maturation and calcification of any of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

name: plantar flexion contracture
plantar flexion contracture
HP:0008112.def: A type of contracture in which the plantar flexion muscles are contracted.

name: metatarsal diaphyseal endosteal sclerosis
metatarsal diaphyseal endosteal sclerosis
HP:0008114.def: Osteosclerosis of the endosteal surface of the diaphyses (shafts) of the metatarsal bones.

name: clinodactyly of the 3rd toe
clinodactyly of the 3rd toe
HP:0008115.def: Bending or curvature of a third toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).

name: flexion limitation of toes
flexion limitation of toe
HP:0008116.def: Limitation of the ability to bend the toes.

name: calcaneonavicular fusion
calcaneonavicular fusion
HP:0008122.def: Synostosis of the calcaneus with the navicular bone.

name: talipes calcaneovarus
talipes calcaneovarus
HP:0008124.def: A congenital deformity characterized by a dorsiflexed, inverted, and adducted foot, i.e., a combination of talipes calcaneus and talipes varus.

name: bipartite calcaneus
bipartite calcaneus
HP:0008127.def: A two-part calcaneus, a finding that probably results from delayed coalescence of two primary calcaneal centers of ossification.
synonym: delayed coalescence of calcaneal ossification centers
delay coalescence of calcaneal ossification center
delayed coalescence of calcaneal ossification centres
delay coalescence of calcaneal ossification centre

name: tarsal stippling
tarsal stipple
HP:0008131.def: The presence of abnormal punctate (speckled, dot-like) calcifications in one or more tarsal bones.

name: medial rotation of the medial malleolus
medial rotation of the medial malleolus
irregular tarsal ossification
irregular tarsal ossification
HP:0008134.def: Defective ossification in an irregular pattern of the seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

name: equinus calcaneus
equinus calcaneus
HP:0008138.def: Abnormal plantar flexion of the calcaneus relative to the longitudinal axis of the tibia. This results in the angle between the long axis of the tibia and the long axis of the heel bone (calcaneus) being greater than 90 degrees.

name: delayed calcaneal ossification
delay calcaneal ossification
HP:0008142.def: Delayed maturation and calcification of the calcaneus.

name: impaired epinephrine - induced platelet aggregation
impaired epinephrine - induced platelet aggregation
HP:0008148.def: Abnormal response to epinephrine as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of epinephrine.

name: elevated serum transaminases during infections
elevate serum transaminase during infection
HP:0008150.def: Elevations of the levels of SGOT (serum glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase) and SGPT (serum glutamic pyruvic transaminase) that occur during infections.

name: prolonged prothrombin time
prolong prothrombin time
HP:0008151.def: Increased time to coagulation in the prothrombin time test, which is a measure of the extrinsic pathway of coagulation. The results of the prothrombin time test are often expressed in terms of the International normalized ratio (INR), which is calculated as a ratio of the patient's prothrombin time (PT) to a control PT standardized for the potency of the thromboplastin reagent developed by the World Health Organization (WHO) using the formula: INR is equal to Patient PT divided by Control PT.

name: periodic hypokalemic paresis
periodic hypokalemic paresis
HP:0008153.def: Episodes of muscle weakness associated with reduced levels of potassium in the blood.

name: mucopolysacchariduria
mucopolysacchariduria
HP:0008155.def: Excessive amounts of mucopolysaccharide in the urine.

name: hyperapobetalipoproteinemia
hyperapobetalipoproteinemia
HP:0008158.def: Hyperapobetalipoproteinemia is defined as the combination of a normal low density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol in the face of an increased LDL apolipoprotein B (apoB) protein.

name: 3 - hydroxydicarboxylic aciduria
3 - hydroxydicarboxylic aciduria
HP:0008160.def: The concentration of 2-hydroxydicarboxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: absent leukocyte alkaline phosphatase
absent leukocyte alkaline phosphatase
HP:0008161.def: Alkaline phosphatase levels measured within leukocytes is below detectable levels.

name: asymptomatic hyperammonemia
asymptomatic hyperammonemia
HP:0008162.def: An increased concentration of ammonia in the blood not associated with symptoms such as encephalopathy.

name: decreased circulating cortisol level
decrease circulate cortisol level
HP:0008163.def: Abnormally reduced concentration of cortisol in the blood.

name: decreased helper t cell proportion
decrease helper t cell proportion
HP:0008165.def: Reduced proportion of helper T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
synonym: decreased proportion circulating t - helper cells
decrease proportion circulate t - helper cell

name: decreased beta - galactosidase activity
decrease beta - galactosidase activity
HP:0008166.def: Abnormally decreased rate of beta-galactosidase activity. Beta-galactosidase activity can be measured in leukocyte, fibroblast, or plasma.
synonym: beta - galactosidase deficiency in fibroblasts and white blood cells
beta - galactosidase deficiency in fibroblast and white blood cell

name: very long chain fatty acid accumulation
very long chain fatty acid accumulation
reduced factor vii activity
reduce factor vii activity
HP:0008169.def: Reduced activity of coagulation factor VII. Factor VII is part of the extrinsic coagulation pathway, which is initiated at the site of injury in response to the release of tissue factor (fIII). Tissue factor and activated factor VII catalyze the activation of factor X.

name: decreased arden ratio of electrooculogram
decrease arden ratio of electrooculogram
HP:0008179.def: An abnormal reduction in the Arden ratio, which is the ratio between the light peak and the dark trough of the smoothed (physiologic) EOG record.

name: abetalipoproteinemia
abetalipoproteinemia
HP:0008181.def: An absence of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood.

name: precocious puberty in males
precocious puberty in male
HP:0008185.def: The onset of puberty before the age of 9 years in boys.
synonym: early onset of puberty in males
early onset of puberty in male

name: adrenocortical cytomegaly
adrenocortical cytomegaly
HP:0008186.def: The presence of large polyhedral cells with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and enlarged nuclei in the adrenal cortex.

name: absence of secondary sex characteristics
absence of secondary sex characteristic
HP:0008187.def: No secondary sexual characteristics are present at puberty.
synonym: no secondary sexual characteristics at puberty
no secondary sexual characteristic at puberty

name: thyroid agenesis
thyroid agenesis
HP:0008191.def: The congenital absence of the thyroid gland.

name: multiple pancreatic beta - cell adenomas
multiple pancreatic beta - cell adenoma
HP:0008194.def: The presence of multiple pancreatic islet cell adenomas.

name: congenital hypoparathyroidism
congenital hypoparathyroidism
HP:0008198.def: Deficiency of parathyroid hormone with congenital onset.

name: primary hyperparathyroidism
primary hyperparathyroidism
HP:0008200.def: A type of hyperparathyroidism caused by a primary abnormality of the parathyroid glands (e.g., adenoma, carcinoma, hyperplasia). Primary hyperparathyroidism is associated with hyercalcemia.

name: reduced circulating prolactin concentration
reduce circulate prolactin concentration
HP:0008202.def: A reduced level of prolactin in the blood circulation. Prolactin is a protein hormone that is secreted by lactotrophs in the anterior pituitary and that stimulates mammary gland development and milk production.

name: precocious puberty with sertoli cell tumor
precocious puberty with sertoli cell tumor
synonym: precocious puberty with sertoli cell tumour
precocious puberty with sertoli cell tumour

name: insulin - dependent but ketosis - resistant diabetes
insulin - dependent but ketosis - resistant diabetes
HP:0008205.def: Ketosis-resistant diabetes is a synonym for type II diabetes. This term thus refers to a form of type II diabetes in which patients are dependent on insulin.

name: primary adrenal insufficiency
primary adrenal insufficiency
HP:0008207.def: Insufficient production of steroid hormones (primarily cortisol) by the adrenal glands as a result of a primary defect in the glands themselves.

name: premature ovarian insufficiency
premature ovarian insufficiency
HP:0008209.def: Amenorrhea due to loss of ovarian function before the age of 40. Primary ovarian inssuficiency (POI) is a state of female hypergonadotropic hypogonadism. It can manifest as primary amenorrhea with onset before menarche or secondary amenorrhea.

name: gonadotropin deficiency
gonadotropin deficiency
HP:0008213.def: A reduced ability to secrete gonadotropins, which are protein hormones secreted by gonadotrope cells of the anterior pituitary gland, including the hormones follitropin (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH).

name: decreased serum estradiol
decrease serum estradiol
HP:0008214.def: A reduction below normal concentration of estradiol in the circulation.

name: adrenal gland dysgenesis
adrenal gland dysgenesis
HP:0008216.def: Abnormal development of the adrenal gland.

name: compensated hypothyroidism
compensate hypothyroidism
HP:0008223.def: Condition associated with a raised serum concentration of thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) but a normal serum free thyroxine (FT4).

name: pituitary resistance to thyroid hormone
pituitary resistance to thyroid hormone
HP:0008227.def: A condition in which the pituitary gland is partially resistant to thyroid hormone, so that it continues to secrete thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) until the blood level of thyroid hormone rises higher than normal.

name: thyroid lymphangiectasia
thyroid lymphangiectasia
HP:0008229.def: The presence of lymphangiectasis of the thyroid gland.

name: elevated circulating follicle stimulating hormone level
elevate circulate follicle stimulate hormone level
HP:0008232.def: An elevated concentration of follicle-stimulating hormone in the blood.
synonym: increased circulating follicle stimulating hormone level
increase circulate follicle stimulate hormone level

name: decreased circulating progesterone
decrease circulate progesterone
HP:0008233.def: An reduced concentration of progesterone in the blood.

name: hypothalamic hypothyroidism
hypothalamic hypothyroidism
HP:0008237.def: A type of hypothyroidism that results from a defect in thyrotropin-releasing hormone activity.

name: adrenal medullary hypoplasia
adrenal medullary hypoplasia
HP:0008239.def: Developmental hypoplasia of the adrenal medulla.

name: pseudohypoaldosteronism
pseudohypoaldosteronism
HP:0008242.def: A state of renal tubular unresponsiveness or resistance to the action of aldosterone.

name: congenital adrenal hypoplasia
congenital adrenal hypoplasia
HP:0008244.def: A type of adrenal hypoplasia with congenital onset.

name: pituitary hypothyroidism
pituitary hypothyroidism
HP:0008245.def: A type of hypothyroidism that results from a defect in thyroid-stimulating hormone secretion.
synonym: low thyroid gland function due to abnormal pituitary gland
low thyroid gland function due to abnormal pituitary gland

name: euthyroid hyperthyroxinemia
euthyroid hyperthyroxinemia
HP:0008247.def: Increased levels of thyroxine without evidence of clinical thyroid disease.

name: congenital goiter
congenital goiter
HP:0008251.def: An enlargement of the thyroid gland with congenital onset.

name: adrenocortical adenoma
adrenocortical adenoma
HP:0008256.def: Adrenocortical adenomas are benign tumors of the adrenal cortex.

name: congenital adrenal hyperplasia
congenital adrenal hyperplasia
HP:0008258.def: A type of adrenal hyperplasia with congenital onset.

name: adrenocorticotropin receptor defect
adrenocorticotropin receptor defect
HP:0008259.def: Adrenal insufficiency secondary to a defect in the ACTH receptor.

name: pancreatic islet cell adenoma
pancreatic islet cell adenoma
HP:0008261.def: The presence of an adenoma of the pancreas with origin in a pancreatic B cell.

name: thyroid defect in oxidation and organification of iodide
thyroid defect in oxidation and organification of iodide
neutrophil inclusion bodies
neutrophil inclusion body
HP:0008264.def: The presence of intracellular inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in neutrophils. Cytoplasmic neutrophil inclusions (oval, basophilic) are also known as Doehle bodies.

name: increased red cell hemolysis by shear stress
increase red cell hemolysis by shear stress
abnormal cartilage collagen
abnormal cartilage collagen
HP:0008271.def: Abnormal morphology of collagen fibers in cartilage. In cartilage, collagen II, actually a collagen II:IX:XI heterofibril, is by far the most important type of collagen. A number of abnormalities may be appreciated by electron micrography or biochemical investigations, including sparse collagen fibers in the cartilage matrix.

name: abnormal blood zinc concentration
abnormal blood zinc concentration
HP:0008277.def: An abnormality of zinc ion homeostasis.

name: acute hyperammonemia
acute hyperammonemia
HP:0008281.def: An increased concentration of ammonia in the blood with sudden onset.

name: unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia
unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia
HP:0008282.def: An increased amount of unconjugated (indirect) bilurubin in the blood.

name: fasting hyperinsulinemia
fast hyperinsulinemia
HP:0008283.def: An increased concentration of insulin in the blood in the fasting state, i.e., not as the response to food intake.
synonym: high blood insulin levels while fasting
high blood insulin level while fast

name: partial complement factor h deficiency
partial complement factor h deficiency
HP:0008290.def: A partial reduction in level of the complement component Factor H in circulation.

name: pituitary corticotropic cell adenoma
pituitary corticotropic cell adenoma
HP:0008291.def: A type of pituitary adenoma that produces adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH).

name: long - chain dicarboxylic aciduria
long - chain dicarboxylic aciduria
HP:0008293.def: An increase in the level of long-chain dicarboxylic acid in the urine.

name: transient hyperphenylalaninemia
transient hyperphenylalaninemia
HP:0008297.def: A condition of not having consistently high levels of phenylalanine in the blood but of experiencing temporary hyperphenylalaninemia following ingestion of large quantities of phenylalanine (for instance, following an oral loading test with phenylalanine).

name: dermatan sulfate excretion in urine
dermatan sulfate excretion in urine
HP:0008301.def: An increased concentration of dermatan sulfate in the urine.

name: olivary degeneration
olivary degeneration
HP:0008303.def: Degeneration of the olivary bodies, prominent oval structures in the medulla oblongata.

name: exercise - induced myoglobinuria
exercise - induced myoglobinuria
HP:0008305.def: Presence of myoglobin in the urine following exercise.

name: medium chain dicarboxylic aciduria
medium chain dicarboxylic aciduria
HP:0008309.def: An increase in the level of medium chain dicarboxylic acid in the urine.

name: spinal cord posterior columns myelin loss
spinal cord posterior column myelin loss
decreased activity of mitochondrial complex ii
decreased activity of mitochondrial complex ii
HP:0008314.def: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex II, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

name: decreased plasma free carnitine
decrease plasma free carnitine
HP:0008315.def: A decreased concentration of free (unbound) carnitine in the blood.

name: abnormal mitochondria in muscle tissue
abnormal mitochondrion in muscle tissue
HP:0008316.def: An abnormality of the mitochondria in muscle tissue.

name: elevated leukocyte alkaline phosphatase
elevate leukocyte alkaline phosphatase
HP:0008318.def: Increased alkaline phosphatase measured within leukocytes.

name: impaired collagen - induced platelet aggregation
impaired collagen - induced platelet aggregation
HP:0008320.def: Abnormal response to collagen or collagen-mimetics as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition collagen or collagen-mimetics.

name: reduced factor x activity
reduce factor x activity
HP:0008321.def: Reduced activity of coagulation factor X. The extrinsic and intrinsic pathways converge at factor X (fX). The extrinsic pathway activates fX by means of d factor VII with its cofactor, tissue factor. The intrinsic pathway activates fX by means of the tenase complex (Ca2+ and factors VIIIa, IXa and X) on the surface of activated platelets. Factor Xa in turn activates prothrombin (factor II) to thrombin (factor IIa).

name: abnormal mitochondrial morphology
abnormal mitochondrial morphology
HP:0008322.def: Any structural anomaly of the mitochondria.

name: abnormal light - and dark - adapted electroretinogram
abnormal light - and dark - adapt electroretinogram
HP:0008323.def: An abnormality of the combined rod-and-cone response on electroretinogram.

name: reduced circulating vitamin b6 level
reduce circulate vitamin b6 level
HP:0008326.def: An abnormally decreased concentration of vitamin B6 in the blood circulation.

name: microscopic nephrocalcinosis
microscopic nephrocalcinosis
HP:0008327.def: The presence of microscopic crystalline calcium precipitates in the form of oxalate and/or phosphate in the renal parenchyma.

name: reduced von willebrand factor activity
reduce von willebrand factor activity
HP:0008330.def: Decreased activity of von Willebrand factor. Von Willebrand factor mediates the adhesion of platelets to the collagen exposed on endothelial cell surfaces.

name: elevated creatine kinase after exercise
elevate creatine kinase after exercise
synonym: elevated phospho - creatine kinase after exercise
elevate phospho - creatine kinase after exercise
increased phospho - creatine kinase after exercise
increase phospho - creatine kinase after exercise

name: partial functional complement factor d deficiency
partial functional complement factor d deficiency
HP:0008338.def: A partial reduction in level of the complement component Factor D in circulation.

name: diaminoaciduria
diaminoaciduria
HP:0008339.def: An increased urine level of any amino acid carrying two amino groups (Asparagine, glutamine and lysine, cystine, ornithine).

name: distal renal tubular acidosis
distal renal tubular acidosis
HP:0008341.def: A type of renal tubular acidosis characterized by a failure of acid secretion by the alpha intercalated cells of the cortical collecting duct of the distal nephron. The urine cannot be acidified below a pH of 5.3, associated with acidemia and hypokalemia.

name: elevated circulating branched chain amino acid concentration
elevate circulate branch chain amino acid concentration
HP:0008344.def: Concentration of a branched chain amino acid in the blood above the upper limit of normal.

name: hypoplasia of the iris dilator muscle
hypoplasia of the iris dilator muscle
synonym: hypoplasia of the pupil dilator muscle
hypoplasia of the pupil dilator muscle

name: decreased activity of mitochondrial complex iv
decreased activity of mitochondrial complex iv
HP:0008347.def: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

name: decreased circulating igg2 level
decrease circulate igg2 level
HP:0008348.def: A reduction in immunoglobulin levels of the IgG2 subclass in the blood circulation.

name: impaired platelet adhesion
impaired platelet adhesion
HP:0008352.def: An abnormality of adhesion of thrombocytes. Normally, platelets adhere to collagen in the vascular subendothelium within seconds of injury via a receptor made up of glycoprotein Ia and IIa and GPVI and to vWF via receptor GPIb/IX/V. The adherent platelets then release granules that lead to platelet activation and aggregation.

name: neutral hyperaminoaciduria
neutral hyperaminoaciduria
HP:0008353.def: The presence of an abnormally increased concentration of neutral amino acids in the urine. The neutral amino acids are tryptophan, alanine, asparagine, glutamine, histidine, isoleucine, leucine, phenylalanine, serine, threonine, tyrosine and valine.

name: factor x activation deficiency
factor x activation deficiency
HP:0008354.def: Reduced ability to transform factor X into its activated form factor Xa.

name: reduced factor xiii activity
reduce factor xiii activity
HP:0008357.def: Decreased activity of coagulation factor XIII (also known as fibrin stabilizing factor). Activated Factor XIII cross-links fibrin polymers solidifying the clot.

name: hyperprolinemia
hyperprolinemia
HP:0008358.def: An increased concentration of proline in the blood.

name: neonatal hypoproteinemia
neonatal hypoproteinemia
HP:0008360.def: A neonatal decreased concentration of proteins in the blood.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the hallux
aplasia / hypoplasia of the hallux
HP:0008362.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the big toe.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the tarsal bones
aplasia / hypoplasia of the tarsal bone
HP:0008363.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the tarsal bones.

name: abnormality of the calcaneus
abnormality of the calcaneus
HP:0008364.def: An abnormality of the calcaneus, also known as the heel bone, one of the or heel bone, one of the components of the tarsus of the foot which make up the heel.

name: foot joint contracture
foot joint contracture
HP:0008366.def: Contractures of one or more joints of the feet meaning chronic loss of joint motion due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.
synonym: contractures involving the joints of the feet
contracture involve the joint of the foot
joint contractures involving the joints of the feet
joint contracture involve the joint of the foot

name: tarsal synostosis
tarsal synostosis
HP:0008368.def: Synostosis (bony fusion) involving one or more bones of the tarsus (calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, cuneiiform bones).

name: abnormal tarsal ossification
abnormal tarsal ossification
HP:0008369.def: An abnormality of the formation and mineralization of any of the tarsal bones, seven bones of the foot comprising the calcaneus, talus, cuboid, navicular, and the cuneiform bones.

name: abnormal metatarsal ossification
abnormal metatarsal ossification
HP:0008371.def: Any abnormal process of ossification of the metatarsal bones, which normally are each ossified from two centers: one for the body, and one for the head (metatarsal II,III,IV, and V) and one for the body and one for the base (metatarsal I). The ossification process begins in the center of the body about the ninth week, and extends toward either extremity. The center for the base of the first metatarsal appears about the third year, and the centers for the heads of the other bones between the fifth and eighth years. They join the bodies between the eighteenth and twentieth years.
synonym: abnormal maturation of long bone of foot
abnormal maturation of long bone of foot

name: abnormal circulating vitamin a concentration
abnormal circulate vitamin a concentration
HP:0008372.def: Concentration of vitamin A in the blood circulation outside limits of normal.

name: slow - growing nails
slow - grow nail
HP:0008383.def: Nails whose growth is slower than normal.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the nails
aplasia / hypoplasia of the nail
HP:0008386.def: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the nail.

name: recurrent loss of toenails and fingernails
recurrent loss of toenail and fingernail
HP:0008390.def: Repeated loss, or shedding, of the nails of the fingers and toes.
synonym: recurrent loss of toenails and fingernails
recurrent loss of toenail and fingernail
recurrent shedding of toenails and fingernails
recurrent shed of toenail and fingernail

name: dystrophic fingernails
dystrophic fingernail
HP:0008391.def: The presence of misshapen or partially destroyed nail plates, often with accumulation of soft, yellow keratin between the dystrophic nail plate and nail bed, resulting in elevation of the nail plate.

name: subungual hyperkeratosis
subungual hyperkeratosis
HP:0008392.def: A thickening of the stratum corneum in the region beneath the nails.

name: congenital curved nail of fourth toe
congenital curve nail of fourth toe
chronic monilial nail infection
chronic monilial nail infection
HP:0008396.def: Chronic infection of the nails by Candida species.

name: hypoplastic fifth fingernail
hypoplastic fifth fingernail
HP:0008398.def: A nail of the fifth finger that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped nail of little finger.

name: circumungual hyperkeratosis
circumungual hyperkeratosis
HP:0008399.def: A thickening of the stratum corneum, the outer layer of the skin, in the region surrounding the nails.

name: onycholysis of distal fingernails
onycholysis of distal fingernail
HP:0008400.def: Detachment of the distal fingernails from the nail bed.

name: ridged fingernail
ridge fingernail
HP:0008402.def: Longitudinal, linear prominences in the fingernail plate.

name: nail dystrophy
nail dystrophy
HP:0008404.def: Onychodystrophy (nail dystrophy) refers to nail changes apart from changes of the color (nail dyschromia) and involves partial or complete disruption of the various keratinous layers of the nail plate.

name: intervertebral disc degeneration
intervertebral disc degeneration
HP:0008419.def: The presence of degenerative changes of intervertebral disk.

name: punctate vertebral calcifications
punctate vertebral calcification
HP:0008420.def: The presence of punctiform calcification of the bone of the vertebral bodies.

name: vertebral wedging
vertebral wedging
HP:0008422.def: An abnormal shape of the vertebral bodies whereby the vertebral bodies are thick on one side and taper to a thin edge at the other.

name: spinal dysplasia
spinal dysplasia
HP:0008423.def: The presence of developmental dysplasia of the vertebral column.

name: vertebral clefting
vertebral clefting
HP:0008428.def: Schisis (cleft or cleavage) of vertebral bodies.

name: anterior beaking of lumbar vertebrae
anterior beaking of lumbar vertebra
HP:0008430.def: Anterior tongue-like protrusions of the vertebral bodies of the lumbar spine.
synonym: anterior tongue - like protrusion of lumbar vertebral bodies
anterior tongue - like protrusion of lumbar vertebral body

name: anterior wedging of l1
anterior wedging of l1
HP:0008432.def: An abnormality of the shape of the lumbar vertebra L1 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).

name: absent in utero ossification of vertebral bodies
absent in utero ossification of vertebral body
vertebral arch anomaly
vertebral arch anomaly
HP:0008438.def: A morphological abnormality of the vertebral arch, i.e., of the posterior part of a vertebra.

name: lumbar hemivertebrae
lumbar hemivertebrae
HP:0008439.def: Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the lumbar spine.

name: c1 - c2 vertebral abnormality
c1 - c2 vertebral abnormality
HP:0008440.def: Any abnormality of the atlas and the axis.

name: herniation of intervertebral nuclei
herniation of intervertebral nucleus
HP:0008441.def: The presence of one or more herniated nucleus pulposus of intervertebral disk.

name: vertebral hyperostosis
vertebral hyperostosis
HP:0008442.def: Excessive growth of the bones of the vertebral bodies.

name: neuropathic spinal arthropathy
neuropathic spinal arthropathy
HP:0008443.def: A progressive disorder of vertebral joint degeneration that occurs in the setting of any condition characterized by decreased afferent innervation, involving loss of deep pain and proprioceptive sensation in the vertebral column. Patients most commonly present with symptoms of lower back pain, sitting imbalance, progressive spinal deformity (usually kyphosis), and an audible clicking sound on changing postures.

name: posterior wedging of vertebral bodies
posterior wedging of vertebral body
HP:0008444.def: An abnormality of the shape of vertebrae, such that they are wedge-shaped (narrow towards the back).

name: cervical spinal canal stenosis
cervical spinal canal stenosis
HP:0008445.def: An abnormal narrowing of the cervical spinal canal.

name: narrow vertebral interpedicular distance
narrow vertebral interpedicular distance
HP:0008450.def: A reduction of the distance between vertebral pedicles, which are the two short, thick processes, which project backward, one on either side, from the upper part of the vertebral body, at the junction of its posterior and lateral surfaces.

name: lumbar kyphosis
lumbar kyphosis
HP:0008454.def: Over curvature of the lumbar region.

name: dysplastic sacrum
dysplastic sacrum
HP:0008455.def: A developmental defect of the sacrum characterized by partial or disordered development of the sacrum in which portions of the sacrum, which normally is formed by fusion of five sacral vertebrae S1-S5, fail to form or fail to form normally.
synonym: absence of some of the sacral and coccygeal bones
absence of some of the sacral and coccygeal bone

name: c2 - c3 subluxation
c2 - c3 subluxation
HP:0008456.def: A partial dislocation of the intervertebral joint between the second and third cervical vertebrae.

name: caudal interpedicular narrowing
caudal interpedicular narrowing
HP:0008457.def: Narrowing (becoming gradually narrower) of the distance between vertebral pedicles that gets progressively more severe towards to caudal (lower) end of the vertebral column. Note that normally, the interpedicular distances get progressively wider as one proceeds down the spine.

name: progressive congenital scoliosis
progressive congenital scoliosis
HP:0008458.def: A progressive form of scoliosis with congenital onset.

name: cervical vertebral agenesis
cervical vertebral agenesis
HP:0008459.def: Agenesis of one or more vertebrae of the cervical vertebral column.

name: absent spinous processes of lower thoracic and lumbar vertebrae
absent spinous process of low thoracic and lumbar vertebra
absent vertebra
absent vertebra
HP:0008465.def: A developmental defect characterized by agenesis of one or more vertebral bodies.

name: thoracic hemivertebrae
thoracic hemivertebrae
HP:0008467.def: Absence of one half of the vertebral body in the thoracic spine.

name: abnormal sacral segmentation
abnormal sacral segmentation
HP:0008468.def: An abnormality related to a defect of vertebral separation of sacral vertebrae during development.

name: cervical vertebral dysplasia
cervical vertebral dysplasia
HP:0008469.def: Dysplasia of the cervical vertebral column.

name: lower thoracic interpediculate narrowness
low thoracic interpediculate narrowness
HP:0008470.def: A reduction of the distance between the lower thoracic vertebral pedicles.
synonym: narrowness of interpediculate distances in lower thoracic regions
narrowness of interpediculate distance in low thoracic region

name: narrow anterio - posterior vertebral body diameter
narrow anterio - posterior vertebral body diameter
HP:0008473.def: An abnormal reduction of the anterioposterior diameter of the vertebral body.
synonym: reduced anterior - posterior diameter of vertebral bodies
reduce anterior - posterior diameter of vertebral body

name: poorly ossified cervical vertebrae
poorly ossify cervical vertebra
HP:0008477.def: Decreased ossification of the cervical vertebral bodies, i.e., of the Cervical vertebrae set.

name: cervical spondylosis
cervical spondylosis
HP:0008480.def: Arthrosis, i.e., of degenerative joint disease, affecting the cervical vertebral column.

name: cervical vertebral bodies with decreased anteroposterior diameter
cervical vertebral body with decreased anteroposterior diameter
thoracolumbar interpediculate narrowness
thoracolumbar interpediculate narrowness
HP:0008484.def: A reduction of the distance between thoracolumbar vertebral pedicles.

name: lumbar interpedicular narrowing
lumbar interpedicular narrowing
HP:0008486.def: Narrowing (becoming gradually narrower) of the distance between lumbar vertebral pedicles that gets progressively more severe towards to caudal (lower) end of the vertebral column.

name: spondylolisthesis at l5 - s1
spondylolisthesis at l5 - s1
HP:0008489.def: Complete bilateral fractures of the pars interarticularis resulting in the anterior slippage of the fifth lumbar vertebral body (L5) onto the sacrum (level S1).

name: premature anterior fontanel closure
premature anterior fontanel closure
HP:0008491.def: Early closure (ossification) of the anterior fontanelle, which generally undergoes closure around the 18th month of life.

name: inferior lens subluxation
inferior lens subluxation
HP:0008494.def: Partial displacement of the lens in the inferior direction.

name: high hypermetropia
high hypermetropia
HP:0008499.def: A severe form of hypermetropia with over +5.00 diopters.

name: median cleft lip and palate
median cleft lip and palate
HP:0008501.def: Cleft lip or palate affecting the midline region of the palate.

name: moderate sensorineural hearing impairment
moderate sensorineural hearing impairment
HP:0008504.def: The presence of a moderate form of sensorineural hearing impairment.

name: central posterior corneal opacity
central posterior corneal opacity
HP:0008511.def: Reduced transparency of the central posterior portion of the corneal stroma.

name: bilateral conductive hearing impairment
bilateral conductive hearing impairment
HP:0008513.def: A bilateral type of conductive hearing impairment.

name: abnormality of the vertebral spinous processes
abnormality of the vertebral spinous process
aplasia / hypoplasia of the sacrum
aplasia / hypoplasia of the sacrum

It typically presents as tender, pruritic red or bluish lesions located symmetrically on the dorsal aspect of the fingers, toes, ears and nose. Less commonly, reports describe involvement of the thighs and buttocks. The lesions present hours after exposure to cold and usually resolve spontaneously in one to three weeks.

name: ectopic accesory toe - like appendage
ectopic accesory toe - like appendage
HP:0010440.def: In contrast to forms of polydactyly where the supernumerary digit (this can either be a rudimentary or a completely 'normal' digit) is either located postaxial (on the fibular side of the foot, next top the little toe), preaxial (on the tibial side of the foot, next to the big toe) or mesoaxial (somewhere central, between big and little toe), a supernumerary digit may also be placed ectopically, meaning anywhere else except post-,meso- or preaxial. In the literature this is sometimes referred to as Disorganisation-like Syndrome (OMIM223200).

name: ectopic accessory finger - like appendage
ectopic accessory finger - like appendage
HP:0010441.def: In contrast to forms of polydactyly where the supernumerary digit (this can either be a rudimentary or a completely 'normal' digit) is either located postaxial (on the ulnar side of the hand, next to the little finger), preaxial (on the radial side of the hand, next to the thumb) or mesoaxial (somewhere central, between thumb and little finger), a supernumerary digit may also be placed ectopically, meaning anywhere else except post-,meso- or preaxial. In the literature this is sometimes referred to as Disorganisation-like Syndrome (OMIM223200).

name: polydactyly
polydactyly
HP:0010442.def: A congenital anomaly characterized by the presence of supernumerary fingers or toes.
synonym: more than five fingers or toes on hands or feet
more than five finger or toe on hand or foot

name: bifid femur
bifid femur
HP:0010443.def: A bifid or bifurcated appearance of the femur as seen on x-rays, possible appearing as a more or less severe bowing of the upper leg. Might be associated with hip dysplasia on the affected side.

name: pulmonary insufficiency
pulmonary insufficiency
HP:0010444.def: The retrograde (backwards) flow of blood through the pulmonary valve into the right ventricle during diastole.

name: primum atrial septal defect
primum atrial septal defect
HP:0010445.def: An ostium primum atrial septal defect is located in the most anterior and inferior aspect of the atrial septum. The ostium primum refers to an anterior and inferior opening (ostium) within the septum primum, which divides the rudimentary atrium during fetal development. The ostium primum is normally sealed by fusion of the superior and inferior endocardial cushions around 5 weeks' gestation. Ostium primum defects result from a failure of the fusion of the embryologic endocardial cushion and septum primum.

name: tricuspid stenosis
tricuspid stenosis
HP:0010446.def: A narrowing of the orifice of the tricuspid valve of the heart.

name: anal fistula
anal fistula
HP:0010447.def: An abnormal connection between the epithelialised surface of the anal canal and the perianal skin.

name: colonic atresia
colonic atresia
HP:0010448.def: A developmental defect resulting in complete obliteration of the lumen of the colon. That is, there is an abnormal closure, or atresia of the tubular structure of the colon.

name: esophageal stenosis
esophageal stenosis
HP:0010450.def: An abnormal narrowing of the lumen of the esophagus.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the spleen
aplasia / hypoplasia of the spleen
HP:0010451.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the spleen.

name: ectopia of the spleen
ectopia of the spleen
HP:0010452.def: An abnormal (non-anatomic) location of the spleen.

name: pelvic bone asymmetry
pelvic bone asymmetry
HP:0010453.def: Pelvic asymmetry refers to asymmetric positioning of landmarks on the two sides of the pelvis and may have a structural or functional etiology.

name: acetabular spurs
acetabular spur
HP:0010454.def: The presence of osteophytes (bone spurs), i.e., of bony projections originating from the acetabulum.

name: steep acetabular roof
steep acetabular roof
HP:0010455.def: An exaggeration of the normal arched form of the acetabular roof such that it takes on a steep appearance.

name: abnormal greater sciatic notch morphology
abnormal great sciatic notch morphology
HP:0010456.def: An abnormality of the sacrosciatic notch, i.e., the deep indentation in the posterior border of the hip bone at the point of union of the ilium and ischium.
synonym: abnormality of the greater sacrosciatic notch
abnormality of the great sacrosciatic notch

name: obsolete widening of the sacrosciatic notch
obsolete widening of the sacrosciatic notch
female pseudohermaphroditism
female pseudohermaphroditism
HP:0010458.def: Hermaphroditism refers to a discrepancy between the morphology of the gonads and that of the external genitalia. In female pseudohermaphroditism, the genotype is female (XX) and the gonads are ovaries, but the external genitalia are virilized.

name: true hermaphroditism
true hermaphroditism
HP:0010459.def: The presence of both ovarian and testicular tissues either in the same or in opposite gonads. Affected persons have ambiguous genitalia and may have 46,XX or 46,XY karyotypes or 46,XX/XY mosaicism.

name: abnormality of the female genitalia
abnormality of the female genitalia
HP:0010460.def: Abnormality of the female genital system.

name: abnormality of the male genitalia
abnormality of the male genitalia
HP:0010461.def: Abnormality of the male genital system.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the ovary
aplasia / hypoplasia of the ovary
HP:0010462.def: Aplasia or developmental hypoplasia of the ovary.

name: aplasia of the ovary
aplasia of the ovary
HP:0010463.def: Aplasia, that is failure to develop, of the ovary.

name: streak ovary
streak ovary
HP:0010464.def: A developmental disorder characterized by the progressive loss of primordial germ cells in the developing ovaries of an embryo, leading to hypoplastic ovaries composed of wavy connective tissue with occasional clumps of granulosa cells, and frequently mesonephric or hilar cells.

name: precocious puberty in females
precocious puberty in female
HP:0010465.def: The onset of puberty before the age of 8 years in girls.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the testes
aplasia / hypoplasia of the testis
HP:0010468.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the testes.

name: absent testis
absent testis
HP:0010469.def: Testis not palpable in the scrotum or inguinal canal.

name: supernumerary testes
supernumerary testis
HP:0010470.def: The presence of more than two testes.

name: oligosacchariduria
oligosacchariduria
HP:0010471.def: Increased urinary excretion of oligosaccharides (low molecular weight carbohydrate chains composed of at least three monosaccharide subunits), derived from a partial degradation of glycoproteins.

name: abnormal circulating porphyrin concentration
abnormal circulate porphyrin concentration
HP:0010472.def: An abnormality in the synthesis or catabolism of heme. Heme is composed of ferrous iron and protoporphyrin IX and is an essential molecule as the prosthetic group of hemeproteins such as hemoglobin, myoglobin, mitochondrial and microsomal cytochromes.

name: porphyrinuria
porphyrinuria
HP:0010473.def: Abnormally increased excretion of porphyrins in the urine.

name: bladder stones
bladder stone
HP:0010474.def: Buildups of minerals that form in the urinary bladder.

name: cloacal exstrophy
cloacal exstrophy
HP:0010475.def: Cloacal exstrophy is a severe anterior abdominal wall defect in which the two hemibladders are visible and are separated by a midline intestinal plate, an omphalocele, and an imperforate anus.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the bladder
aplasia / hypoplasia of the bladder
HP:0010476.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the urinary bladder.

name: patent urachus
patent urachus
HP:0010479.def: Persistence of the urachal canal resulting in a canal between the bladder and the umbilicus.

name: urethral fistula
urethral fistula
HP:0010480.def: The presence of an abnormal connection between the urethra and another organ or the skin.

name: urethral valve
urethral valve
HP:0010481.def: The presence of an abnormal membrane obstructing the urethra.

name: acromelia of the upper limbs
acromelia of the upper limb
HP:0010482.def: Shortening of the arms predominantly affecting terminal parts of the arm in relation to the upper and middle limb segments.

name: amniotic constriction rings of arms
amniotic constriction ring of arm
HP:0010483.def: Amniotic constriction rings affecting the arms.

name: hypertrophy of the upper limb
hypertrophy of the upper limb
HP:0010484.def: Abnormal increase in size of the upper limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells).

name: hyperextensibility at elbow
hyperextensibility at elbow
HP:0010485.def: The ability of the elbow joint to move beyond its normal range of motion.

name: abnormality of the hypothenar eminence
abnormality of the hypothenar eminence
HP:0010486.def: An abnormality of the hypothenar eminence, i.e., of the muscles on the ulnar side of the palm of the hand (i.e., on the side of the little finger).

name: small hypothenar eminence
small hypothenar eminence
HP:0010487.def: Reduced muscle mass on the ulnar side of the palm, that is, reduction in size of the hypothenar eminence.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the palmar creases
aplasia / hypoplasia of the palmar crease
HP:0010488.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the palmar creases.

name: absent palmar crease
absent palmar crease
HP:0010489.def: The absence of the major creases of the palm (distal transverse crease, proximal transverse crease, or thenar crease).

name: abnormality of the palmar creases
abnormality of the palmar crease
HP:0010490.def: An abnormality of the creases of the skin of palm of hand.

name: digital constriction ring
digital constriction ring
HP:0010491.def: A narrow segment of significantly reduced circumference of a digit.

name: osseous finger syndactyly
osseous finger syndactyly
HP:0010492.def: Webbing or fusion of the fingers, involving soft parts and including fusion of individual finger bones. Bony fusions are referred to as \"bony\

name: long metacarpals
long metacarpal
HP:0010493.def: An abnormally increased length of the metacarpal bones.

name: acromelia of the lower limbs
acromelia of the low limb
HP:0010494.def: Shortening of the legs predominantly affecting terminal parts of the leg in relation to the upper and middle arm segments.

name: amniotic constriction rings of legs
amniotic constriction ring of leg
HP:0010495.def: Amniotic constriction rings affecting the legs.

name: hypertrophy of the lower limb
hypertrophy of the low limb
HP:0010496.def: Abnormal increase in size of the lower limbs (due to an increase of the size of cells).

name: sirenomelia
sirenomelia
HP:0010497.def: A developmental defect in which the legs are fused together.

name: bipartite patella
bipartite patella
HP:0010498.def: A developmental defect that occurs if the two halves of the patella fail to fuse in early childhood.

name: patellar subluxation
patellar subluxation
HP:0010499.def: The kneecap normally is located within the groove termed trochlea on the distal femur and can slide up and down in it. Patellar subluxation refers to an unstable kneecap that does not slide centrally within its groove, i.e., a partial dislocation of the patella.

name: hyperextensibility of the knee
hyperextensibility of the knee
HP:0010500.def: The ability of the knee joint to extend beyond its normal range of motion (the lower leg is moved beyond a straight position with respect to the thigh).

name: limitation of knee mobility
limitation of knee mobility
HP:0010501.def: An abnormal limitation of knee joint mobility.

name: fibular bowing
fibular bowing
HP:0010502.def: A bending or abnormal curvature of the fibula.

name: fibular duplication
fibular duplication
HP:0010503.def: Duplication of the fibula. This may occur as a part of diplopodia (accessory tarsal or metatarsal bone). Diplopodia with double fibula is an extremely rare condition.

name: increased length of the tibia
increased length of the tibia
HP:0010504.def: An abnormal increase in the length of the tibia.

name: limitation of movement at ankles
limitation of movement at ankle
HP:0010505.def: An abnormal limitation of the mobility of the ankle joint.

name: abnormal plantar dermatoglyphics
abnormal plantar dermatoglyphic
HP:0010506.def: An abnormality of dermatoglyphs on the toes and soles, i.e., an abnormality of the patterns of ridges of the skin of sole of foot.

name: foot asymmetry
foot asymmetry
HP:0010507.def: A difference in size or shape between the left and right foot.

name: metatarsus valgus
metatarsus valgus
HP:0010508.def: A condition in which the anterior part of the foot rotates outward away from the midline of the body and the heel remains straight.

name: hypermobility of toe joints
hypermobility of toe joint
HP:0010510.def: An ability of the toe joints to move beyond their normal range of motion.

name: long toe
long toe
HP:0010511.def: Toes that appear disproportionately long compared to the foot.

name: pituitary calcification
pituitary calcification
HP:0010513.def: Deposition of calcium salts in the pituitary gland.

name: hyperpituitarism
hyperpituitarism
HP:0010514.def: Hypersecretion of one or more pituitary hormones. This can occur in conditions in which deficiency in the target organ leads to decreased hormonal feedback, or as a primary condition most usually in connection with a pituitary adenoma.

name: aplasia / hypoplasia of the thymus
aplasia / hypoplasia of the thymus
HP:0010515.def: Absence or underdevelopment of the thymus.

name: ectopic thymus tissue
ectopic thymus tissue
HP:0010517.def: The presence of ectopic thymus tissue. Normally, cells of the ventral bud of the third pharyngeal pouch detach and migrate in the eighth gestational week caudally and medially towards the location of the mature thyroid. They migrate further retrosternally into the superior mediastinum. There are two main ways ectopic thymus tissue can develop. Either cells detach along the descensus path and proliferate, thereby forming accessory thymus tissue, or the entire gland fails to descend.

name: thyroglossal cyst
thyroglossal cyst
HP:0010518.def: An abnormality of the thyroid gland owing to the presence of a fibrous cyst resulting from the persistence of the thyroglossal duct.

name: increased fetal movement
increase fetal movement
HP:0010519.def: An abnormal increase in quantity or strength of fetal movements.

name: gait apraxia
gait apraxia
HP:0010521.def: Gait apraxia affecting the ability to make walking movements with the legs.

name: dyslexia
dyslexia
HP:0010522.def: A learning disorder characterized primarily by difficulties in learning to read and spell. Dyslectic children also exhibit a tendency to read words from right to left and to confuse letters such as b and d whose orientation is important for their identification. Children with dyslexia appear to be impaired in phonemic skills (the ability to associate visual symbols with the sounds they represent).

name: alexia
alexia
HP:0010523.def: An acquired type of sensory aphasia where damage to the brain leads to the loss of the ability to read.

name: disturbed sensory perception
disturbed sensory perception
HP:0010524.def: Alteration or impairment in the processing or interpretation of sensory information can lead to abnormal perceptions or experiences.

name: finger agnosia
finger agnosia
HP:0010525.def: The examiner identified the inability to name, move, or touch specific fingers.

name: dysgraphia
dysgraphia
HP:0010526.def: A writing disability in the absence of motor or sensory deficits of the upper extremities, resulting in an impairment in the ability to write regardless of the ability to read and not due to intellectual impairment.

name: astereognosis
astereognosis
HP:0010527.def: Tactile agnosia refers to the inability to recognize objects by touch, while the inability to discriminate shape and size by touch is also a related condition.

name: prosopagnosia
prosopagnosia
HP:0010528.def: Inability to recognize faces of familiar persons.

name: echolalia
echolalia
HP:0010529.def: The repetition of words or phrases that are odd or used in a non-social manner. These can be words or phrases that the person has heard or invented.

name: palatal tremor
palatal tremor
