increase circulate free t3
HP:0011788.def: An elevated concentration of free 3,3',5-triiodo-L-thyronine in the blood circulation.

name: impaired sensitivity to thyroid stimulating hormone
impaired sensitivity to thyroid stimulate hormone
HP:0011789.def: Reduced sensitivity of thyroid follicle cells to stimulation by biologically active thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH).

name: activating thyroid - stimulating hormone receptor defect
activate thyroid - stimulate hormone receptor defect
inactivating thyroid - stimulating hormone receptor defect
inactivate thyroid - stimulate hormone receptor defect
neoplasm by histology
neoplasm by histology
HP:0011792.def: Neoplasm categorized according to type of histological abnormality.

name: neoplasm by anatomical site
neoplasm by anatomical site
HP:0011793.def: Neoplasm categorized according to the anatomical site of origin of the neoplasm.

name: embryonal renal neoplasm
embryonal renal neoplasm
HP:0011794.def: The presence of an embryonal neoplasm of the kidney that primarily affects children.

name: intralobar nephroblastomatosis
intralobar nephroblastomatosis
HP:0011795.def: Presence of persistent islands of renal blastema in the postnatal kidney, anywhere within a renal lobe (a portion of a kidney consisting of a renal pyramid and the renal cortex above it).

name: perilobar nephroblastomatosis
perilobar nephroblastomatosis
HP:0011796.def: Abnormally persistent foci of embryonal immature blastema located in the superficial cortical region (perilobar).

name: papillary renal cell carcinoma type 1
papillary renal cell carcinoma type 1
HP:0011797.def: A type of papillary renal cell carcinoma that is characterized by small cuboidal cells covering thin papillae with a single line of uniform nuclei and small nucleoli.

name: renal oncocytoma
renal oncocytoma
HP:0011798.def: A renal tumor originating from an oncocyte, which is an epithelial cell characterized by an excessive amount of mitochondria, resulting in an abundant acidophilic, granular cytoplasm.

name: midface retrusion
midface retrusion
HP:0011800.def: Posterior positions and/or vertical shortening of the infraorbital and perialar regions, or increased concavity of the face and/or reduced nasolabial angle.

name: enlargement of parotid gland
enlargement of parotid gland
HP:0011801.def: Increased size of the parotid gland.

name: hamartoma of tongue
hamartoma of tongue
HP:0011802.def: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the tongue.

name: bifid nose
bifid nose
HP:0011803.def: Visually assessable vertical indentation, cleft, or depression of the nasal bridge, ridge and tip.
synonym: indentation or clefting of the nose
indentation or clefting of the nose

name: abnormal muscle physiology
abnormal muscle physiology
HP:0011804.def: A functional abnormality of a skeletal muscle.

name: abnormal skeletal muscle morphology
abnormal skeletal muscle morphology
HP:0011805.def: A structural abnormality of a skeletal muscle.

name: type 1 muscle fiber atrophy
type 1 muscle fiber atrophy
HP:0011807.def: Atrophy (wasting) affecting primary type 1 muscle fibers. This feature in general can only be observed on muscle biopsy.

name: decreased patellar reflex
decrease patellar reflex
HP:0011808.def: Decreased intensity of the patellar reflex (also known as the knee jerk reflex).

name: paradoxical myotonia
paradoxical myotonia
HP:0011809.def: A type of myotonia that worsens with repeated muscle contractions.

name: impaired two - point discrimination
impaired two - point discrimination
HP:0011810.def: A reduced ability to distinguish tactile sensations at points that are very close to one another. This can be tested by using special calipers whose points can be set from 2mm to several centimeters apart.

name: impaired touch localization
impaired touch localization
HP:0011811.def: A reduced ability to identify precisely the site of a touch. This test is usually carried out by asking a patient, whose eyes are closed or covered, to touch the same site with a fingertip.

name: agraphesthesia
agraphesthesia
HP:0011812.def: Impaired ability to recognize letters or numbers drawn by an examiner's fingertip on the patient's skin (the patients eyes are closed or covered throughout this examination).

name: increased cerebral lipofuscin
increase cerebral lipofuscin
HP:0011813.def: Lipofuscin (age pigment) is a brown-yellow, electron-dense, autofluorescent material that accumulates progressively over time in lysosomes of postmitotic cells, such as neurons and cardiac myocytes. This term pertains if there is an increase in the accumulation of lipofuscin (also known as autofluorescent lipoprotein) more than expected for the age of the patient.

name: increased urinary hypoxanthine level
increase urinary hypoxanthine level
HP:0011814.def: The concentration of hypoxanthine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: cephalocele
cephalocele
HP:0011815.def: A congenital defect in the skull, whereby there is a protrusion of part of the cranial contents through a congenital defect in the cranium, usually covered with skin or mucous membrane. The term encephalocele refers to a subclass of these lesions in which brain tissue protrudes through the defect.

name: parietal encephalocele
parietal encephalocele
HP:0011816.def: An encephalocele located between bregma and lambda.

name: basal encephalocele
basal encephalocele
HP:0011817.def: Basal encephalocele is an encephalocele that occurs along the cribriform plate or through the sphenoid bone. The mass may appear in the nasal cavity, nasopharynx, epipharynx, sphenoid sinus, posterior orbit, or pterygopalatine fossa. The important distinction from other types is that no external tumor is visible except in those rare instances of herniations so large that they protrude through the mouth or nares.

name: submucous cleft soft palate
submucous cleft soft palate
HP:0011819.def: A cleft of the muscular (soft) portion of the palate that is covered by mucous membrane. Soft-palate submucous clefts are characterized by a midline deficiency or lack of muscle tissue.

name: membranous choanal atresia
membranous choanal atresia
HP:0011820.def: Absence of the normal opening of the choana (the posterior nasal aperture) as a result of an obstructing choanal membrane that may be thin and strandlike or thick and pluglike.

name: abnormal facial skeleton morphology
abnormal facial skeleton morphology
HP:0011821.def: An abnormality of one or more of the set of bones that make up the facial skeleton.

name: broad chin
broad chin
HP:0011822.def: Increased width of the midpoint of the mandible (mental protuberance) and overlying soft tissue.

name: chin with horizontal crease
chin with horizontal crease
HP:0011823.def: Horizontal crease or fold situated below the vermilion border of the lower lip and above the fatty pad of the chin, with the face at rest.

name: chin with h - shaped crease
chin with h - shape crease
HP:0011824.def: H-shaped crease in the fat pad of the chin.
synonym: h - shaped dimple of the chin
h - shaped dimple of the chin

name: tented philtrum
tent philtrum
HP:0011825.def: Prominence of a triangular soft tissue area of the philtrum with the apex to the columella.

name: philtrum with midline raphe
philtrum with midline raphe
HP:0011826.def: Narrow ridge in the midline of the philtral groove.

name: malaligned philtral ridges
malaligned philtral ridge
HP:0011827.def: Absence of the usual parallel position of philtral ridges.

name: midline sinus of philtrum
midline sinus of philtrum
HP:0011828.def: Pit in the midline of the philtral groove.

name: narrow philtrum
narrow philtrum
HP:0011829.def: Distance between the philtral ridges, measured just above the vermilion border, more than 2 standard deviations below the mean. Alternatively, an apparently decreased distance between the ridges of the philtrum.

name: deviated nasal tip
deviate nasal tip
HP:0011831.def: Nasal tip positioned to one side of the midline.

name: narrow nasal tip
narrow nasal tip
HP:0011832.def: Decrease in width of the nasal tip.

name: overhanging nasal tip
overhang nasal tip
HP:0011833.def: Positioning of the nasal tip inferior to the nasal base.

name: moyamoya phenomenon
moyamoya phenomenon
HP:0011834.def: A noninflammatory, progressive occlusion of the intracranial carotid arteries owing to the formation of netlike collateral arteries arising from the circle of Willis.

name: delayed talus ossification
delay talus ossification
HP:0011836.def: Delayed maturation and calcification of the talus.

name: partial iga deficiency
partial iga deficiency
HP:0011837.def: Detectable but decreased IgA levels that are more than 2 standard deviations below normal age-adjusted means.

name: sclerodactyly
sclerodactyly
HP:0011838.def: Localized thickening and tightness of the skin of the fingers or toes.

name: abnormal t cell count
abnormal t cell count
HP:0011839.def: A deviation from the normal count of T cells.

name: abnormality of t cell physiology
abnormality of t cell physiology
HP:0011840.def: A functional anomaly of T cells.

name: ventricular flutter
ventricular flutter
HP:0011841.def: A potentially lethal cardiac arrhythmia characterized by an extremely rapid, hemodynamically unstable ventricular tachycardia (150-300 beats/min) with a large oscillating sine-wave appearance.

name: abnormal skeletal morphology
abnormal skeletal morphology
HP:0011842.def: An abnormality of the form, structure, or size of the skeletal system.

name: abnormal musculoskeletal physiology
abnormal musculoskeletal physiology
HP:0011843.def: An abnormality of the function of the skeletal system.

name: abnormal appendicular skeleton morphology
abnormal appendicular skeleton morphology
HP:0011844.def: An abnormality of the appendicular skeletal system, consisting of the of the limbs, shoulder and pelvic girdles.

name: osteoblastoma
osteoblastoma
HP:0011846.def: A benign, painful, tumor of bone characterized by the formation of osteoid tissue, primitive bone and calcified tissue.

name: giant cell tumor of bone
giant cell tumor of bone
HP:0011847.def: A bone tumor composed of cellular spindle-cell stroma containing scattered multinucleated giant cells resembling osteoclasts.

name: abdominal colic
abdominal colic
HP:0011848.def: A type of abdominal pain that comes and goes in waves, most often starting and ending suddenly and being of severe intensity.

name: abnormal bone ossification
abnormal bone ossification
HP:0011849.def: Any anomaly in the formation of bone or of a bony substance, or the conversion of fibrous tissue or of cartilage into bone or a bony substance.

name: hemopericardium
hemopericardium
HP:0011851.def: Accumulation of blood within the pericardial sac.

name: chylopericardium
chylopericardium
HP:0011852.def: Accumulation of chyle (the whitish fluid taken up by the lacteals in the intestine, consisting of an emulsion of lymph and triglyceride fat thatpasses into the veins by the thoracic duct) in the pericardium. Chylopericardium is generally caused by obstruction of or trauma to the thoracic duct.

name: serous pericardial effusion
serous pericardial effusion
HP:0011853.def: Accumulation of serous fluid (pale yellow and transparent fluid) in the pericardial sac.

name: hemoperitoneum
hemoperitoneum
HP:0011854.def: Accumulation of blood in the peritoneal cavity owing to internal hemorrhage.

name: pharyngeal edema
pharyngeal edema
HP:0011855.def: Abnormal accumulation of fluid leading to swelling of the pharynx.

name: pica
pica
HP:0011856.def: An appetite for and the persistent ingestion of non-food substances such as clay. In order to diagnose pica, this behavior must have persisted over a period of at least one month.

name: plasmacytoma
plasmacytoma
HP:0011857.def: A discrete mass of neoplastic monoclonal plasma cells either in the bone marrow or in an extramedullary location.

name: reduced factor ix activity
reduce factor ix activity
HP:0011858.def: Decreased activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.

name: punctate keratitis
punctate keratitis
HP:0011859.def: A type of keratitis characterized by inflammation in pinpoint areas of the corneal epithelium.

name: metaphyseal dappling
metaphyseal dapple
HP:0011860.def: The presence of spots or rounded patches of abnormally increased density of metaphyseal bone.

name: bilateral trilobed lung
bilateral trilobed lung
HP:0011861.def: Both lungs have three lobes. Normally, the left lung has two lobes, whereas the right lung has three lobes.

name: abnormal bone collagen fibril morphology
abnormal bone collagen fibril morphology
HP:0011862.def: Any structural anomaly of the connective tissue bundles in the extracellular matrix of bone tissue that are composed of collagen, and play a role in tissue strength and elasticity.

name: abnormal sternal ossification
abnormal sternal ossification
HP:0011863.def: Any anomaly in the formation of the bony substance of the sternum.

name: elevated plasma pyrophosphate
elevate plasma pyrophosphate
HP:0011864.def: An abnormally increased diphosphate(4-) concentration in the blood. Diphosphate(4-), as ester with two phosphate groups, is also known as pyrophosphate.

name: abnormal iliac wing morphology
abnormal iliac wing morphology
HP:0011867.def: An anomaly of the ilium ala. This is the large expanded portion of the ilum which bounds the greater pelvis laterally.
synonym: abnormality of the wing of the ilium
abnormality of the wing of the ilium

name: sciatica
sciatica
HP:0011868.def: Pain in the lower back and hip radiating in the distribution of the sciatic nerve.

name: abnormal platelet function
abnormal platelet function
HP:0011869.def: Any anomaly in the function of thrombocytes.

name: impaired arachidonic acid - induced platelet aggregation
impaired arachidonic acid - induced platelet aggregation
HP:0011870.def: Abnormal response to arachidonic acid as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of arachidonic acid.

name: impaired ristocetin - induced platelet aggregation
impaired ristocetin - induced platelet aggregation
HP:0011871.def: Abnormal response to ristocetin as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of ristocetin.

name: impaired thrombin - induced platelet aggregation
impaired thrombin - induced platelet aggregation
HP:0011872.def: Abnormal response to thrombin or thrombin mimetics as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thrombin (or thrombin mimetics).

name: abnormal platelet count
abnormal platelet count
HP:0011873.def: Abnormal number of platelets per volume of blood. In a healthy adult, a normal platelet count is between 150,000 and 450,000 per microliter of blood.

name: heparin - induced thrombocytopenia
heparin - induce thrombocytopenia
HP:0011874.def: Low platelet count following administration of unfractionated or (less commonly) low-molecular weight heparin.

name: abnormal platelet morphology
abnormal platelet morphology
HP:0011875.def: An anomaly in platelet form, ultrastructure, or intracellular organelles.

name: abnormal platelet volume
abnormal platelet volume
HP:0011876.def: Anomalous size of platelets. Most normal sized platelets are 1.5 to 3 micrometers in diameter. Large platelets are 4 to 7 micrometers. Giant platelets are larger than 7 micrometers and usually 10 to 20 micrometers.

name: increased mean platelet volume
increase mean platelet volume
HP:0011877.def: Average platelet volume above the upper limit of the normal reference interval.

name: abnormal platelet membrane protein expression
abnormal platelet membrane protein expression
HP:0011878.def: Presence of reduced amount of a membrane protein on the cell membrane of platelets. This feature is typically measured by flow cytometry.

name: decreased platelet glycoprotein ib - ix - v
decrease platelet glycoprotein ib - ix - v
HP:0011879.def: Decreased cell membrane concentration of the glycoprotein complex Ib-IX-V.

name: acute disseminated intravascular coagulation
acute disseminate intravascular coagulation
HP:0011880.def: An acute form of disseminated intravascular coagulation. Acute DIC can occur following sudden exposure of blood to procoagulants, with the compensatory hemostatic mechanisms becoming overwhelmed.

name: decreased platelet glycoprotein vi
decrease platelet glycoprotein vi
HP:0011881.def: Decreased cell membrane concentration of glycoprotein VI.

name: decreased platelet p2y12 receptor
decrease platelet p2y12 receptor
HP:0011882.def: Decreased cell membrane concentration of P2Y12 receptor.

name: abnormal platelet granules
abnormal platelet granule
HP:0011883.def: An anomaly of alpha or dense granules or platelet lysosomes.

name: abnormal umbilical stump bleeding
abnormal umbilical stump bleeding
HP:0011884.def: Abnormal bleeding of the umbilical stump following separation of the cord at approximately 7-10 days after birth.

name: hemorrhage of the eye
hemorrhage of the eye
HP:0011885.def: Bleeding from vessels of the various tissues of the eye.

name: hyphema
hyphema
HP:0011886.def: Bleeding in the anterior chamber of the eye.

name: choroid hemorrhage
choroid hemorrhage
HP:0011887.def: Hemorrhage from the vessels of the choroid.

name: bleeding requiring red cell transfusion
bleed require red cell transfusion
HP:0011888.def: Bleeding sufficiently severe as to require red cell transfusion (WHO Grade 3 or 4).

name: bleeding with minor or no trauma
bleed with minor or no trauma
HP:0011889.def: Significant bleeding or hemorrhage without significant precipitating factor.
synonym: bleeding with minor or no trauma
bleed with minor or no trauma

name: prolonged bleeding following procedure
prolonged bleeding following procedure
HP:0011890.def: Prolonged or protracted bleeding following an invasive procedure or intervention.

name: post - partum hemorrhage
post - partum hemorrhage
HP:0011891.def: Significant maternal haemorrhage/blood loss following deilvery of a child.

name: low levels of vitamin k
low level of vitamin k
HP:0011892.def: A reduced concentration of vitamin K.

name: abnormal leukocyte count
abnormal leukocyte count
HP:0011893.def: Number of leukocytes per volume of blood beyond normal limits.

name: impaired thromboxane a2 agonist - induced platelet aggregation
impaired thromboxane a2 agonist - induced platelet aggregation
HP:0011894.def: Abnormal response to thromboxane as manifested by reduced or lacking aggregation of platelets upon addition of thromboxane A2 receptor agonists.

name: anemia due to reduced life span of red cells
anemia due to reduced life span of red cell
HP:0011895.def: A type of anemia related to a reduction in the average life span of red blood cells in the peripheral circulation, which is normally around 120 days.
synonym: anaemia due to reduced life span of red cells
anaemia due to reduced life span of red cell

name: subconjunctival hemorrhage
subconjunctival hemorrhage
HP:0011896.def: Bleeding beneath the mucous membrane that lines the inner surface of the eyelid.

name: neutrophilia
neutrophilia
HP:0011897.def: Increased number of neutrophils circulating in blood.

name: abnormality of circulating fibrinogen
abnormality of circulate fibrinogen
HP:0011898.def: An abnormality of the level of activity of circulating fibrinogen.

name: hyperfibrinogenemia
hyperfibrinogenemia
HP:0011899.def: Increased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood.

name: hypofibrinogenemia
hypofibrinogenemia
HP:0011900.def: Decreased concentration of fibrinogen in the blood.

name: abnormal hemoglobin
abnormal hemoglobin
HP:0011902.def: Anomaly in the level or the function of hemoglobin, the oxygen-carrying protein of erythrocytes.

name: hbh hemoglobin
hbh hemoglobin
HP:0011903.def: Hemoglobin H (HbH) contains four beta-globin chains. It is normally not present at all in blood, but may make up about 1-40 percent of all hemoglobin in HbH disease, a subform of alpha thalassemia.

name: persistence of hemoglobin f
persistence of hemoglobin f
HP:0011904.def: Hemoglobin F (HbF) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin gamma chains. It is the main form of hemoglobin in the fetus during the last seven months of intrauterine development and in the half year of postnatal life. In adults it normally makes up less than one percent of all hemoglobin. This term refers to an increase in HbF above this limit. In beta thalassemia major, it may represent over 90 percent of all hemoglobin, and in beta thalassemia minor it may make up between 0.5 to 4 percent.

name: reduced hemoglobin a
reduce hemoglobin a
HP:0011905.def: Hemoglobin A (HbA) contains two globin alpha chains and two globin beta chains. HbA is normally the main adult hemoglobin, representing about 96-98 percent of all hemoglobin. This term represents a decreased in the proportion of HbA below this limit, and can be seen in various forms of thalassemia.

name: reduced beta / alpha synthesis ratio
reduce beta / alpha synthesis ratio
HP:0011906.def: A reduction in the ratio of production of beta globin to that of alpha globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of beta thalassemia.

name: reduced alpha / beta synthesis ratio
reduce alpha / beta synthesis ratio
HP:0011907.def: A reduction in the ratio of production of alpha globin to that of beta globin. This is the major abnormality in the various forms of alpha thalassemia.

name: unilateral radial aplasia
unilateral radial aplasia
HP:0011908.def: Missing radius bone on one side only associated with congenital failure of development.

name: flattened metacarpal heads
flatten metacarpal head
HP:0011909.def: Abnormally flat shape of the heads of the metacarpal bones.
synonym: flattened head of long bone of hand
flatten head of long bone of hand

name: shortening of all phalanges of fingers
shortening of all phalanx of finger
HP:0011910.def: Abnormal reduction in length affecting all phalanges.

name: abnormal metacarpophalangeal joint morphology
abnormal metacarpophalangeal joint morphology
HP:0011911.def: An anomaly of a metacarpophalangeal joint.

name: abnormality of the glenoid fossa
abnormality of the glenoid fossa
HP:0011912.def: An anomaly of the glenoid fossa, also known as the glenoid cavity, which is the articular surface of the scapula that articulates with the head of the humerus.

name: lumbar hypertrichosis
lumbar hypertrichosis
HP:0011913.def: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the lumbar region.

name: thoracic hypertrichosis
thoracic hypertrichosis
HP:0011914.def: Excessive, increased hair growth located in the thoracic region.

name: cardiovascular calcification
cardiovascular calcification
HP:0011915.def: Abnormal calcification in the cardiovascular system.

name: toe extensor amyotrophy
toe extensor amyotrophy
HP:0011916.def: Atrophy of the extensor digitorum longus muscles, which mediate extension of the toes.

name: clinodactyly of the 4th toe
clinodactyly of the 4th toe
HP:0011918.def: Bending or curvature of a fourth toe in the tibial direction (i.e., towards the big toe).

name: pleural empyema
pleural empyema
HP:0011919.def: Accumulation of pus in the pleural cavity.

name: transudative pleural effusion
transudative pleural effusion
HP:0011920.def: A type of pleural effusion with a transudate (extravascular fluid with low protein content and a low specific gravity). Pleural effusions can be classified as transudates or exudates based on Light's criteria, which classify an effusion as exudate if one or more of the following are present: (1) the ratio of pleural fluid protein to serum protein is greater than 0.5, (2) the ratio of pleural fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to serum LDH is greater than 0.6, or (3) the pleural fluid LDH level is greater than two thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH.

name: exudative pleural effusion
exudative pleural effusion
HP:0011921.def: A type of pleural effusion with a exudate (extravascular fluid that has exuded out of a tissue or its capillaries due to injury or inflammation). Pleural effusions can be classified as transudates or exudates based on Light's criteria, which classify an effusion as exudate if one or more of the following are present: (1) the ratio of pleural fluid protein to serum protein is greater than 0.5, (2) the ratio of pleural fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) to serum LDH is greater than 0.6, or (3) the pleural fluid LDH level is greater than two thirds of the upper limit of normal for serum LDH.

name: abnormal activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
abnormal activity of mitochondrial respiratory chain
HP:0011922.def: An increased or decreased activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain.

name: decreased activity of mitochondrial complex i
decreased activity of mitochondrial complex i
HP:0011923.def: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex I, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

name: decreased activity of mitochondrial complex iii
decreased activity of mitochondrial complex iii
HP:0011924.def: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III, which is part of the electron transport chain in mitochondria.

name: decreased activity of mitochondrial atp synthase complex
decreased activity of mitochondrial atp synthase complex
HP:0011925.def: A reduction in the activity of the mitochondrial proton-transporting ATP synthase complex, which makes ATP via oxidative phosphorylation, and is sometimes described as Complex V of the electron transport chain.
synonym: decreased activity of mitochondrial complex v
decreased activity of mitochondrial complex v

name: proximal placement of hallux
proximal placement of hallux
HP:0011926.def: Proximal mislocalization of the big toe from its normal position.

name: short digit
short digit
HP:0011927.def: One or more digit that appears disproportionately short compared to the hand/foot, whereby either the entire digit or a specific phalanx is shortened.

name: short proximal phalanx of toe
short proximal phalanx of toe
HP:0011928.def: Developmental hypoplasia (shortening) of proximal phalanx of toe.

name: hypersegmentation of proximal phalanx of third finger
hypersegmentation of proximal phalanx of third finger
HP:0011929.def: Presence of an additional phalanx-like bone, producing an extra, wedge-shaped bone at the base of the proximal phalanx of the third finger.

name: abnormal cerebellar peduncle morphology
abnormal cerebellar peduncle morphology
HP:0011931.def: An anomaly of the cerebellar peduncles. The superior, middle, and inferior cerebellar peduncles emerge from the cerebellum. The superior cerebellar penduncles connect the cerebellum to the midbrain, the middle cerebellar peduncles connect the cerebellum to the pons, and the inferior cerebellar peduncle connects the medulla spinalis and medulla oblongata with the cerebellum.

name: abnormal superior cerebellar peduncle morphology
abnormal superior cerebellar peduncle morphology
HP:0011932.def: An anomaly of the superior cerebellar peduncle.
synonym: abnormality of the superior cerebellar peduncle
abnormality of the superior cerebellar peduncle

name: elongated superior cerebellar peduncle
elongate superior cerebellar peduncle
HP:0011933.def: Increased length of the superior cerebellar peduncle.

name: dilatation of mesenteric artery
dilatation of mesenteric artery
HP:0011934.def: Abnormal outpouching or sac-like dilatation in the wall of the inferior mesenteric artery or superior mesenteric artery .

name: decreased urinary urate
decrease urinary urate
HP:0011935.def: Decreased concentration of urate in the urine.

name: decreased plasma total carnitine
decrease plasma total carnitine
HP:0011936.def: A decreased concentration of total carnitine in the blood.

name: hypoplastic fifth toenail
hypoplastic fifth toenail
HP:0011937.def: Underdeveloped nails of the fifth toes.

name: 3 - 4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
3 - 4 finger cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0011939.def: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between fingers 3 and 4.

name: anterior wedging of t12
anterior wedging of t12
HP:0011940.def: An abnormality of the shape of the thoracic vertebra T12 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).
synonym: anterior wedging of the 12th thoracic vertebra
anterior wedging of the 12th thoracic vertebra

name: anterior wedging of l2
anterior wedging of l2
HP:0011941.def: An abnormality of the shape of the lumbar vertebra L2 such that it is wedge-shaped (narrow towards the front).

name: increased urinary sulfite level
increase urinary sulfite level
HP:0011942.def: The concentration of SO3(2-), i.e., sulfite, in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: increased urinary thiosulfate
increase urinary thiosulfate
HP:0011943.def: Increased concentration of thiosulfate(2-) in the urine.

name: small vessel vasculitis
small vessel vasculitis
HP:0011944.def: A type of vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessel walls) that affects blood vessels that are smaller than arteries, i.e., arterioles, venules, and capilllaries.

name: bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia
bronchiolitis obliterans organize pneumonia
HP:0011945.def: Bronchiolitis obliterans organizing pneumonia (BOOP) is and interstitial lung abnormalitiy characterized histopathologically by plugs of granulation tissue lying within small airways, alveolar ducts, and alveoli and by chronic inflammatory cell infiltration in alveolar walls. Patients with BOOP generally present with subacute illness, including shortness of breath, fever, malaise, and weight loss.

name: bronchiolitis obliterans
bronchiolitis obliterans
HP:0011946.def: Inflammation and fibrosis of the bronchioles leading to partial or complete obstruction of these airways.

name: respiratory tract infection
respiratory tract infection
HP:0011947.def: An infection of the upper or lower respiratory tract.

name: recurrent acute respiratory tract infection
recurrent acute respiratory tract infection
HP:0011948.def: A history of repeated acute infections of the upper or lower respiratory tract.

name: acute infectious pneumonia
acute infectious pneumonia
HP:0011949.def: Acute inflammation of the lung due to an infection.

name: aspiration pneumonia
aspiration pneumonia
HP:0011951.def: Pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.

name: acute aspiration pneumonia
acute aspiration pneumonia
HP:0011952.def: An acute episode of pneumonia due to the aspiration (breathing in) of food, liquid, or gastric contents into the upper respiratory tract.

name: nodular regenerative hyperplasia of liver
nodular regenerative hyperplasia of liver
HP:0011954.def: Diffuse benign transformation of the hepatic parenchyma into small regenerative nodules with minimal or no fibrosis.

name: hepatic granulomatosis
hepatic granulomatosis
HP:0011955.def: The presence of multiple granulomas in the liver as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

name: intestinal lymphoid nodular hyperplasia
intestinal lymphoid nodular hyperplasia
HP:0011956.def: A lymphoproliferative abnormality of the intestine characterized by numerous visible mucosal nodules measuring up to, and rarely exceeding, 0.5 cm in diameter Histologically, hyperplastic lymphoid follicles with large germinal centres are seen in the lamina propria and superficial submucosa. There is enlargement of the mucosal B cell follicles caused by hyperplasia of the follicle centres; surrounded by a normal appearing mantle zone. Disease may involve the stomach, the entire small intestine, and the large intestine.

name: abnormal pectoral muscle morphology
abnormal pectoral muscle morphology
HP:0011957.def: An abnormality of the pectoral muscle, comprising the pectoralis major, a thick, fan-shaped muscle of the anterior chest and the pectoralis minor, a thin, triangular muscle situated underneath the pectoralis major.

name: retinal perforation
retinal perforation
HP:0011958.def: A small hole through the whole thickness of the retina.

name: unilateral hypoplasia of pectoralis major muscle
unilateral hypoplasia of pectoralis major muscle
HP:0011959.def: Hypoplasia (underdevelopment) of the pectoralis minor on only one side of the chest.
synonym: small pec muscle on one side
small pec muscle on one side
underdeveloped pec muscle on one side
underdeveloped pec muscle on one side

name: substantia nigra gliosis
substantia nigra gliosis
HP:0011960.def: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the substantia nigra.

name: non - obstructive azoospermia
non - obstructive azoospermia
HP:0011961.def: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, resulting from a defect in the production of spermatozoa in the testes. This can be differentiated from obstructive azoospermia on the basis of testicular biopsy.

name: obstructive azoospermia
obstructive azoospermia
HP:0011962.def: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, resulting from post-testicular obstruction or retrograde ejaculation. This can be differentiated from obstructive azoospermia on the basis of testicular biopsy.

name: pretesticular azoospermia
pretesticular azoospermia
HP:0011963.def: Absence of any measurable level of sperm in his semen, due to a hypothalamic or pituitary abnormality diagnosed with hypo-gonadotropic-hypogonadism. The diagnosis is made on the basis of low LH and FSH levels and low or normal testosterone levels.

name: intermittent painful muscle spasms
intermittent painful muscle spasm
HP:0011964.def: History of repeated intermittent involuntary muscle contractions that were painful.

name: abnormal circulating citrulline concentration
abnormal circulate citrulline concentration
HP:0011965.def: Any deviation from the normal concentration of citrulline in the blood circulation.

name: elevated plasma citrulline
elevate plasma citrulline
HP:0011966.def: An increased concentration of citrulline in the blood.

name: decreased circulating copper concentration
decrease circulate copper concentration
HP:0011967.def: A reduced concentration of copper in the blood.

name: feeding difficulties
feed difficulty
HP:0011968.def: Impaired ability to eat related to problems gathering food and getting ready to suck, chew, or swallow it.

name: elevated circulating luteinizing hormone level
elevate circulate luteinizing hormone level
HP:0011969.def: An elevated concentration of luteinizing hormone in the blood.

name: cerebral amyloid angiopathy
cerebral amyloid angiopathy
HP:0011970.def: Amyloid deposition in the walls of leptomeningeal and cortical arteries, arterioles, and less often capillaries and veins of the central nervous system.

name: dermatographic urticaria
dermatographic urticaria
HP:0011971.def: An exaggerated whealing tendency when the skin is stroked, that is, formation of red, itchy bumps and lines on the skin as a result of pressure on the skin (for instance, stroking the skin with a pen or tongue depressor).

name: hypoglycorrhachia
hypoglycorrhachia
HP:0011972.def: Abnormally low glucose concentration in the cerebrospinal fluid.
synonym: low glucose levels in cerebral spinal fluid
low glucose level in cerebral spinal fluid

name: paroxysmal lethargy
paroxysmal lethargy
HP:0011973.def: Repeated episodes of sudden-onset and transient lethargy.

name: myelofibrosis
myelofibrosis
HP:0011974.def: Replacement of bone marrow by fibrous tissue.

name: aminoglycoside - induced hearing loss
aminoglycoside - induced hearing loss
HP:0011975.def: Partial or complete loss of hearing following ingestion of aminoglycoside antibiotics.

name: elevated urinary catecholamine level
elevate urinary catecholamine level
HP:0011976.def: The concentration of a catecholamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated urinary homovanillic acid
elevate urinary homovanillic acid
HP:0011977.def: An increased concentration of homovanillic acid in the urine.

name: elevated urinary vanillylmandelic acid
elevate urinary vanillylmandelic acid
HP:0011978.def: An increased concentration of vanillylmandelic acid in the urine.

name: elevated urinary dopamine level
elevate urinary dopamine level
HP:0011979.def: The concentration of dopamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: cholesterol gallstones
cholesterol gallstone
HP:0011980.def: Gallstones composed primarily of cholesterol, usually about 2-3 cm in length with an oval form and a yellow or green/brown color.

name: pigment gallstones
pigment gallstone
HP:0011981.def: Gallstones composed primarily of bilirubin and calcium salts (calcium bilirubinate) with a low cholesterol concentration.

name: black pigment gallstones
black pigment gallstone
HP:0011982.def: A type of pigment gallstone that is hard and black, containing calcium carbonate and calcium phosphates.

name: brown pigment gallstones
brown pigment gallstone
HP:0011983.def: A type of pigment gallstone that is brown, containing calcium fatty acids. These stones are softer than black pigment gallstones.

name: atretic gallbladder
atretic gallbladder
HP:0011984.def: Failure of formation of the lumen of the gallbladder, often associated with gallbladder hypoplasia.

name: acholic stools
acholic stool
HP:0011985.def: Clay colored stools lacking bile pigment.

name: ectopic ossification
ectopic ossification
HP:0011986.def: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue, i.e., the presence of bone in soft tissue where bone normally does not exist.

name: ectopic ossification in muscle tissue
ectopic ossification in muscle tissue
HP:0011987.def: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within muscle tissue.

name: ectopic ossification in tendon tissue
ectopic ossification in tendon tissue
HP:0011988.def: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within tendon tissue.

name: ectopic ossification in ligament tissue
ectopic ossification in ligament tissue
HP:0011989.def: Formation of abnormal bony tissue within ligament tissue.

name: abnormal neutrophil count
abnormal neutrophil count
HP:0011991.def: A deviation from the normal range of neutrophil cell counts in the circulation.

name: abnormal neutrophil morphology
abnormal neutrophil morphology
HP:0011992.def: An abnormal form or size of neutrophils.

name: impaired neutrophil bactericidal activity
impaired neutrophil bactericidal activity
HP:0011993.def: A reduction in the ability of neutrophils to kill bacteria.

name: abnormal atrial septum morphology
abnormal atrial septum morphology
HP:0011994.def: An abnormality of the interatrial septum.

name: atrial septal dilatation
atrial septal dilatation
HP:0011995.def: A bulging of the interatrial septum towards one side. In adults, atrial septal aneurysm can be defined as a protrusion of the aneurysm of >10 mm beyond the plane of the atrial septum as measured by transesophageal echocardiography.

name: elevated coagulation factor v activity
elevate coagulation factor v activity
HP:0011996.def: Increased activity of coagulation factor V, Factor V, which is activated to factor Va by means of minute amounts of thrombin (and inactivated by larger amounts of thrombin). Activated factor V (fVa) is a cofactor in the formation of the prothrombinase complex.

name: postprandial hyperlactemia
postprandial hyperlactemia
HP:0011997.def: Abnormally increased level of blood lactate following a meal.

name: postprandial hyperglycemia
postprandial hyperglycemia
HP:0011998.def: An increased concentration of glucose in the blood following a meal.

name: paranoia
paranoia
HP:0011999.def: An inappropriate feeling of being persecuted or being the subject of hostility from others.

name: eeg with generalized spikes
eeg with generalized spike
HP:0012000.def: EEG with generalized sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.

name: eeg with generalized polyspikes
eeg with generalized polyspikes
HP:0012001.def: EEG with repetitive generalized sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec.

name: experiential epileptic aura
experiential epileptic aura
HP:0012002.def: Affective, mnemonic or composite perceptual auras with subjective qualities similar to those experienced in life but are recognized by the subject as occurring outside of actual context.

name: affective epileptic aura
affective epileptic aura
HP:0012003.def: Affective auras with subjective qualities similar to those experienced in life but are recognized by the subject as occurring outside of actual context.

name: focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
HP:0012004.def: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by memory phenomena such as feelings of familiarity (deja vu) and unfamiliarity (jamais vu) as the initial semiological manifestation.

name: deja vu aura
deja vu aura
HP:0012005.def: A subjective feeling that an experience which is occurring for the first time has been experienced before.

name: jamais vu aura
jamais vu aura
HP:0012006.def: A subjective feeling that an experience which has occurred before is being experienced for the first time.

name: focal cognitive seizure with hallucination
focal cognitive seizure with hallucination
HP:0012007.def: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by hallucination as the initial semiological manifestation.

name: focal cognitive seizure with illusion
focal cognitive seizure with illusion
HP:0012008.def: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by an alteration of actual perception involving visual, auditory, somatosensory, olfactory, and/or gustatory phenomena as the initial semiological manifestation.

name: eeg with central focal spike waves
eeg with central focal spike wave
HP:0012009.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the central region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

name: eeg with frontal focal spike waves
eeg with frontal focal spike wave
HP:0012010.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the frontal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

name: eeg with occipital focal spike waves
eeg with occipital focal spike wave
HP:0012011.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the occipital region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

name: eeg with parietal focal spike waves
eeg with parietal focal spike wave
HP:0012012.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the parietal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

name: eeg with temporal focal spike waves
eeg with temporal focal spike wave
HP:0012013.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the temporal region, i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

name: eeg with central focal spikes
eeg with central focal spike
HP:0012014.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the central region.

name: eeg with frontal focal spikes
eeg with frontal focal spike
HP:0012015.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the frontal region.

name: eeg with occipital focal spikes
eeg with occipital focal spike
HP:0012016.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the occipital region.

name: eeg with parietal focal spikes
eeg with parietal focal spike
HP:0012017.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the parietal region.

name: eeg with temporal focal spikes
eeg with temporal focal spike
HP:0012018.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves of a duration less than 80 msec in the temporal region.

name: lens luxation
lens luxation
HP:0012019.def: Complete dislocation of the lens of the eye.

name: right aortic arch
right aortic arch
HP:0012020.def: Aorta descends on right instead of on the left.

name: persistent patent ductus venosus
persistent patent ductus venosus
HP:0012021.def: Persistence of blood flow through the ductus venosus for longer than the normal time after birth.

name: congenital portosystemic venous shunt
congenital portosystemic venous shunt
HP:0012022.def: A congenital defect of the vasculature such that there is a shunt (by-pass) of blood directly from the portal vein to the vena cava (i.e., the blood from the portal vein is not filtered through the liver).

name: galactosuria
galactosuria
HP:0012023.def: Elevated concentration of galactose in the urine.

name: hypergalactosemia
hypergalactosemia
HP:0012024.def: Elevated concentration of galactose in the blood.

name: abnormal circulating ornithine concentration
abnormal circulate ornithine concentration
HP:0012025.def: Deviation from the normal concentration of ornithine in the blood circulation.

name: hyperornithinemia
hyperornithinemia
HP:0012026.def: Increased concentration of ornithine in the blood.

name: laryngeal edema
laryngeal edema
HP:0012027.def: An abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling in the tissues of the larynx.

name: hepatocellular adenoma
hepatocellular adenoma
HP:0012028.def: A benign tumor of the liver of presumably epithelial origin.

name: abnormal urine hormone level
abnormal urine hormone level
HP:0012029.def: An abnormal concentration of a hormone in the urine.

name: increased urinary cortisol level
increase urinary cortisol level
HP:0012030.def: Abnormally increased concentration of cortisol in the urine.

name: lipoma
lipoma
HP:0012032.def: Benign neoplasia derived from lipoblasts or lipocytes of white or brown fat. May be angiomatous or hibernomatous.

name: sacral lipoma
sacral lipoma
HP:0012033.def: Presence of a lipoma in the region of the sacrum.

name: liposarcoma
liposarcoma
HP:0012034.def: Malignant neoplasms which probably originate in primitive mesenchymal stem cell populations differentiating down a lipomatous pathway.

name: steatocystoma multiplex
steatocystoma multiplex
HP:0012035.def: Multiple, localized or widespread, asymptomatic or inflammatory dermal cysts involving the pilosebaceous units. Lesions can appear anywhere on the body, but steatocystoma multiplex is more commonly involved with those areas of the skin with a high density of developed pilosebaceous units (e.g., the axilla, groin, neck, and proximal extremities).

name: sternocleidomastoid amyotrophy
sternocleidomastoid amyotrophy
HP:0012036.def: Wasting of the sternocleidomastoid muscle, the muscle in the anterior part of the neck that acts to flex and rotate the head.

name: pectoralis amyotrophy
pectoralis amyotrophy
HP:0012037.def: Wasting of the pectoral muscles, i.e., of the pectoralis major and pectoralis minor.

name: corneal guttata
corneal guttata
HP:0012038.def: Corneal guttata are droplet-like accumulations of non-banded collagen on the posterior surface of Descemet's membrane. The presence of focal thickenings of Descemet's membrane histologically named guttae. Cornea guttata can be easily diagnosed in vivo and ex vivo by means of specular microscopy as it gives dark areas where no endothelial cells are visible.

name: descemet membrane folds
descemet membrane fold
HP:0012039.def: Presence of folds in the Descemet membrane, which is the basement membrane of the endothelial (inner) cell layer of the cornea. Descemet membrane folds are generally a manifestation of inflammation or edema of the cornea.

name: corneal stromal edema
corneal stromal edema
HP:0012040.def: Abnormal accumulation of fluid and swelling of the stroma of cornea.

name: aspirin - induced asthma
aspirin - induced asthma
HP:0012042.def: A type of asthma in which aspirin and other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) that inhibit cyclooxygen-ase 1 (COX-1) exacerbate bronchoconstriction.

name: pendular nystagmus
pendular nystagmus
HP:0012043.def: Rhythmic, involuntary sinusoidal oscillations of one or both eyes. The waveform of pendular nystagmus may occur in any direction.

name: seesaw nystagmus
seesaw nystagmus
HP:0012044.def: Seesaw nystagmus is a type of pendular nystagmus where a half cycle consists of the elevation and intorsion of one eye, concurrently with the depression and extortion of the fellow eye. In the other half cycle, there is an inversion of the ocular movements.

name: retinal flecks
retinal fleck
HP:0012045.def: Presence of multiple yellowish-white lesions of various size and configuration on the retina not related to vascular lesions.

name: areflexia of upper limbs
areflexia of upper limb
HP:0012046.def: Inability to elicit tendon reflexes in the upper limbs.

name: hemeralopia
hemeralopia
HP:0012047.def: A visual defect characterized by the inability to see as clearly in bright light as in dim light. The word hemeralopia literally means day blindness.

name: oromandibular dystonia
oromandibular dystonia
HP:0012048.def: A kind of focal dystonia characterized by forceful contractions of the face, jaw, and/or tongue causing difficulty in opening and closing the mouth and often affecting chewing and speech.

name: laryngeal dystonia
laryngeal dystonia
HP:0012049.def: A form of focal dystonia that affects the vocal cords, associated with involuntary contractions of the vocal cords causing interruptions of speech and affecting the voice quality and often leading to patterned, repeated breaks in speech.

name: anasarca
anasarca
HP:0012050.def: An extreme form of generalized edema with widespread and massive edema due to effusion of fluid into the extracellular space.

name: reactive hypoglycemia
reactive hypoglycemia
HP:0012051.def: Hypoglycermia following a meal (or more generally, after intake of glucose).
synonym: low blood sugar after a meal
low blood sugar after a meal

name: low serum calcitriol
low serum calcitriol
HP:0012052.def: A reduced concentration of calcitriol in the blood. Calcitriol is also known as 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol or 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3.

name: decreased circulating calcifediol concentration
decrease circulate calcifediol concentration
HP:0012053.def: A reduced concentration of calcifediol in the blood. Calcifediol is also known as calcidiol, 25-hydroxycholecalciferol and 25-Hydroxyvitamin D3.

name: choroidal melanoma
choroidal melanoma
HP:0012054.def: Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the choroid. The classic appearance of choroidal melanoma is a pigmented dome-shaped or collar button-shaped tumor with an associated exudative retinal detachment. Choroidal melanoma is usually pigmented, but can be variably pigmented and even amelanotic (non-pigmented).

name: ciliary body melanoma
ciliary body melanoma
HP:0012055.def: Malignant tumor of melanocytes of the ciliary body.

name: cutaneous melanoma
cutaneous melanoma
HP:0012056.def: The presence of a melanoma of the skin.

name: superficial spreading melanoma
superficial spreading melanoma
HP:0012057.def: A type of melanoma that is flat and irregular in shape and color, with different shades of black and brown.

name: nodular melanoma
nodular melanoma
HP:0012058.def: A type of melanoma that starts as a raised area that is usually dark blackish-blue or bluish-red but may not have any color.

name: lentigo maligna melanoma
lentigo maligna melanoma
HP:0012059.def: A subtype of melanoma in situ that typically develops on sun-damaged skin. The lesion is typically a large, irregularly pigmented macule that has developed from an ordinary lentigo (a small pigmented spot on the skin with a clearly-defined edge). Change to a malignant lentigo typically takes place over 20 years or more, and many patients accept the change as a consequence of aging.

name: acral lentiginous melanoma
acral lentiginous melanoma
HP:0012060.def: A type of cutaneous melanoma localized to the palm, sole, or beneath the nail (subungual melanoma). Acral lentiginous melanoma starts as a slowly-enlarging flat patch of discoloured skin and usually displays a size above 6 mm and often several centimetres or more in diameter upon diagnosis and variable pigmentation with a mixutre of colors including brown, and blue-grey, black and red. The surface of the lesion is initially smooth but later in the course may become thicker and irregular, and may ulcerate or bleed.

name: urinary excretion of sialylated oligosaccharides
urinary excretion of sialylated oligosaccharide
HP:0012061.def: Excretion of oligosaccharides conjugated to sialic acid in the urine.

name: bone cyst
bone cyst
HP:0012062.def: A fluid filled cavity that develops with a bone.

name: aneurysmal bone cyst
aneurysmal bone cyst
HP:0012063.def: Radiographic features include a dilated, radiolucent lesion typically located eccentrically within the metaphyseal portion of the bone, with fluid levels visible on magnetic resonance imaging.

name: unicameral bone cyst
unicameral bone cyst
HP:0012064.def: A benign fluid filled simple cyst of bone filled with serous fluid.

name: multiple bony cystic lesions
multiple bony cystic lesion
HP:0012065.def: Presence of multiple cystic changes in multiple areas or multiple bones.

name: increased urinary disaccharide excretion
increase urinary disaccharide excretion
HP:0012066.def: Increased concentration of disaccharide in the urine.

name: glycopeptiduria
glycopeptiduria
HP:0012067.def: Increased excretion of glycopeptides in the urine. Glycopeptides are peptides with carbohydrate moieties covalently attached to the side chains of the amino acid residues.

name: aspartylglucosaminuria
aspartylglucosaminuria
HP:0012068.def: Excretion of excess amounts of aspartylglucosamine in the urine.

name: keratan sulfate excretion in urine
keratan sulfate excretion in urine
HP:0012069.def: An increased concentration of keratan sulfate in the urine.

name: chondroitin sulfate excretion in urine
chondroitin sulfate excretion in urine
HP:0012070.def: An increased concentration of chondroitin sulfate (CHEBI:37397) in the urine.

name: abnormal circulating acylcarnitine concentration
abnormal circulate acylcarnitine concentration
HP:0012071.def: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an acylcarnitine, which is produced by reversible esterification of the 3-hydroxyl group of carnitine.

name: aciduria
aciduria
HP:0012072.def: Excretion of urine with an acid pH, i.e., having an increased hydrogen ion concentration.

name: abnormal urinary acylglycine profile
abnormal urinary acylglycine profile
HP:0012073.def: An abnormal distribution of N-acylglycines in the urine. There are numerous different N-acylglycines, and this term refers to pathological alterations in their level or distribution.

name: tonic pupil
tonic pupil
HP:0012074.def: An abnormality of the pupillary light reaction characterized by a marked slowing of the light reaction of usually just one pupil. The pupil tends to be relatively dilated, and there is reduced accommodation.

name: personality disorder
personality disorder
HP:0012075.def: A personality disorder is a deeply ingrained pattern of behavior of a specified kind that deviates markedly from the norms of generally accepted behavior. It is typically apparent by the time of adolescence and causes long-term difficulties in personal relationships or functioning in society.

name: borderline personality disorder
borderline personality disorder
HP:0012076.def: A personality disorder characterized by impulsive behavior and unpredictable, capricious mood. Affected individuals show a tendency to have outbursts of emotion and an inability to control these behavioral explosions. They generally experience an intense fear of abandonment or instability and also struggle with feelings of emptiness.
xref: ICD-10:F60.3 "Emotionally unstable personality disorder, borderline type"

name: histrionic personality disorder
histrionic personality disorder
HP:0012077.def: A personality disorder characterized by shallow and labile affectivity, self-dramatization, theatricality, exaggerated expression of emotions, suggestibility, egocentricity, self-indulgence, lack of consideration for others, easily hurt feelings, and continuous seeking for appreciation, excitement and attention.

name: motor conduction block
motor conduction block
HP:0012078.def: Blockade of impulses at a focal site along the course of a motor axon.

name: abnormality of central motor conduction
abnormality of central motor conduction
HP:0012079.def: Any anomaly of the conduction of motor nerve impulses in the central nervous system.

name: cerebellar granular layer atrophy
cerebellar granular layer atrophy
HP:0012080.def: Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the granular cell layer.

name: enlarged cerebellum
enlarge cerebellum
HP:0012081.def: An abnormally increased size of the cerebellum compared to other brain structures.

name: cerebellar purkinje layer atrophy
cerebellar purkinje layer atrophy
HP:0012082.def: Atrophy of the cerebellum affecting primarily the Purkinje cell layer.

name: ubiquitin - positive cerebral inclusion bodies
ubiquitin - positive cerebral inclusion body
HP:0012083.def: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates that show positive staining with antibodies against ubiquitin within cells of the brain.

name: abnormality of skeletal muscle fiber size
abnormality of skeletal muscle fiber size
HP:0012084.def: Any abnormality of the size of the skeletal muscle cell.
synonym: abnormality of skeletal muscle fibre size
abnormality of skeletal muscle fibre size

name: pyuria
pyuria
HP:0012085.def: The presence of 10 or more white cells per cubic millimeter in a urine specimen, 3 or more white cells per high-power field of unspun urine, a positive result on Gram staining of an unspun urine specimen, or a urinary dipstick test that is positive for leukocyte esterase.

name: abnormal urinary color
abnormal urinary color
HP:0012086.def: An abnormal color of the urine, that is, the color of the urine appears different from the usual straw-yellow color.

name: abnormal mitochondrial shape
abnormal mitochondrial shape
HP:0012087.def: An anomaly in the surface contour of mitochondria.

name: abnormal urinary odor
abnormal urinary odor
HP:0012088.def: A deviation from the normal odor of the urine.

name: abnormality of pancreas physiology
abnormality of pancreas physiology
HP:0012091.def: An anomaly of the function of the pancreas.

name: abnormality of exocrine pancreas physiology
abnormality of exocrine pancreas physiology
HP:0012092.def: A functional anomaly of the acinar gland portion of the pancreas that secretes digestive enzymes.

name: abnormality of endocrine pancreas physiology
abnormality of endocrine pancreas physiology
HP:0012093.def: A function abnormality of the endocrine pancreas.

name: abnormal pancreas size
abnormal pancreas size
HP:0012094.def: A deviation from the normal size of the pancreas.

name: intracranial epidermoid cyst
intracranial epidermoid cyst
HP:0012096.def: A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from ectodermal cells that normally form skin cells being left behind in the nervous system during development.

name: intracranial dermoid cyst
intracranial dermoid cyst
HP:0012097.def: A congenital inclusion cysts that arises from the inclusion of ectodermally committed cells at the time of neural tube closure (3rd-5th week of embryogenesis). The capsule of dermoid cysts consists of simple epithelium supported by collagen. In thicker parts, the lining is supplemented with dermis containing hair follicles, sebaceous glands, and apocrine glands.

name: edema of the dorsum of feet
edema of the dorsum of foot
HP:0012098.def: An abnormal accumulation of fluid beneath the skin on the back of the feet.
synonym: oedema of the dorsum of feet
oedema of the dorsum of foot

name: abnormality of circulating catecholamine level
abnormality of circulate catecholamine level
HP:0012099.def: An abnormal catecholamine concentration in the blood.

name: abnormal circulating creatinine concentration
abnormal circulate creatinine concentration
HP:0012100.def: An abnormal concentration of creatinine in the blood.

name: decreased serum creatinine
decrease serum creatinine
HP:0012101.def: An abnormally reduced amount of creatinine in the blood.

name: abnormal mitochondrial number
abnormal mitochondrial number
HP:0012102.def: A deviation from the normal number of mitochondria per cell.

name: abnormality of the mitochondrion
abnormality of the mitochondrion
HP:0012103.def: An anomaly of the mitochondrion, the membranous cytoplasmic organelle the interior of which is subdivided by cristae. The mitochondrion is a self replicating organelle that is the site of tissue respiration.

name: rhizomelic leg shortening
rhizomelic leg shorten
HP:0012106.def: Disproportionate shortening of the proximal segment of the leg (i.e. the femur).

name: increased fibular diameter
increase fibular diameter
HP:0012107.def: Increased width of the cross sectional diameter of the fibula.

name: open angle glaucoma
open angle glaucoma
HP:0012108.def: A type of glaucoma defined by an open, normal appearing anterior chamber angle and raised intraocular pressure,

name: angle closure glaucoma
angle closure glaucoma
HP:0012109.def: A type of glaucomatous optic neuropathy in an eye that has evidence of angle closure (i.e. significant iridotrabecular contact).

name: abnormality of circulating glucocorticoid level
abnormality of circulate glucocorticoid level
HP:0012111.def: An abnormality of the concentration of a glucocorticoid in the blood.

name: abnormal circulating corticosterone level
abnormal circulate corticosterone level
HP:0012112.def: An abnormality of the concentration of corticosterone in the blood.

name: abnormal circulating creatine concentration
abnormal circulate creatine concentration
HP:0012113.def: A deviation from the normal concentration of creatine in the blood circulation. Creatine is a derivative of glycine having methyl and amidino groups attached to the nitrogen. Creatine is naturally produced from amino acids, primarily in liver and kidney, and acts as an energy source for cells, primarly for muscle cells.

name: endometrial carcinoma
endometrial carcinoma
HP:0012114.def: A carcinoma of the endometrium, the mucous lining of the uterus.

name: abnormal circulating albumin concentration
abnormal circulate albumin concentration
HP:0012116.def: Deviation from normal concentration of albumin in the blood.

name: hyperalbuminemia
hyperalbuminemia
HP:0012117.def: Elevation in the concentration of albumin in the blood.

name: methemoglobinemia
methemoglobinemia
HP:0012119.def: Abnormally increased levels of methemoglobin in the blood. In this form of hemoglobin, there is an oxidized ferric iron (Fe +3) rather than the reduced ferrous form (Fe 2+) that is normally found in hemoglobin. Methemoglobin has a reduced affinity for oxygen, resulting in a reduced ability to release oxygen to tissues.

name: methylmalonic aciduria
methylmalonic aciduria
HP:0012120.def: Increased concentration of methylmalonic acid in the urine.

name: panuveitis
panuveitis
HP:0012121.def: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which inflammation affects the anterior chamber, vitreous, retina or choroid.

name: anterior uveitis
anterior uveitis
HP:0012122.def: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the anterior chamber.

name: posterior uveitis
posterior uveitis
HP:0012123.def: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the retina or choroid.

name: intermediate uveitis
intermediate uveitis
HP:0012124.def: Inflammation of the uveal tract in which the primary site of inflammation is the vitreous.

name: stomach cancer
stomach cancer
HP:0012126.def: A cancer arising in any part of the stomach.

name: uraciluria
uraciluria
HP:0012127.def: Increased concentration of uracil in the urine.

name: basal ganglia necrosis
basal ganglion necrosis
HP:0012128.def: Death of cells in the basal ganglia.

name: abnormality of bone marrow stromal cells
abnormality of bone marrow stromal cell
abnormal erythroid lineage cell morphology
abnormal erythroid lineage cell morphology
HP:0012130.def: An anomaly of erythroid lineage cells, that is, of the erythropoietic cells in the lineage leading to and including erythrocytes.
synonym: abnormality of cells of the erythroid lineage
abnormality of cell of the erythroid lineage

name: abnormal number of erythroid precursors
abnormal number of erythroid precursor
HP:0012131.def: A deviation from the normal count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.

name: erythroid hyperplasia
erythroid hyperplasia
HP:0012132.def: Increased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.
synonym: bone marrow biopsy shows erythroid hyperplasia
bone marrow biopsy show erythroid hyperplasia
bone marrow smear shows erythroid hyperplasia
bone marrow smear show erythroid hyperplasia

name: erythroid hypoplasia
erythroid hypoplasia
HP:0012133.def: Decreased count of erythroid precursor cells, that is, erythroid lineage cells in the bone marrow.
synonym: erythroid hypoplasia in the bone marrow
erythroid hypoplasia in the bone marrow

name: abnormal granulocytopoietic cell morphology
abnormal granulocytopoietic cell morphology
HP:0012135.def: An anomaly of cells involved in the formation of a granulocytes, that is, of the granulocytopoietic cell.
synonym: abnormality of cells of the granulocytic lineage
abnormality of cell of the granulocytic lineage

name: granulocytic hypoplasia
granulocytic hypoplasia
HP:0012139.def: Decreased number of granulocyte precursors in the bone marrow.

name: obsolete abnormality of cells of the lymphoid lineage
obsolete abnormality of cell of the lymphoid lineage
pancreatic squamous cell carcinoma
pancreatic squamous cell carcinoma
HP:0012142.def: A subtype of ductal pancreatic carcinoma that is thought to originate from squamous metaplasia of pancreatic ductal epithelium.
synonym: squamous cell carcinoma of the pancreas
squamous cell carcinoma of the pancreas

name: abnormal megakaryocyte morphology
abnormal megakaryocyte morphology
HP:0012143.def: Any structural anomaly of megakaryocytes. Mature blood platelets are released from the cytoplasm of megakaryocytes, which are bone-marrow resident cells.
synonym: abnormality of cells of the megakaryocyte lineage
abnormality of cell of the megakaryocyte lineage

name: abnormal monocyte morphology
abnormal monocyte morphology
HP:0012144.def: Any structural anomaly of a myeloid mononuclear recirculating leukocyte that can act as a precursor of tissue macrophages, osteoclasts and some populations of tissue dendritic cells.

name: abnormality of multiple cell lineages in the bone marrow
abnormality of multiple cell lineage in the bone marrow
abnormality of von willebrand factor
abnormality of von willebrand factor
HP:0012146.def: Decreased quantity or activity of von Willebrand factor. Von Willebrand factor mediates the adhesion of platelets to the collagen exposed on endothelial cell surfaces.

name: reduced quantity of von willebrand factor
reduce quantity of von willebrand factor
HP:0012147.def: Decreased quantity of von Willebrand factor.

name: multiple lineage myelodysplasia
multiple lineage myelodysplasia
HP:0012148.def: Myelodysplasia with dysplastic changes in two or more of the myeloid lineages: erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic.

name: bilineage myelodysplasia
bilineage myelodysplasia
HP:0012149.def: Myelodysplasia with dysplastic changes in two of the myeloid lineages: erythroid, granulocytic, megakaryocytic.

name: single lineage myelodysplasia
single lineage myelodysplasia
HP:0012150.def: Abnormality/dysplasia of a single myeloid cell (erythroid, granulocytic, or megakaryocytic).

name: hemothorax
hemothorax
HP:0012151.def: The presence of blood in the pleural space.

name: foveoschisis
foveoschisis
HP:0012152.def: Splitting of the retinal layers in the macula.

name: hypotriglyceridemia
hypotriglyceridemia
HP:0012153.def: An decrease in the level of triglycerides in the blood.

name: anhedonia
anhedonia
HP:0012154.def: Inability to experience pleasurable activities usually found enjoyable.

name: decreased corneal sensation
decrease corneal sensation
HP:0012155.def: Reduced ability of the cornea to respond to stimulation.

name: hemophagocytosis
hemophagocytosis
HP:0012156.def: Phagocytosis by macrophages of erythrocytes, leukocytes, platelets, and their precursors in bone marrow and other tissues.

name: subcortical cerebral atrophy
subcortical cerebral atrophy
HP:0012157.def: Atrophy of the cerebral subcortical white and gray matter, termed subcortical atrophy, reflects loss of nerve cells in the basal ganglia or fibers in the deep white matter.

name: carotid artery dissection
carotid artery dissection
HP:0012158.def: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the carotid artery wall.

name: internal carotid artery dissection
internal carotid artery dissection
HP:0012159.def: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the internal carotid artery wall.

name: intracranial internal carotid artery dissection
intracranial internal carotid artery dissection
HP:0012160.def: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the intracranial portion of the internal carotid artery wall.

name: external carotid artery dissection
external carotid artery dissection
HP:0012161.def: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the external carotid artery wall.

name: common carotid artery dissection
common carotid artery dissection
HP:0012162.def: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the common carotid artery wall.

name: carotid artery dilatation
carotid artery dilatation
HP:0012163.def: A dilatation (balooning or bulging out of the vessel wall) of a carotid artery.

name: asterixis
asterixis
HP:0012164.def: A clinical sign indicating a lapse of posture and is usually manifest by a bilateral flapping tremor at the wrist, metacarpophalangeal, and hip joints.

name: oligodactyly
oligodactyly
HP:0012165.def: A developmental defect resulting in the presence of fewer than the normal number of digits.

name: skin - picking
skin - picking
HP:0012166.def: Repetitive and compulsive picking of skin which results in tissue damage.

name: hair - pulling
hair - pulling
HP:0012167.def: A phenomenon in which persons repetitively pull out their own hair, resulting in noticeable hair loss.

name: head - banging
head - banging
HP:0012168.def: Habitual striking of one's own head against a surface such as a mattress or wall of a crib.

name: self - biting
self - biting
HP:0012169.def: Habitual biting of one's own body.

name: nail - biting
nail - biting
HP:0012170.def: Habitual biting of one's own fingernails.

name: stereotypical hand wringing
stereotypical hand wring
HP:0012171.def: Habitual clasping and wringing of the hands in the middle of the body, similar to a hand-washing movement.

name: stereotypical body rocking
stereotypical body rock
HP:0012172.def: Habitual repetitive movement of the entire body, front to back or side to side.

name: orthostatic tachycardia
orthostatic tachycardia
HP:0012173.def: An increase in heart rate with standing of 30 beats per minute or more.

name: glioblastoma multiforme
glioblastoma multiforme
HP:0012174.def: A tumor arising from glia in the central nervous system with macroscopic regions of necrosis and hemorrhage. Microscopically, glioblastoma multiforme is characterized by regions of pseudopalisading necrosis, pleomorphic nuclei and cells, and microvascular proliferation.

name: resistance to activated protein c
resistance to activate protein c
HP:0012175.def: Poor anticoagulant response to activated protein C. A plasma is termed 'APC resistant' when the addition of exogenous APC fails to prolong its clotting time in an activated partial thromboplastin time assay.

name: abnormal natural killer cell morphology
abnormal natural killer cell morphology
HP:0012176.def: An anomaly of the natural killer cell, which is a lymphocyte that can spontaneously kill a variety of target cells without prior antigenic activation via germline encoded activation receptors. It also regulates immune responses via cytokine release and direct contact with other cells.

name: abnormal natural killer cell physiology
abnormal natural killer cell physiology
HP:0012177.def: A functional anomaly of the natural killer cell.

name: reduced natural killer cell activity
reduced natural killer cell activity
HP:0012178.def: Reduced ability of the natural killer cell to function in the adaptive immune response.

name: craniofacial dystonia
craniofacial dystonia
HP:0012179.def: A form of focal dystonia affecting the face and especially the jaw that is induced by the act of speaking. It is an involuntary contraction of the masticatory muscles, resulting in dysarthria or dysphagia.

name: cystic medial necrosis
cystic medial necrosis
HP:0012180.def: A disorder of large arteries, in particular the aorta, characterized by an accumulation of basophilic ground substance in the media with cyst-like lesions associated with degenerative changes of collagen, elastin and the vascular smooth muscle cells.

name: entrapment neuropathy
entrapment neuropathy
HP:0012181.def: Malfunction of a peripheral nerve resulting from mechanical compression of the nerve roots from internal or external causes and leading to a conduction block or axonal loss.

name: oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma
HP:0012182.def: A squamous cell carcinoma that originates in the oropharnyx.

name: hyperplastic colonic polyposis
hyperplastic colonic polyposis
HP:0012183.def: Presence of multiple hyperplastic polyps in the colon. Hyperplastic polyps are generally about 5 mm in size and show hyperplastic mucosal proliferation.

name: increased hdl cholesterol concentration
increase hdl cholesterol concentration
HP:0012184.def: An elevated concentration of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL) in the blood.
synonym: increased circulating high - density lipoprotein levels
increase circulate high - density lipoprotein level

name: constrictive median neuropathy
constrictive median neuropathy
HP:0012185.def: Injury to the median nerve caused by its entrapment at the wrist as it traverses through the carpal tunnel. Clinically, constrictive median neuropathy is characterized by pain, paresthesia, and weakness in the median nerve distribution of the hand.

name: entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve at elbow
entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve at elbow
HP:0012186.def: An entrapment neuropathy of the ulnar nerve in the cubital tunnel (in the elbow) characterized by numbness in the ring and little fingers and weakness of the intrinsic muscles in the hand.

name: increased erythrocyte protoporphyrin concentration
increase erythrocyte protoporphyrin concentration
HP:0012187.def: Concentration of protoporphyrins in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

name: hyperemesis gravidarum
hyperemesis gravidarum
HP:0012188.def: Excessive vomiting in early pregnancy, leading to the loss of 5% or more of body weight.

name: hodgkin lymphoma
hodgkin lymphoma
HP:0012189.def: A type of lymphoma characterized microscopically by multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells.

name: t - cell lymphoma
t - cell lymphoma
HP:0012190.def: A type of lymphoma that originates in T-cells.

name: b - cell lymphoma
b - cell lymphoma
HP:0012191.def: A type of lymphoma that originates in B-cells.

name: cutaneous t - cell lymphoma
cutaneous t - cell lymphoma
HP:0012192.def: A type of T-cell lymphoma that exhibits malignant infiltration of the skin.

name: anaplastic large - cell lymphoma
anaplastic large - cell lymphoma
HP:0012193.def: A type of T-cell lymphoma that is characterized by so-called hallmark cells with a pleomorphic appearance that express the CD30 antigen, are lobulated, and have indented nuclei.

name: episodic hemiplegia
episodic hemiplegia
HP:0012194.def: Transient episodes of weakness of the arm, leg, and in some cases the face on one side of the body.

name: cheyne - stokes respiration
cheyne - stokes respiration
HP:0012196.def: An abnormal pattern of respiration characterized by cycles of respiration that are increasingly deeper then shallower with possible periods of apnea. Affected patients may display a 10 to 20 second episode of hypoventilation or apnea, followed by respiration of increased depth and frequency over the course of about one minute. The cycle repeats every 45 seconds to 3 minutes.

name: insulinoma
insulinoma
HP:0012197.def: A type of tumor of the pancreatic beta cells that secretes excess insulin and can result in hypoglycemia.

name: juvenile colonic polyposis
juvenile colonic polyposis
HP:0012198.def: The presence of more than 5 juvenile polyps of the colon. The term juvenile polyps refer to a special histopathology and not the age of onset as the polyp might be diagnosed at all ages. The juvenile polyp has a spherical appearance and is microscopically characterized by overgrowth of an oedematous lamina propria with inflammatory cells and cystic glands.

name: cluster headache
cluster headache
HP:0012199.def: A type of headache characterized by repeated attacks of unilateral pain lasting 15 to 180 minutes and associated with local autonomic signs.

name: abnormality of prothrombin
abnormality of prothrombin
HP:0012200.def: An anomaly of clotting factor II, which is known as prothrombin, a vitamin K-dependent proenzyme that functions in the blood coagulation cascade.

name: increased serum bile acid concentration
increase serum bile acid concentration
HP:0012202.def: An increase in the concentration of bile acid in the blood.

name: onychomycosis
onychomycosis
HP:0012203.def: A fungal infection of the toenails or fingernails that tends to cause the nails to thicken, discolor, disfigure, and split.

name: recurrent vulvovaginal candidiasis
recurrent vulvovaginal candidiasis
HP:0012204.def: Recurrent infection involving the vulva, vagina, and adjacent crural areas, whereby the causative agent belongs to the genus Candida.

name: globozoospermia
globozoospermia
HP:0012205.def: Any structural anomaly of the acrosome resulting in a round sperm head.

name: abnormal sperm motility
abnormal sperm motility
HP:0012206.def: An anomaly of the mobility of ejaculated sperm.

name: reduced sperm motility
reduce sperm motility
HP:0012207.def: An abnormal reduction in the mobility of ejaculated sperm.

name: immotile sperm
immotile sperm
HP:0012208.def: A lack of mobility of ejaculated sperm.

name: juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia
HP:0012209.def: Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) is a lethal myeloproliferative disease of young childhood characterized clinically by overproduction of myelomonocytic cells and by the in vitro phenotype of hematopoietic progenitor hypersensitivity to granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor.

name: abnormal renal morphology
abnormal renal morphology
HP:0012210.def: Any structural anomaly of the kidney.
synonym: structural anomalies of the renal tract
structural anomaly of the renal tract

name: abnormal renal physiology
abnormal renal physiology
HP:0012211.def: An abnormal functionality of the kidney.

name: abnormal glomerular filtration rate
abnormal glomerular filtration rate
HP:0012212.def: An abnormally increased or reduced amount of fluid filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.

name: decreased glomerular filtration rate
decrease glomerular filtration rate
