HP:0012213.def: An abnormal reduction in the volume of fluid filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.

name: increased glomerular filtration rate
increase glomerular filtration rate
HP:0012214.def: An abnormal rise in the volume of water filtered out of plasma through glomerular capillary walls into Bowman's capsules per unit of time.

name: testicular microlithiasis
testicular microlithiasis
HP:0012215.def: The deposition of calcium phosphate microliths within the seminiferous tubules.

name: entrapment neuropathy of suprascapular nerve
entrapment neuropathy of suprascapular nerve
HP:0012216.def: An entrapment neuropathy of the suprascapular nerve, presenting with shoulder weakness confined to the supraspinatus muscle (this muscle initiates shoulder abduction) or to the infraspinatus (this muscle externally rotates the arm), as well as with pain in the posterior part of the shoulder and upper periscapular region.

name: increased urinary porphobilinogen
increase urinary porphobilinogen
HP:0012217.def: The concentration of porphobilinogen in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: alveolar soft part sarcoma
alveolar soft part sarcoma
HP:0012218.def: A type of soft tissue sarcoma with a histological appearance reminiscent of alveoli because of its reticulated fibrous stroma enclosing groups of sarcoma cells, which resemble epithelial cells and are enclosed in alveoli walled with connective tissue.

name: erythema nodosum
erythema nodosum
HP:0012219.def: An erythematous eruption commonly associated with drug reactions or infection and characterized by inflammatory nodules that are usually tender, multiple, and bilateral.

name: non - caseating epithelioid cell granulomatosis
non - caseate epithelioid cell granulomatosis
HP:0012220.def: The presence of multiple epithelioid cell granulomas consist of highly differentiated mononuclear phagocytes (epithelioid cells and giant cells) and lymphocytes, not exhibiting caseation (a form of necrosis in which the tissue changes into a dry, amorphous mass said to resemble cheese).

name: pretibial blistering
pretibial blistering
HP:0012221.def: A type of blistering that affects the skin of the tibial region.

name: arachnoid hemangiomatosis
arachnoid hemangiomatosis
HP:0012222.def: The presence of multiple hemangiomas in the arachnoid.

name: splenic rupture
splenic rupture
HP:0012223.def: A breach of the capsule of the spleen.

name: circulating immune complexes
circulate immune complex
HP:0012224.def: Persistence of immune complexes in the blood circulation.

name: oligodontia of primary teeth
oligodontia of primary teeth
synonym: failure of development of some deciduous teeth
failure of development of some deciduous teeth
failure of development of some primary teeth
failure of development of some primary teeth

name: ovarian teratoma
ovarian teratoma
HP:0012226.def: The presence of a teratoma in the ovary.

name: urethral stricture
urethral stricture
HP:0012227.def: Narrowing of the urethra associated with inflammation or scar tissue.

name: tension - type headache
tension - type headache
HP:0012228.def: A type of headache that last hours with continuous pain of mild or moderate intensity, bilateral location, a pressing/tightening (non-pulsating) quality and that is not aggravated by routine physical activity such as walking or climbing stairs.

name: csf pleocytosis
csf pleocytosis
HP:0012229.def: An increased white blood cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid.

name: rhegmatogenous retinal detachment
rhegmatogenous retinal detachment
HP:0012230.def: A type of retinal detachment associated with a retinal tear, that is, with a break in the retina that allows fluid to pass from the vitreous space into the subretinal space between the sensory retina and the retinal pigment epithelium.

name: exudative retinal detachment
exudative retinal detachment
HP:0012231.def: A type of retinal detachment arising from damage to the outer blood-retinal barrier that allows fluid to access the subretinal space and separate the neurosensory retina from the retinal pigment epithelium.

name: shortened qt interval
shorten qt interval
HP:0012232.def: Decreased time between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).

name: intramuscular hematoma
intramuscular hematoma
HP:0012233.def: Blood clot formed within muscle tissue following leakage of blood into the tissue.

name: agranulocytosis
agranulocytosis
HP:0012234.def: Marked decrease in the number of granulocytes.

name: drug - induced agranulocytosis
drug - induced agranulocytosis
HP:0012235.def: A type of agranulocytosis related to ingestion of a specific medication.

name: elevated sweat chloride
elevate sweat chloride
HP:0012236.def: An increased concentration of chloride in the sweat.

name: urocanic aciduria
urocanic aciduria
HP:0012237.def: An increased concentration of urocanic acid in the urine.

name: increased circulating chylomicron concentration
increase circulate chylomicron concentration
HP:0012238.def: Increased plasma concentrations of chylomicrons, the large lipid droplet (up to 100 mm in diameter) of reprocessed lipid synthesized in epithelial cells of the small intestine and containing triacylglycerols, cholesterol esters, and several apolipoproteins.

name: atransferrinemia
atransferrinemia
HP:0012239.def: Absence of transferrin, a protein that transports iron, in the blood.

name: increased intramyocellular lipid droplets
increase intramyocellular lipid droplet
HP:0012240.def: An abnormal increase in intracellular lipid droplets In a muscle. The number and size of these drops can increase with somd disorders of lipid metabolism affecting muscle. See PMID 20691590 for histological images.

name: levator palpebrae superioris atrophy
levator palpebrae superioris atrophy
HP:0012241.def: Atrophy of the levator palpebrae superioris, the extraocular muscle that elevates the superior eyelid.

name: superior rectus atrophy
superior rectus atrophy
HP:0012242.def: Atrophy of the superior rectus, the extraocular muscle whose primary function is to elevate the globe.

name: abnormal reproductive system morphology
abnormal reproductive system morphology
HP:0012243.def: A structural or developmental anomaly of any of the tissues involved in the genital system.

name: abnormal sex determination
abnormal sex determination
HP:0012244.def: Anomaly of primary or secondary sexual development or characteristics.

name: sex reversal
sex reversal
HP:0012245.def: Development of the reproductive system is inconsistent with the chromosomal sex.

name: oculomotor nerve palsy
oculomotor nerve palsy
HP:0012246.def: Reduced ability to control the movement of the eye associated with damage to the third cranial nerve (the oculomotor nerve).

name: prolonged pr interval
prolonged pr interval
HP:0012248.def: Increased time for the PR interval (beginning of the P wave to the beginning of the QRS complex).

name: abnormal st segment
abnormal st segment
HP:0012249.def: An electrocardiographic anomaly of the ST segment, which is the segment that connects the QRS complex and the T wave. The ST segment normally has a duration of 80 to 120 ms, is flat and at the same level (isoelectric) as the PR and TP segment.

name: st segment depression
st segment depression
HP:0012250.def: An electrocardiographic anomaly in which the ST segment is observed to be located inferior to the isoelectric line.

name: st segment elevation
st segment elevation
HP:0012251.def: An electrocardiographic anomaly in which the ST segment is observed to be located superior to the isoelectric line.

name: abnormal respiratory system morphology
abnormal respiratory system morphology
HP:0012252.def: A structural anomaly of the respiratory system.

name: abnormal respiratory epithelium morphology
abnormal respiratory epithelium morphology
HP:0012253.def: Any structural anomaly of the pseudostratified ciliated epithelium that lines much of the conducting portion of the airway, including part of the nasal cavity and larynx, the trachea, and bronchi.

name: ewing sarcoma
ewing sarcoma
HP:0012254.def: A malignant tumor of the bone which always arises in the medullary tissue, occurring more often in cylindrical bones.

name: dynein arm defect of respiratory motile cilia
dynein arm defect of respiratory motile cilium
HP:0012255.def: An anomaly of the dynein arms of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

name: absent outer dynein arms
absent outer dynein arm
HP:0012256.def: Absence of the outer dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, which normally are situated outside of the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

name: absent inner dynein arms
absent inner dynein arm
HP:0012257.def: Absence of the inner dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, which normally are situated within the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

name: abnormal axonemal organization of respiratory motile cilia
abnormal axonemal organization of respiratory motile cilium
HP:0012258.def: Abnormal arrangement of the structures of the axoneme, which is the cytoskeletal structure that forms the inner core of the motile cilium and displays a canonical 9+2 microtubular pattern of motile cilia studded with dynein arms.
synonym: abnormal axonemal organisation of respiratory motile cilia
abnormal axonemal organisation of respiratory motile cilium

name: absent inner and outer dynein arms
absent inner and outer dynein arm
HP:0012259.def: Complete absence of the dynein arms of respiratory motile cilia, that is, absence of the inner and the outer dynein arms, which normally are situated inside and outside of the peripheral microtubules of motile cilia. This feature is usually appreciated by electron microscopy.

name: abnormal central microtubular pair morphology of respiratory motile cilia
abnormal central microtubular pair morphology of respiratory motile cilium
HP:0012260.def: A structural anomaly of the two central microtubules of motile cilia with a 9+2 microtubuluar configuration.

name: abnormal respiratory motile cilium physiology
abnormal respiratory motile cilium physiology
HP:0012261.def: Any functional anomaly of the respiratory motile cilia.

name: abnormal ciliary motility
abnormal ciliary motility
HP:0012262.def: Any anomaly of the normal motility of motile cilia. Evaluation of ciliary beat frequency and ciliary beat pattern requires high-speed videomicroscopy of freshly obtained ciliary biopsies that are maintained in culture media under controlled conditions.

name: absent central microtubular pair morphology of respiratory motile cilia
absent central microtubular pair morphology of respiratory motile cilium
HP:0012264.def: Absence of the two central microtubules of motile cilia with a 9+2 microtubuluar configuration.

name: ciliary dyskinesia
ciliary dyskinesia
HP:0012265.def: A deviation from the normally well coordinated pattern of intracellular and intercellular synchrony of motile cilia. Dyskinetic cilia usually beat out of synchrony relative to neighboring cilia.
synonym: lack of coordinated beating of respiratory cilia
lack of coordinated beating of respiratory cilium

name: t - wave alternans
t - wave alternans
HP:0012266.def: A periodic beat-to-beat variation in the amplitude or shape of the T wave in an EKG.

name: absent respiratory ciliary axoneme radial spokes
absent respiratory ciliary axoneme radial spoke
HP:0012267.def: Absence of the radial spokes of the axoneme of the respiratory cilium.

name: myxoid liposarcoma
myxoid liposarcoma
HP:0012268.def: A liposarcoma that contains myxomatous tissue.

name: abnormal muscle glycogen content
abnormal muscle glycogen content
HP:0012269.def: Any anomaly in the amount of glycogen in muscle tissue.

name: decreased muscle glycogen content
decreased muscle glycogen content

name: sacroiliac joint synovitis
sacroiliac joint synovitis
HP:0012449.def: Inflammation of the synovial membrane of the sacroiliac joint.

name: chronic constipation
chronic constipation
HP:0012450.def: Constipation for longer than three months with fewer than 3 bowel movements per week, straining, lumpy or hard stools, and a sensation of anorectal obstruction or incomplete defecation.

name: acute constipation
acute constipation
HP:0012451.def: Constipation of sudden onset and lasting for less than three months.

name: restless legs
restless leg
HP:0012452.def: Restless Leg Syndrome (RLS) is a condition characterized by an uncomfortable and restless sensation in the legs that occurs after going to bed, often leading to insomnia.

name: bilateral wrist flexion contracture
bilateral wrist flexion contracture
HP:0012453.def: A chronic loss of wrist joint motion on the right and left sides.

name: unilateral wrist flexion contracture
unilateral wrist flexion contracture
HP:0012454.def: A chronic loss of wrist joint motion on one side only.

name: medial arterial calcification
medial arterial calcification
HP:0012456.def: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of arteries.

name: medial calcification of medium - sized arteries
medial calcification of medium - sized artery
HP:0012457.def: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of medium-sized (muscular or distributive) arteries.

name: medial calcification of small arteries
medial calcification of small artery
HP:0012458.def: Calcification, that is, pathological deposition of calcium salts in the tunica media of small arteries.

name: hypnic headache
hypnic headache
HP:0012459.def: A headache disorder that occurs exclusively at night, waking the affected individual from sleep.

name: dysmorphic inferior cerebellar vermis
dysmorphic inferior cerebellar vermis
HP:0012460.def: A structural anomaly of the inferior portion of the vermis of cerebellum.

name: bacteriuria
bacteriuria
HP:0012461.def: The presence of bacteria in the urine.

name: chin myoclonus
chin myoclonus
HP:0012462.def: Involuntary and irregular twitches of the chin.

name: elevated transferrin saturation
elevate transferrin saturation
HP:0012463.def: An above normal level of saturation of serum transferrin with iron.

name: decreased transferrin saturation
decrease transferrin saturation
HP:0012464.def: A below normal level of saturation of serum transferrin with iron.

name: elevated hepatic iron concentration
elevate hepatic iron concentration
HP:0012465.def: An increased level of iron in liver tissues.

name: chronic respiratory acidosis
chronic respiratory acidosis
HP:0012466.def: Longstanding impairment in ventilation such that the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) is elevated above the upper limit of the reference range (more than 45 mm Hg), with a normal or near-normal pH secondary to renal compensation and an elevated serum bicarbonate levels (more than30 mEq/L).

name: acute respiratory acidosis
acute respiratory acidosis
HP:0012467.def: Sudden onset of impairment in ventilation such that the removal of carbon dioxide by the respiratory system is less than the production of carbon dioxide in the tissues, leading to an elevation of the partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PaCO2) above the normal limits (more than 45 mm Hg) with an accompanying acidemia (pH less than 7.35).

name: chronic acidosis
chronic acidosis
HP:0012468.def: Longstanding abnormal acid accumulation or depletion of base.

name: infantile spasms
infantile spasm
HP:0012469.def: Infantile spasms represent a subset of \"epileptic spasms\". Infantile Spasms are epileptic spasms starting in the first year of life (infancy).

name: setting - sun eye phenomenon
set - sun eye phenomenon
HP:0012470.def: An ophthalmologic sign in young children resulting from upward-gaze paresis. In this condition, the eyes appear driven downward, the sclera may be seen between the upper eyelid and the iris, and part of the lower pupil may be covered by the lower eyelid.

name: thick vermilion border
thick vermilion border
HP:0012471.def: Increased width of the skin of vermilion border region of upper lip.

name: eclabion
eclabion
HP:0012472.def: A turning outward of the lip or lips, that is, eversion of the lips.

name: carotid artery occlusion
carotid artery occlusion
HP:0012474.def: Complete obstruction of a carotid artery.

name: decreased circulating level of specific antibody
decrease circulate level of specific antibody
HP:0012475.def: The presence of normal overall immunoglobulin levels with deficiency of specific immunoglobulins directed against a specific antigen or microorganism.

name: decreased specific pneumococcal antibody level
decrease specific pneumococcal antibody level
HP:0012476.def: The presence of normal overall immunoglobulin levels with deficiency of specific immunoglobulins directed against pneumococci.

name: vocal tremor
vocal tremor
HP:0012477.def: A wavering, unsteady voice that reflects involuntary and approximately sinusoidal oscillation of motor unit firings of laryngeal muscles. Vocal tremor results in low frequency modulations of voice frequency or amplitude and intermittent voice instability.

name: temporomandibular joint ankylosis
temporomandibular joint ankylosis
HP:0012478.def: Bony fusion of the mandibular condyle to the base of the skull, resulting in limitation of jaw opening.

name: temporomandibular joint crepitus
temporomandibular joint crepitus
HP:0012479.def: Noises from the temporomandibular joint during mandibular movement (e.g., chewing). Temporomandibular joint crepitus is often described as a clicking, popping, grating sound.

name: cerebral venous angioma
cerebral venous angioma
HP:0012481.def: A congenital malformation of veins which drain normal brain characterized by a caput medusae or an umbrellalike convergence of multiple venules on a single, or occasionally multiple, enlarged parenchymal or medullary vein, like the trunk of a tree or the shank of an umbrella. This dilated terminal vein penetrates the cortex to drain either (a) superficially to cortical veins or sinuses, (b) deeply to subependymal veins of the lateral ventricle and then into the galenic system, (c) to the fourth ventricle and then to the pontomesencephalic vein, or (d) to the precentral cerebellar vein and into the galenic system.

name: frontal venous angioma
frontal venous angioma
HP:0012482.def: A venous angioma of the frontal lobe of the brain.

name: abnormal alpha granules
abnormal alpha granule
HP:0012483.def: Defective structure, size or content of alpha granules, platelet organelles that contain several growth factors destined for release during platelet activation at sites of vessel wall injury.

name: abnormal dense granules
abnormal dense granule
HP:0012484.def: Defective structure, size or content of dense granules, platelet organelles that contain granules proaggregatory factors such as adenosine diphosphate (ADP), adenosine triphosphate (ATP), ionized calcium, histamine and serotonin.

name: abnormal surface - connected open canalicular system
abnormal surface - connect open canalicular system
HP:0012485.def: An anomaly of the invaginations of the surface membrane that form the open canalicular system (OCS). The OCS serve as the pathway for transport of substances into the cells and as conduits for the discharge of alpha granule products secreted during the platelet release reaction.

name: cerebellopontine angle arachnoid cyst
cerebellopontine angle arachnoid cyst
HP:0012487.def: An arachnoid cyst located at the margin of the cerebellum and pons.

name: intraventricular arachnoid cyst
intraventricular arachnoid cyst
HP:0012488.def: An arachnoid cyst located within the ventricular system.

name: suprasellar arachnoid cyst
suprasellar arachnoid cyst
HP:0012489.def: An arachnoid cyst that progressively enlarges from an abnormality in the membrane of Liliequist or in the interpeduncular cistern, and typically, expands from the prepontine space, displacing the floor of the third ventricle upwards, the pituitary stalk and optic chiasm upwards and forwards, and the mammillary bodies upwards and backwards.

name: abnormal dense tubular system
abnormal dense tubular system
HP:0012491.def: An anomaly of the intracellular membrane complexes known as the dense tubular system.

name: cerebral artery stenosis
cerebral artery stenosis
HP:0012492.def: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of a cerebral artery.

name: middle cerebral artery stenosis
middle cerebral artery stenosis
HP:0012493.def: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the middle cerebral artery.

name: anterior cerebral artery stenosis
anterior cerebral artery stenosis
HP:0012494.def: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the anterior cerebral artery.

name: posterior cerebral artery stenosis
posterior cerebral artery stenosis
HP:0012495.def: Narrowing or constriction of the inner surface (lumen) of the posterior cerebral artery.

name: reduced maximal inspiratory pressure
reduce maximal inspiratory pressure
HP:0012496.def: A decrease in the maximum amount of negative pressure a person can generate during an inhalation.

name: reduced maximal expiratory pressure
reduce maximal expiratory pressure
HP:0012497.def: A decrease in the maximum amount of pressure of expired air achieved by a person after a full inspiration.

name: nuchal cord
nuchal cord
HP:0012498.def: A complication of pregnancy and delivery in which the umbilical cord wraps around the fetal neck once or multiple times.

name: descending aortic dissection
descend aortic dissection
HP:0012499.def: A separation of the layers within the wall of the descending aorta. Tears in the intimal layer result in the propagation of dissection (proximally or distally) secondary to blood entering the intima-media space.

name: verrucous papule
verrucous papule
HP:0012500.def: A wartlike (with multiple small elevated projections) papule.

name: abnormal brainstem white matter morphology
abnormal brainstem white matter morphology
HP:0012501.def: An anomaly of the white matter of brainstem.
synonym: abnormality of the brainstem white matter
abnormality of the brainstem white matter

name: abnormality of the internal capsule
abnormality of the internal capsule
HP:0012502.def: An anomaly of the internal capsule, which is an area of white matter in the brain that separates the caudate nucleus and the thalamus from the putamen and the globus pallidus.

name: abnormal pituitary gland morphology
abnormal pituitary gland morphology
HP:0012503.def: An anomaly of the pituitary gland.

name: abnormal size of pituitary gland
abnormal size of pituitary gland
HP:0012504.def: A deviation from the normal size of the pituitary gland.

name: enlarged pituitary gland
enlarge pituitary gland
HP:0012505.def: An abnormally increased size of the pituitary gland.

name: small pituitary gland
small pituitary gland
HP:0012506.def: An abnormally decreased size of the pituitary gland.

name: weakness of orbicularis oculi muscle
weakness of orbicularis oculus muscle
HP:0012507.def: Reduced strength of the orbicularis oculi, the circumorbital muscle in the face that closes the eyelid.

name: metamorphopsia
metamorphopsia
HP:0012508.def: A visual anomaly in which images appear distorted. A grid of straight lines appears wavy and parts of the grid may appear blank.

name: reduced thyroxin - binding globulin
reduce thyroxin - binding globulin
HP:0012509.def: An abnormally decreased amount of thyroxin-binding globulin (TBG) in blood. TBG is responsible for carrying the thyroid hormones thyroxine (T4) and 3,5,3'-triiodothyronine (T3) in the bloodstream.

name: extra - axial cerebrospinal fluid accumulation
extra - axial cerebrospinal fluid accumulation
HP:0012510.def: An increased amount of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) in the subarachnoid space.

name: temporal optic disc pallor
temporal optic disc pallor
HP:0012511.def: A pale yellow discoloration of the temporal (lateral) portion of the optic disc.

name: diffuse optic disc pallor
diffuse optic disc pallor
HP:0012512.def: A pale yellow discoloration of the entire optic disc.

name: upper limb pain
upper limb pain
HP:0012513.def: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the arm.

name: lower limb pain
low limb pain
HP:0012514.def: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the leg.

name: hip flexor weakness
hip flexor weakness
HP:0012515.def: Reduced ability to flex the femur, that is, to pull the knee upward.

name: tetralogy of fallot with pulmonary atresia
tetralogy of fallot with pulmonary atresia
HP:0012516.def: An extreme form of tetralogy of Fallot characterized by absence of flow from the right ventricle to the pulmonary arteries.

name: reduced catalase level
reduced catalase level
HP:0012517.def: An abnormally decreased amount of catalase level.

name: abnormal circle of willis morphology
abnormal circle of willis morphology
HP:0012518.def: An anomaly of the circle of Willis, also known as the cerebral arterial circle.
synonym: abnormality of the cerebral arterial circle
abnormality of the cerebral arterial circle

name: hypoplastic posterior communicating artery
hypoplastic posterior communicate artery
HP:0012519.def: A developmental anomnaly characterized by underdevelopment of the posterior communicating artery.

name: dilation of virchow - robin spaces
dilation of virchow - robin space
HP:0012520.def: Increased dimensions of the Virchow-Robin spaces (also known as perivascular spaces), which surround the walls of vessels as they course from the subarachnoid space through the brain parenchyma. Perivascular spaces are commonly microscopic, and not visible on conventional neuroimaging. This term refers to an increase of size of these spaces such that they are visible on neuroimaging (usually magnetic resonance imaging). The dilatations are regular cavities that always contain a patent artery.

name: optic nerve aplasia
optic nerve aplasia
HP:0012521.def: Congenital absence of the optic nerve.

name: spider hemangioma
spider hemangioma
HP:0012522.def: A form of telangiectasis characterized by a central elevated red dot the size of a pinhead, representing an arteriole, with numerous small blood vessels that radiate out thereby resembling the legs of a spider. Characteristically, compression of the central arteriole causes the entire lesion to blanch, and the lesion quickly refills once the compression is released.

name: oral aversion
oral aversion
HP:0012523.def: Reluctance or refusal of a child to be breastfed or eat, manifested as gagging, vomiting, turning head away from food, or avoidance of sensation in or around the mouth (i.e. toothbrushing or face-washing).

name: abnormal platelet shape
abnormal platelet shape
HP:0012524.def: A deviation from the normal discoid platelet shape.

name: abnormal alpha granule distribution
abnormal alpha granule distribution
HP:0012525.def: An anomalous location and arrangement of platelet alpha granules.

name: absence of alpha granules
absence of alpha granule
HP:0012526.def: A lack of platelet alpha granules. This typically results in the grey appearance of platelets in giemsa stained blood smears.

name: abnormal alpha granule content
abnormal alpha granule content
HP:0012527.def: A deviation from the normal contents of the platelet alpha granules, which normally contain hemostatic proteins such as fibrinogen, von Willebrand factor, and growth factors such as platelet-derived growth factor.

name: abnormal number of alpha granules
abnormal number of alpha granule
HP:0012528.def: A deviation from the normal count of alpha granules per thrombocyte.

name: abnormal dense granule content
abnormal dense granule content
HP:0012529.def: A deviation from the normal contents of the platelet alpha granules, which normally contain adenosine triphosphate (ATP), adenosine diphosphate (ADP), serotonin, calcium, and pyrophosphate, which are secreted when platelets are activated.

name: abnormal number of dense granules
abnormal number of dense granule
HP:0012530.def: A deviation from the normal count of dense granules per thrombocyte.

name: pain
pain
HP:0012531.def: An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience associated with actual or potential tissue damage, or described in terms of such damage.

name: chronic pain
chronic pain
HP:0012532.def: Persistent pain, usually defined as pain that has lasted longer than 3 to 6 months.

name: allodynia
allodynia
HP:0012533.def: Pain due to a stimulus that does not normally provoke pain.

name: dysesthesia
dysesthesia
HP:0012534.def: Painful sensations elicited by a nonpainful cutaneous stimulus such as a light touch or gentle stroking over affected areas of the body. Sometimes referred to as hyperpathia or hyperalgesia. Often perceived as an intense burning, dyesthesias may outlast the stimulus by several seconds.

name: abnormal synaptic transmission
abnormal synaptic transmission
HP:0012535.def: An anomaly in the communication from a neuron to a target across a synapse. This is a four step process, comprising (i) synthesis and storage of neurotransmitters; (ii) neurotransmitter release; (iii) activation of postsynaptic receptors by the neurotransmitter; and (iv) inactivation of the neurotransmitter. Thus, this term is defined as an anomaly of neurotransmitter metabolic process.

name: maternal anticardiolipin antibody positive
maternal anticardiolipin antibody positive
HP:0012536.def: The presence of circulating autoantibodies to anticardiolipin in the mother.

name: food intolerance
food intolerance
HP:0012537.def: A detrimental reaction to a food, beverage, food additive, or compound found in foods that produces symptoms in one or more body organs and systems that is not mediated by an immune reaction.

name: gluten intolerance
gluten intolerance
HP:0012538.def: A detrimental reaction to the presence of gluten in food, which may include abdominal pain, fatigue, headaches and paresthesia, or celiac disease.

name: non - hodgkin lymphoma
non - hodgkin lymphoma
HP:0012539.def: A type of lymphoma characterized microscopically by the absence of multinucleated Reed-Sternberg cells.

name: axillary epidermoid cyst
axillary epidermoid cyst
HP:0012540.def: An epidermoid cyst in the armpit.

name: cephalohematoma
cephalohematoma
HP:0012541.def: Hemorrhage between the skull and periosteum of a newborn resulting from rupture of blood vessels that cross the periosteum.

name: hemosiderinuria
hemosiderinuria
HP:0012543.def: The presence of hemosiderin in the urine.

name: elevated circulating aldolase concentration
elevate circulate aldolase concentration
HP:0012544.def: Concentration of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: reduced circulating aldolase concentration
reduce circulate aldolase concentration
HP:0012545.def: Concentration of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: skewed maternal x inactivation
skew maternal x inactivation
HP:0012546.def: A deviation from equal (50%) inactivation of each parental X chromosome in maternal cells.

name: abnormal involuntary eye movements
abnormal involuntary eye movement
HP:0012547.def: Anomalous movements of the eyes that occur without the subject wanting them to happen.

name: fatty replacement of skeletal muscle
fatty replacement of skeletal muscle
HP:0012548.def: Muscle fibers degeneration resulting in fatty replacement of skeletal muscle fibers

name: conjunctival lipoma
conjunctival lipoma
HP:0012549.def: A lipoma (a benign tumor composed of adipose tissue) located in the conjunctiva.

name: colonic varices
colonic varix
HP:0012550.def: The presence of varices (enlarged and convoluted blood vessels) in the colon.

name: absent neutrophil specific granules
absent neutrophil specific granule
HP:0012551.def: Lack of specific granules in neutrophils.

name: increased neutrophil nuclear projections
increase neutrophil nuclear projection
HP:0012552.def: Presence of an elevated number of projections from nuclei of neutrophils. These projections can have the shape of hooks, tags, or clubs.

name: hypoplastic thumbnail
hypoplastic thumbnail
HP:0012553.def: A thumbnail that is diminished in length and width, i.e., underdeveloped thumb nail.

name: hyperbeta - alaninemia
hyperbeta - alaninemia
HP:0012556.def: Increased concentration of beta-alanine in the blood.

name: eeg with centrotemporal focal spike waves
eeg with centrotemporal focal spike wave
HP:0012557.def: EEG with focal sharp transient waves in the centrotemporal region of the brain (also known as the central sulcus), i.e., focal sharp waves of a duration less than 80 msec followed by a slow wave.

name: abnormal t3 / t4 ratio
abnormal t3 / t4 ratio
HP:0012558.def: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that deviates from normal.

name: increased t3 / t4 ratio
increase t3 / t4 ratio
HP:0012559.def: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that is higher than normal.

name: decreased t3 / t4 ratio
decrease t3 / t4 ratio
HP:0012560.def: A ratio of serum triiodothyronine (T3) to thyroxine (T4) in the blood that is lower than normal.

name: unicuspid aortic valve
unicuspid aortic valve
HP:0012561.def: The presence of an aortic valve with one instead of the normal three cusps (flaps).

name: premature epimetaphyseal fusion in hand
premature epimetaphyseal fusion in hand
HP:0012562.def: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the hand, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

name: premature epimetaphyseal fusion in foot
premature epimetaphyseal fusion in foot
HP:0012563.def: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the foot, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

name: premature epimetaphyseal fusion in tibia
premature epimetaphyseal fusion in tibia
HP:0012564.def: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the tibia, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

name: premature epimetaphyseal fusion in fibula
premature epimetaphyseal fusion in fibula
HP:0012565.def: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the fibula, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

name: premature epimetaphyseal fusion in radius
premature epimetaphyseal fusion in radius
HP:0012566.def: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the radius, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

name: premature epimetaphyseal fusion in ulna
premature epimetaphyseal fusion in ulna
HP:0012567.def: Stop of growth at the epiphyseal plate the hyaline cartilage plate in the metaphysis at one or more long bones in the ulna, at an earlier than normal age, resulting in growth arrest and shortening of the involved bone.

name: lower eyelid edema
low eyelid edema
HP:0012568.def: Edema in the region of the Lower eyelid.

name: delayed menarche
delay menarche
HP:0012569.def: First period after the age of 15 years.

name: synovial sarcoma
synovial sarcoma
HP:0012570.def: A type of mesenchymal tissue cell tumor that exhibits epithelial differentiation, which most frequently arises in the extremities.

name: ureter fissus
ureter fissus
HP:0012571.def: A partial duplication of the ureter where the duplicated ureters fuse to a single ureter before their insertion into the bladder.

name: ureter duplex
ureter duplex
HP:0012572.def: A complete duplication of the ureter, where the duplicated ureters have separate insertions into the bladder.

name: global proximal tubulopathy
global proximal tubulopathy
HP:0012573.def: A type of proximal renal tubulopathy characterized by resorption defects leading to glycosuria, aminoaciduria, tubular proteinuria, renal hypophosphatemia, and urate tubular hyporeabsorption with bicarbonate loss and resulting acidosis.

name: mesangial hypercellularity
mesangial hypercellularity
HP:0012574.def: Increased numbers of mesangial cells per glomerulus, defined as more than 3 nuclei fully surrounded by matrix in one or more mesangial areas, not including perihilar region, on a standard 3-micron-thick tissue section, best evaluated on periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) stain.

name: abnormal nephron morphology
abnormal nephron morphology
HP:0012575.def: A structural anomaly of the nephron.

name: glomerular c3 deposition
glomerular c3 deposition
HP:0012576.def: The presence of complement 3 deposits in the glomerulus.

name: thin glomerular basement membrane
thin glomerular basement membrane
HP:0012577.def: Decreased thickness of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to a decrease in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations less than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals. May be focal or diffuse, although the term thin GBMs generally implies thinning of over 50% of GBMs.

name: membranous nephropathy
membranous nephropathy
HP:0012578.def: A type of glomerulonephropathy characterized by thickening of the basement membrane and deposition of immune complexes in the subepithelial space.

name: minimal change glomerulonephritis
minimal change glomerulonephritis
HP:0012579.def: The presence of minimal changes visible by light microscopy but flattened and fused podocyte foot processes on electron microscopy in a person with nephrotic range proteinuria.

name: calcium phosphate nephrolithiasis
calcium phosphate nephrolithiasis
HP:0012580.def: The presence of calcium- and phosphate-containing calculi (stones) in the kidneys.

name: simple renal cyst
simple renal cyst
HP:0012581.def: An isolated cyst of the kidney.

name: bilateral renal dysplasia
bilateral renal dysplasia
HP:0012582.def: A bilateral form of developmental dysplasia of the kidney.

name: unilateral renal hypoplasia
unilateral renal hypoplasia
HP:0012583.def: One sided hypoplasia of the kidney.

name: bilateral renal hypoplasia
bilateral renal hypoplasia
HP:0012584.def: Two sided hypoplasia of the kidney.

name: bilateral renal atrophy
bilateral renal atrophy
HP:0012586.def: A two-sided form of atrophy of the kidney.

name: macroscopic hematuria
macroscopic hematuria
HP:0012587.def: Hematuria that is visible upon inspection of the urine.

name: steroid - resistant nephrotic syndrome
steroid - resistant nephrotic syndrome
HP:0012588.def: A form of nephrotic syndrome that does not respond to treatment with steroid medication, defined as persistent proteinuria despite 60mg/m2 or 2mg/kg for 8 weeks, after insuring no infection or non-adherence to medication.

name: multidrug - resistant nephrotic syndrome
multidrug - resistant nephrotic syndrome
HP:0012589.def: A form of nephrotic syndrome that does not respond to any immunosuppresive treatment.

name: abnormal urine output
abnormal urine output
HP:0012590.def: An abnormal amount of urine production.

name: abnormal urinary electrolyte concentration
abnormal urinary electrolyte concentration
HP:0012591.def: An abnormality in the concentration of electrolytes in the urine.

name: albuminuria
albuminuria
HP:0012592.def: Increased concentration of albumin in the urine.

name: nephrotic range proteinuria
nephrotic range proteinuria
HP:0012593.def: Severely increased amount of excretion of protein in the urine, defined as 3.5 grams per day or more in adults and 40 mg per meter-squared body surface area per hour in children.

name: moderate albuminuria
moderate albuminuria
HP:0012594.def: The presence of moderately increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as and albumin-creatinine ratio (ACR) of 30 to 299 mg/gm (3.4 to 34 mg/mmol).

name: mild proteinuria
mild proteinuria
HP:0012595.def: Mildly increased levels of protein in the urine (150-500 mg per day in adults).

name: moderate proteinuria
moderate proteinuria
HP:0012596.def: Moderately increased levels of protein in the urine (500-1000 mg per day in adults).

name: heavy proteinuria
heavy proteinuria
HP:0012597.def: Severely increased levels of protein in the urine (1000-3000 mg per day in adults).

name: abnormal urine potassium concentration
abnormal urine potassium concentration
HP:0012598.def: An abnormal concentration of potassium(1+) in the urine.

name: abnormal urine phosphate concentration
abnormal urine phosphate concentration
HP:0012599.def: An abnormal phosphate concentration in the urine.

name: abnormal urine chloride concentration
abnormal urine chloride concentration
HP:0012600.def: An abnormal concentration of chloride in the urine.

name: hypochloriduria
hypochloriduria
HP:0012601.def: An decreased concentration of chloride in the urine.

name: renal chloride wasting
renal chloride wasting
HP:0012602.def: High urine chloride in the presence of hypochloridemia.

name: abnormal urine sodium concentration
abnormal urine sodium concentration
HP:0012603.def: An abnormal concentration of sodium in the urine.

name: hyponatriuria
hyponatriuria
HP:0012604.def: An abnormally decreased sodium concentration in the urine.

name: hypernatriuria
hypernatriuria
HP:0012605.def: An increased concentration of sodium(1+) in the urine.

name: renal sodium wasting
renal sodium wasting
HP:0012606.def: An abnormally increased sodium concentration in the urine in the presence of hyponatremia.

name: abnormal urine magnesium concentration
abnormal urine magnesium concentration
HP:0012607.def: An abnormal concentration of magnesium the urine.

name: hypermagnesiuria
hypermagnesiuria
HP:0012608.def: An increased concentration of magnesium the urine.

name: hypomagnesiuria
hypomagnesiuria
HP:0012609.def: An decreased concentration of magnesium the urine.

name: abnormality of urinary uric acid level
abnormality of urinary uric acid level
HP:0012610.def: Abnormal amount of urate in the urine.

name: abnormal urinary sulfate concentration
abnormal urinary sulfate concentration
HP:0012612.def: Abnormal concentration of sulfate in the urine.

name: increased urinary sulfate
increase urinary sulfate
HP:0012613.def: Elevated concentration of SO4(2-), i.e., sulfate, in the urine.

name: abnormal urine cytology
abnormal urine cytology
HP:0012614.def: An anomalous finding in the examination of the urine for cells.

name: cylindruria
cylindruria
HP:0012615.def: The presence of renal casts (cylindrical, cigar-shaped structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.

name: leukocyte cylindruria
leukocyte cylindruria
HP:0012616.def: Presence of leukocyte casts (cylindrical structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.

name: erythrocyte cylindruria
erythrocyte cylindruria
HP:0012617.def: Presence of erythrocyte casts (cylindrical structures produced by the kidney in certain disease states) in the urine.

name: urachal cyst
urachal cyst
HP:0012618.def: A cyst located along the allantois canal.

name: multiple bladder diverticula
multiple bladder diverticulum
HP:0012619.def: Presence of a many diverticula (sac or pouch) in the wall of the urinary bladder.

name: cloacal abnormality
cloacal abnormality
HP:0012620.def: A developmental anomaly associated with the failure of rectum, vagina, and bladder to separate.

name: persistent cloaca
persistent cloaca
HP:0012621.def: Developmental anomaly in which the vagina, bladder, and rectum fuse resulting in a common channel.

name: chronic kidney disease
chronic kidney disease
HP:0012622.def: Functional anomaly of the kidney persisting for at least three months.

name: stage 1 chronic kidney disease
stage 1 chronic kidney disease
HP:0012623.def: A type of chronic kidney disease with normal or increased glomerular filtration rate (GFR at least 90 mL/min/1.73 m2).

name: stage 2 chronic kidney disease
stage 2 chronic kidney disease
HP:0012624.def: A type of chronic kidney disease with mildly reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 60-89 mL/min/1.73 m2).

name: stage 3 chronic kidney disease
stage 3 chronic kidney disease
HP:0012625.def: A type of chronic kidney disease with moderately reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 30-59 mL/min/1.73 m2).

name: stage 4 chronic kidney disease
stage 4 chronic kidney disease
HP:0012626.def: A type of chronic kidney disease with severely reduced glomerular filtration rate (GFR 15-29 mL/min/1.73 m2).

name: pseudoexfoliation
pseudoexfoliation
HP:0012627.def: Deposition of fibrillar material that can be found on all anterior segment structures bathed by aqueous humor.

name: abnormal suspensory ligament of lens morphology
abnormal suspensory ligament of lens morphology
HP:0012628.def: An anomaly of the suspensory ligament of lens, also known as the ciliary zonule. These ligaments represent a series of fibers connecting the ciliary body and lens of the eye, holding the lens in place.
synonym: abnormality of the suspensory ligament of lens
abnormality of the suspensory ligament of lens

name: phakodonesis
phakodonesis
HP:0012629.def: Tremulousness (trembling) of the lens of the eye.

name: abnormal trabecular meshwork morphology
abnormal trabecular meshwork morphology
HP:0012630.def: An anomaly of the trabecular meshwork, which is the porelike structure surrounding the entire circumference of the anterior chamber at the base of the cornea and near the ciliary body. The trabecular mesh work is responsible for draining the aqueous humor into the canal of Schlemm.

name: pigment deposition in the trabecular meshwork
pigment deposition in the trabecular meshwork
HP:0012631.def: Accumulation of abnormal amounts of pigment within the trabecular meshwork.

name: abnormal intraocular pressure
abnormal intraocular pressure
HP:0012632.def: An anomaly in the amount of force per unit area exerted by the intraocular fluid within the eye.

name: asymmetry of intraocular pressure
asymmetry of intraocular pressure
HP:0012633.def: A difference in the amount of intraocular pressure in the right and left eye.

name: iris pigment dispersion
iris pigment dispersion
HP:0012634.def: Shedding of the pigment granules that normally adhere to the back of the iris into the aqueous humor.

name: iris hypoperfusion
iris hypoperfusion
HP:0012635.def: Reduction in the amount of blood flow to the iris.

name: renal calcium wasting
renal calcium wasting
HP:0012637.def: High urine calcium in the presence of hypocalcemia.

name: abnormal nervous system physiology
abnormal nervous system physiology
HP:0012638.def: A functional anomaly of the nervous system.

name: abnormal nervous system morphology
abnormal nervous system morphology
HP:0012639.def: A structural anomaly of the nervous system.

name: abnormality of intracranial pressure
abnormality of intracranial pressure
HP:0012640.def: A deviation from the norm of the intracranial pressure.

name: decreased intracranial pressure
decrease intracranial pressure
HP:0012641.def: A reduction of the pressure inside the cranium (skull) and thereby in the brain tissue and cerebrospinal fluid.

name: cerebellar agenesis
cerebellar agenesis
HP:0012642.def: Cerebellar agenesis is defined by the near complete absence of cerebellar tissue with only remnants of the anterior vermis, flocculus, and/or middle cerebellar peduncles.

name: foveal hypopigmentation
foveal hypopigmentation
HP:0012643.def: Decreased amount of pigmentation in the fovea centralis.

name: increased caudate lactate level
increase caudate lactate level
HP:0012644.def: An elevated concentration of lactate in the caudate nucleus. This finding can be elicited by magnetic resonance spectroscopy imaging.

name: enlarged peripheral nerve
enlarged peripheral nerve
HP:0012645.def: Increase in size of a peripheral nerve. This finding can be appreciated by palpation along the axis of the nerve.

name: retractile testis
retractile testis
HP:0012646.def: A testis that is located at the upper scrotum or lower inguinal canal and that can be made to descend completely into the scrotum without resistance by manual reduction but returns to its original position by the cremasteric reflex.

name: abnormal inflammatory response
abnormal inflammatory response
HP:0012647.def: Any anomaly of the inflammatory response, a response to injury or infection characterized by local vasodilation, extravasation of plasma into intercellular spaces and accumulation of white blood cells and macrophages.

name: decreased inflammatory response
decreased inflammatory response
HP:0012648.def: An abnormal reduction in the inflammatory response to injury or infection.

name: increased inflammatory response
increased inflammatory response
HP:0012649.def: A abnormal increase in the inflammatory response to injury or infection.

name: perisylvian polymicrogyria
perisylvian polymicrogyria
HP:0012650.def: Polymicrogyria (an excessive number of small gyri or convolutions) that is maximal in perisylvian regions (the regions that surround the Sylvian fissures), which may be symmetric or asymmetric and may extend beyond perisylvian regions. The Sylvian fissures often extend posteriorly and superiorly.

name: abasia
abasia
HP:0012651.def: A severe form of gait ataxia such that an affected person cannot walk at all.

name: status asthmaticus
status asthmaticus
HP:0012653.def: Severe asthma unresponsive to repeated courses of beta-agonist therapy such as inhaled albuterol, levalbuterol, or subcutaneous epinephrine.

name: abnormal csf dopamine concentration
abnormal csf dopamine concentration
HP:0012654.def: Abnormal concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: elevated csf dopamine concentration
elevate csf dopamine concentration
HP:0012655.def: Increased concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: reduced csf dopamine concentration
reduce csf dopamine concentration
HP:0012656.def: Decreased concentration of dopamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: abnormal brain positron emission tomography
abnormal brain positron emission tomography
HP:0012657.def: A functional brain anomaly detectable by positron emission tomography (PET). PET scanning is a method for functional brain imaging, and its measurements reflect the amount of brain activity in the various regions of the brain.

name: abnormal brain fdg positron emission tomography
abnormal brain fdg positron emission tomography
HP:0012658.def: An anomaly detectable in [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography (PET) brain scans. Glucose uptake measured with FDG-PET is a marker of neuronal metabolic activity.

name: prefrontal hypometabolism in fdg pet
prefrontal hypometabolism in fdg pet
HP:0012659.def: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the prefrontal cortex as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.

name: thalamic hypometabolism in fdg pet
thalamic hypometabolism in fdg pet
HP:0012660.def: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the thalamus as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.

name: hypothalamic hypometabolism in fdg pet
hypothalamic hypometabolism in fdg pet
HP:0012661.def: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the hypothalamus as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.

name: parietal hypometabolism in fdg pet
parietal hypometabolism in fdg pet
HP:0012662.def: Reduced uptake of [18F]-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) in the parietal cortex as measured by positron emission tomography (PET) brain scan.

name: mildly reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
mildly reduce leave ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0012663.def: A small reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle. The normal range in adults is at least 50 percent, and a mild reduction is defined as 40-49 percent.

name: reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
reduce leave ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0012664.def: A diminution of the volumetric fraction of blood pumped out of the ventricle with each cardiac cycle.

name: moderately reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
moderately reduce leave ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0012665.def: A medium reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle, defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction of 30-39 percent.

name: severely reduced left ventricular ejection fraction
severely reduce leave ventricular ejection fraction
HP:0012666.def: A large reduction in the fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each cardiac cycle. The normal range in adults is at over 50 percent, and a severe reduction is defined as less than 30 percent.

name: regional left ventricular wall motion abnormality
regional leave ventricular wall motion abnormality
HP:0012667.def: An abnormal motion of a segment of the left ventricle during the cardiac cycle.

name: carotid sinus syncope
carotid sinus syncope
HP:0012669.def: An exaggerated response to carotid sinus baroreceptor stimulation resulting in syncope from transient diminished cerebral perfusion.

name: orthostatic syncope
orthostatic syncope
HP:0012670.def: Syncope following a quick change in position from lying down to standing.

name: abulia
abulia
HP:0012671.def: Abulia is a severe form of apathy, characterized by difficulty in initiating and sustaining spontaneous movements, as well as reductions in emotional responsiveness, spontaneous speech, and social interaction.

name: akinetic mutism
akinetic mutism
HP:0012672.def: Akinetic mutism is essentially characterized by a total absence of spontaneous behavior and speech occurring in the presence of preserved visual tracking.

name: aplasia of the upper vagina
aplasia of the upper vagina
HP:0012673.def: A failure to develop of the upper vagina.

name: aplasia of the lower vagina
aplasia of the low vagina
HP:0012674.def: A failure to develop of the lower part of the vagina.

name: iron accumulation in brain
iron accumulation in brain
HP:0012675.def: An abnormal build up of iron (Fe) in brain tissue.

name: copper accumulation in brain
copper accumulation in brain
HP:0012676.def: An anomalous build up of copper (Cu) in the brain.

name: obsolete iron accumulation in globus pallidus
obsolete iron accumulation in globus pallidus
iron accumulation in substantia nigra
iron accumulation in substantia nigra
HP:0012678.def: An anomalous build up of iron (Fe) in the substantia nigra.

name: widened interpedicular distance
widen interpedicular distance
HP:0012679.def: An increase in the distance between vertebral pedicles, which are the two short, thick processes, which project backward, one on either side, from the upper part of the vertebral body, at the junction of its posterior and lateral surfaces.

name: abnormality of the pineal gland
abnormality of the pineal gland
HP:0012680.def: An anomaly of the pineal gland,a small endocrine gland in the brain that produces melatonin.

name: abnormal pineal morphology
abnormal pineal morphology
HP:0012681.def: A structural abnormality of the pineal gland.

name: pineal gland calcification
pineal gland calcification
HP:0012682.def: Accumulation of calcium salts in the pineal gland.

name: pineal cyst
pineal cyst
HP:0012683.def: A glial uniloculated or multiloculated fluid-filled sac that either reside within or completely replace the pineal gland.

name: abnormal pineal volume
abnormal pineal volume
HP:0012684.def: An abnormal increase or decrease in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.

name: decreased pineal volume
decreased pineal volume
HP:0012685.def: An abnormal reduction in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.

name: increased pineal volume
increase pineal volume
HP:0012686.def: An abnormal elevation in the quantity of three-dimensional space taken up by the pineal gland.

name: agenesis of pineal gland
agenesis of pineal gland
HP:0012687.def: Failure to develop of the pineal gland, defined clinically as the absence of the pineal gland with no indication of the pineal gland even having been present.

name: abnormality of pineal physiology
abnormality of pineal physiology
HP:0012688.def: A functional abnormality of the pineal gland.

name: abnormal pineal melatonin secretion
abnormal pineal melatonin secretion
HP:0012689.def: An anomaly in the amount or timing of melatonin secretion by the pineal gland. Note that melatonin is also synthesized by multiple tissues outside of the pineal gland.

name: t2 hypointense thalamus
t2 hypointense thalamus
HP:0012690.def: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting the entire thalamus.

name: focal t2 hypointense thalamic lesion
focal t2 hypointense thalamic lesion
HP:0012691.def: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the thalamus.

name: focal t2 hyperintense thalamic lesion
focal t2 hyperintense thalamic lesion
HP:0012692.def: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the thalamus.

name: abnormal thalamic size
abnormal thalamic size
HP:0012693.def: Deviation from the normal range of size of the thalamus.

name: enlarged thalamic volume
enlarged thalamic volume
HP:0012694.def: An increase in the quantity of space occupied by the thalamus.

name: decreased thalamic volume
decreased thalamic volume
HP:0012695.def: A reduction in the quantity of space occupied by the thalamus.

name: abnormal thalamic mri signal intensity
abnormal thalamic mri signal intensity
HP:0012696.def: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thalamus.

name: small basal ganglia
small basal ganglion
HP:0012697.def: Decreased size of the basal ganglia.

name: cerebellar gliosis
cerebellar gliosis
HP:0012698.def: Focal proliferation of glial cells in the cerebellum.

name: anomaly of lower limb diaphyses
anomaly of low limb diaphysis
HP:0012699.def: A structural abnormality of a diaphysis of the leg.
synonym: anomaly of shaft of long bone of lower limb
anomaly of shaft of long bone of low limb

name: abnormal large intestine physiology
abnormal large intestine physiology
HP:0012700.def: A functional anomaly of the large intestine.

name: bowel urgency
bowel urgency
HP:0012701.def: A sudden, irresistible need to have a bowel movement.

name: tenesmus
tenesmus
HP:0012702.def: A repeated, painful urge to defecate without excreting stool.

name: abnormal subarachnoid space morphology
abnormal subarachnoid space morphology
HP:0012703.def: Abnormality in the space in the meninges beneath the arachnoid membrane and above the pia mater that contains the cerebrospinal fluid.

name: widened subarachnoid space
widen subarachnoid space
HP:0012704.def: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater.

name: abnormal metabolic brain imaging by mrs
abnormal metabolic brain imaging by mr
HP:0012705.def: An anomaly of metabolism in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: elevated brain choline level by mrs
elevate brain choline level by mr
HP:0012706.def: An increase in the level of choline-containing compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: elevated brain lactate level by mrs
elevate brain lactate level by mr
HP:0012707.def: An increase in the level of lactate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: reduced brain n - acetyl aspartate level by mrs
reduce brain n - acetyl aspartate level by mr
HP:0012708.def: A decrease in the level of N-acetyl aspartate in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).
synonym: mr spectroscopy : n - acetylaspartate low in brain
mr spectroscopy : n - acetylaspartate low in brain
reduced brain n - acetyl aspartate level by magnetic resonance spectroscopy
reduce brain n - acetyl aspartate level by magnetic resonance spectroscopy

name: abnormal brain choline / creatine ratio by mrs
abnormal brain choline / creatine ratio by mr
HP:0012709.def: A deviation from normal in the ratio of choline to creatine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: ingrown nail
ingrown nail
HP:0012710.def: Excessive growth of a nail laterally into the nail fold.

name: delayed ossification of vertebral epiphysis
delay ossification of vertebral epiphysis
HP:0012711.def: A delay in the process of formation and maturation of the epiphysis of one or more vertebrae.
synonym: delayed maturation of the end part of the vertebral bone
delay maturation of the end part of the vertebral bone

name: mild hearing impairment
mild hearing impairment
HP:0012712.def: The presence of a mild form of hearing impairment.

name: moderate hearing impairment
moderate hearing impairment
HP:0012713.def: The presence of a moderate form of hearing impairment.

name: severe hearing impairment
severe hearing impairment
HP:0012714.def: A severe form of hearing impairment.

name: profound hearing impairment
profound hear impairment
HP:0012715.def: A profound (essentially complete) form of hearing impairment.

name: moderate conductive hearing impairment
moderate conductive hearing impairment
HP:0012716.def: The presence of a moderate form of conductive hearing impairment.

name: severe conductive hearing impairment
severe conductive hearing impairment
HP:0012717.def: A severe form of conductive hearing impairment.

name: abnormal gastrointestinal tract morphology
abnormal gastrointestinal tract morphology
HP:0012718.def: Abnormal structure of the gastrointestinal tract.
synonym: abnormal shape of the digestive system
abnormal shape of the digestive system
morphological abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
morphological abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
morphological abnormality of the gi tract
morphological abnormality of the gi tract
morphological anomaly of the digestive system
morphological anomaly of the digestive system

name: functional abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
functional abnormality of the gastrointestinal tract
HP:0012719.def: Abnormal functionality of the gastrointestinal tract.
synonym: functional abnormality of the gi tract
functional abnormality of the gi tract

name: neoplasm of the nose
neoplasm of the nose
HP:0012720.def: Tumor (An abnormal mass of tissue resulting from abnormally dividing cells) of the nasal cavity.

name: venous malformation
venous malformation
HP:0012721.def: A vascular malformation resulting from a developmental error of venous tissue composed of dysmorphic channels lined by flattened endothelium and exhibiting slow turnover. A venous malformation may present as a blue patch on the skin ranging to a soft blue mass. Venous malformations are easily compressible and usually swell in thewhen venous pressure increases (e.g., when held in a dependent position or when a child cries). They may be relatively localized or quite extensive within an anatomic region.

name: heart block
heart block
HP:0012722.def: Impaired conduction of cardiac impulse occurring anywhere along the conduction pathway.

name: sinoatrial block
sinoatrial block
HP:0012723.def: Disturbance in the atrial activation that is caused by transient failure of impulse conduction from the sinoatrial node to the cardiac atria.

name: upper eyelid edema
upper eyelid edema
HP:0012724.def: Edema in the region of the upper eyelid.

name: cutaneous syndactyly
cutaneous syndactyly
HP:0012725.def: A soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits that extends distally to at least the level of the proximal interphalangeal joints, or a soft tissue continuity in the A/P axis between two digits that lies significantly distal to the flexion crease that overlies the metacarpophalangeal or metatarsophalangeal joint of the adjacent digits.

name: episodic hypokalemia
episodic hypokalemia
HP:0012726.def: An abnormally decreased potassium concentration in the blood occurring periodically with a return to normal between the episodes.

name: thoracic aortic aneurysm
thoracic aortic aneurysm
HP:0012727.def: An abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the thoracic aorta.

name: fusiform descending thoracic aortic aneurysm
fusiform descend thoracic aortic aneurysm
HP:0012728.def: A concentric abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the descending thoracic aorta that involves the full circumference of the vessel wall
synonym: dilatation of the fusiform descending thoracic aorta
dilatation of the fusiform descend thoracic aorta

name: saccular descending thoracic aortic aneurysm
saccular descend thoracic aortic aneurysm
HP:0012729.def: An eccentric abnormal localized widening (dilatation) of the descending thoracic aorta that involves only a portion of the circumference of the vessel wall
synonym: dilatation of the saccular descending thoracic aorta
dilatation of the saccular descending thoracic aorta

name: aglossia
aglossia
HP:0012730.def: Absence of the tongue owing to a developmental abnormality.

name: ectopic anterior pituitary gland
ectopic anterior pituitary gland
HP:0012731.def: Abnormal anatomic location of the anterior pituitary gland.

name: anorectal anomaly
anorectal anomaly
HP:0012732.def: An abnormality of the anus or rectum.

name: macule
macule
HP:0012733.def: A flat, distinct, discolored area of skin less than 1 cm wide that does not involve any change in the thickness or texture of the skin.

name: ketotic hypoglycemia
ketotic hypoglycemia
HP:0012734.def: Low blood glucose is accompanied by elevated levels of ketone bodies in the body.

name: cough
cough
HP:0012735.def: A sudden, audible expulsion of air from the lungs through a partially closed glottis, preceded by inhalation.

name: profound global developmental delay
profound global developmental delay
HP:0012736.def: A profound delay in the achievement of motor or mental milestones in the domains of development of a child.

name: small intestinal polyp
small intestinal polyp
HP:0012737.def: A discrete abnormal tissue mass that protrudes into the lumen of the small intestine and is attached to the intestinal wall either by a stalk, pedunculus, or a broad base.

name: agenesis of canine
agenesis of canine
synonym: failure of development of eye tooth
failure of development of eye tooth

name: agenesis of the small intestine
agenesis of the small intestine
HP:0012739.def: Failure to develop of the small intestine.

name: papilloma
papilloma
HP:0012740.def: A tumor of the skin or mucous membrane with finger-like projections.

name: unilateral cryptorchidism
unilateral cryptorchidism
HP:0012741.def: Absence of a testis from the scrotum on one side owing to failure of the testis or testes to descend through the inguinal canal to the scrotum.

name: thin fingernail
thin fingernail
HP:0012742.def: Fingernail that appears thin when viewed on end.

name: abdominal obesity
abdominal obesity
HP:0012743.def: Excessive fat around the stomach and abdomen.

name: femoral aplasia
femoral aplasia
HP:0012744.def: Failure of the femur to develop.

name: short palpebral fissure
short palpebral fissure
HP:0012745.def: Distance between the medial and lateral canthi is more than 2 SD below the mean for age (objective); or, apparently reduced length of the palpebral fissures.

name: thin toenail
thin toenail
HP:0012746.def: Toenail that appears thin when viewed on end.

name: abnormal brainstem mri signal intensity
abnormal brainstem mri signal intensity
HP:0012747.def: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem.

name: focal t2 hyperintense brainstem lesion
focal t2 hyperintense brainstem lesion
HP:0012748.def: A lighter than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a localized hyperintensity affecting a particular region of the brainstem.

name: focal t2 hypointense brainstem lesion
focal t2 hypointense brainstem lesion
HP:0012749.def: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the brainstem.

name: t2 hypointense brainstem
t2 hypointense brainstem
HP:0012750.def: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brainstem. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting the entire brainstem.

name: abnormal basal ganglia mri signal intensity
abnormal basal ganglion mri signal intensity
HP:0012751.def: A deviation from normal signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia.

name: focal t2 hypointense basal ganglia lesion
focal t2 hypointense basal ganglion lesion
HP:0012752.def: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a localized hypointensity affecting a particular region of the basal ganglia.

name: t2 hypointense basal ganglia
t2 hypointense basal ganglion
HP:0012753.def: A darker than expected T2 signal on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the basal ganglia. This term refers to a diffuse hypointensity affecting all of the basal ganglia.

name: cns hypermyelination
cns hypermyelination
HP:0012754.def: Increased amount of myelin in the central nervous system.

name: enlarged brainstem
enlarge brainstem
HP:0012755.def: Abnormal increase in size of the brainstem.

name: csf polymorphonuclear pleocytosis
csf polymorphonuclear pleocytosis
HP:0012756.def: An increased polymorphonuclear cell count in the cerebrospinal fluid.

name: abnormal neuron morphology
abnormal neuron morphology
HP:0012757.def: A structural anomaly of a neuron. Neurons are electrically excitable cells that transmit signals throughout the body. Neurons employ both electrical and chemical components in the transmission of information. Neurons are connected to other neurons at synapses and connected to effector organs or cells at neuroeffector junctions.

name: neurodevelopmental delay
neurodevelopmental delay
HP:0012758.def: Neurodevelopmental delay (NDD) refers to delays in the maturation of the brain and central nervous system; infants and young children with NDD may experience delays in the development of one or more skills including gross motor abilities, fine-motor coordination, language abilities and ability to solve increasingly complex problems.

name: neurodevelopmental abnormality
neurodevelopmental abnormality
HP:0012759.def: A deviation from normal of the neurological development of a child, which may include any or all of the aspects of the development of personal, social, gross or fine motor, and cognitive abilities.

name: reduced social reciprocity
reduce social reciprocity
HP:0012760.def: A reduced ability to participate in the back-and-forth flow of social interaction appropriate to culture and developmental level, which is normally characterized by an influence of the behavior of one person on the behavior of another person.

name: absent mastoid
absent mastoid
HP:0012761.def: A developmental anomaly in which the mastoid process fails to form and is thus found to be congenitally absent.

name: cerebral white matter atrophy
cerebral white matter atrophy
HP:0012762.def: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the cerebral white matter.

name: paroxysmal dyspnea
paroxysmal dyspnea
HP:0012763.def: A sudden attack of dyspnea that occurs while the affected person is at rest.

name: orthopnea
orthopnea
HP:0012764.def: A sensation of breathlessness in the recumbent position, relieved by sitting or standing.

name: widened cerebellar subarachnoid space
widen cerebellar subarachnoid space
HP:0012765.def: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater in the region surrounding the cerebellum.

name: widened cerebral subarachnoid space
widen cerebral subarachnoid space
HP:0012766.def: An increase in size of the anatomic space between the arachnoid membrane and pia mater in the region surrounding the cerebrum.

name: abnormal placental size
abnormal placental size
HP:0012767.def: A deviation from normal size of the placenta.

name: abnormal arm span
abnormal arm span
HP:0012769.def: A deviation from normal of the length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle)

name: reduced arm span
reduce arm span
HP:0012770.def: Decreased length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle).

name: increased arm span
increase arm span
HP:0012771.def: Increased length of the arm span (length from one end of an individual's arms measured at the fingertips to the other when raised parallel to the ground at shoulder height at a one-hundred eighty degree angle).

name: abnormal upper to lower segment ratio
abnormal upper to lower segment ratio
HP:0012772.def: A deviation from normal of the relation between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis.

name: reduced upper to lower segment ratio
reduce upper to lower segment ratio
HP:0012773.def: Decreased ratio between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis. Consider the term Disproportionate tall stature (HP:0001519) if tall stature is also present.

name: increased upper to lower segment ratio
increase upper to lower segment ratio
HP:0012774.def: Elevated ratio between the upper and the lower segment of the body, where the lower segment is defined as the length between the top of pubic symphysis to floor, and the upper segment is defined as the top of head to top of pubic symphysis.

name: stellate iris
stellate iris
HP:0012775.def: A lacy pattern or iris pigmentation that resembles the spokes of a bicycle wheel.

name: abnormal ciliary body morphology
abnormal ciliary body morphology
HP:0012776.def: A structural anomaly of the ciliary body.

name: retinal neoplasm
retinal neoplasm
HP:0012777.def: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the retina.

name: retinal astrocytic hamartoma
retinal astrocytic hamartoma
HP:0012778.def: A glial tumor of the retinal nerve fiber layer arising from a retinal astrocyte.

name: transient hearing impairment
transient hearing impairment
HP:0012779.def: Hearing loss that occurs acutely and resolves completely.

name: neoplasm of the ear
neoplasm of the ear
HP:0012780.def: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the ear.

name: mid - frequency hearing loss
mid - frequency hearing loss
HP:0012781.def: A type of hearing impairment affecting primarily the middle frequencies of sound (1000 Hz to 3000 Hz).

name: perilobar nephrogenic rest
perilobar nephrogenic rest
HP:0012782.def: A type of nephrogenic rest associated with multiple lesions in the periphery of the renal lobe.

name: intralobar nephrogenic rest
intralobar nephrogenic rest
HP:0012783.def: A type of nephrogenic rest usually representing single lesions within the renal lobe, renal sinus, or calyceal walls.

name: perinephritis
perinephritis
HP:0012784.def: Inflammation of the connective and adipose tissues surrounding the kidney.

name: flexion contracture of finger
flexion contracture of finger
HP:0012785.def: Chronic loss of joint motion in a finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue.

name: recurrent cystitis
recurrent cystitis
HP:0012786.def: Repeated infections of the urinary bladder.

name: reticulate pigmentation of oral mucosa
reticulate pigmentation of oral mucosa
HP:0012788.def: A net-like pattern of increased pigmentation of the oral cavity.
synonym: reticulate pigmentation of oral mucous membrane
reticulate pigmentation of oral mucous membrane

name: abnormal intramembranous ossification
abnormal intramembranous ossification
HP:0012790.def: An anomaly in the process of intramembranous ossification by which flat bones (cranial bones of the skull, i.e., the frontal, parietal, occipital, and temporal bones, and the clavicles) are formed.

name: abnormal humeral ossification
abnormal humeral ossification
HP:0012791.def: An anomaly of the process of formation of bone in the humerus.
synonym: abnormal maturation of long bone in upper arm
abnormal maturation of long bone in upper arm

name: absent ossification of thoracic vertebral bodies
absent ossification of thoracic vertebral body
HP:0012792.def: A lack of bone mineralization of one or more body of thoracic vertebra.

name: kinked brainstem
kink brainstem
HP:0012793.def: A kinked appearance of the brainstem, i.e., an exaggerated flexure.

name: periventricular white matter hypodensities
periventricular white matter hypodensities
HP:0012794.def: Multiple areas of darker than expected signal on magnetic resonance imaging emanating from the cerebral white matter that surrounds the cerebral ventricles.

name: abnormal optic disc morphology
abnormal optic disc morphology
HP:0012795.def: A morphological abnormality of the optic disc, i.e., of the portion of the optic nerve clinically visible on fundoscopic examination.

name: increased cup - to - disc ratio
increase cup - to - disc ratio
HP:0012796.def: An elevation in the ratio of the diameter of the cup of the optic disc to the total diameter of the disc. The optic disc has an orange-pink rim with a pale centre (the cup) that does not contain neuroretinal tissue. An increase in this ratio therefore may indicate a decrease in the quantity of healthy neuroretinal cells.

name: lymphatic vessel neoplasm
lymphatic vessel neoplasm
HP:0012797.def: A benign or malignant neoplasm arising from the lymphatic vessels.

name: pulmonary lymphangiomyomatosis
pulmonary lymphangiomyomatosis
HP:0012798.def: Infiltration of smooth muscle-like cells in lymph vessels as well as the lung (pleura, alveolar septa, bronchi, pulmonary vessels and lymphatics as well as lymph nodes, especially in posterior mediastinum and retroperitoneum). Focal emphysema can develop because of airway narrowing, and the thoracic duct may be obliterated. Pulmonary lymphangiomyomatosis may lead to multiple small cysts with a hamartomatous proliferation of smooth muscle in their walls.

name: unilateral facial palsy
unilateral facial palsy
HP:0012799.def: One-sided weakness of the muscles of facial expression and eye closure.
synonym: paralysis of one side of the face
paralysis of one side of the face
weakness of one side of the face
weakness of one side of the face

name: accessory cranial suture
accessory cranial suture
HP:0012800.def: A cranial suture that is in addition to canonical membrane-covered openings in the incompletely ossified skull of the fetus or newborn infant.

name: narrow jaw
narrow jaw
