prominent nucleolus of renal tubular epithelial cell
HP:0032602.def: Tubular epithelium with nucleoli clearly visible at 100-fold magnification.

name: renal tubular epithelial cell simplification
renal tubular epithelial cell simplification
HP:0032603.def: Tubular cross section with flattened tubular cell cytoplasm (height unequivocally less than width), with complete loss of brush border involving greater than 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section, resulting in an apparent increase in the size of the lumen, without the presence of casts.

name: renal tubular epithelial cell mitosis
renal tubular epithelial cell mitosis
HP:0032604.def: Tubular epithelial cells in any mitotic phase, identified by distinctively visible chromosome in either prophase, metaphase, anaphase or telophase configuration.

name: high renal tubular epithelial cell n / c ratio
high renal tubular epithelial cell n / c ratio
HP:0032605.def: At least one tubular epithelial cell with average sized cytoplasmic area and a nuclear area 3 times greater than average sized nuclei.
synonym: high n / c ratio of renal tubular epithelial cells
high n / c ratio of renal tubular epithelial cell

name: renal tubular epithelial lipofuscin
renal tubular epithelial lipofuscin
HP:0032606.def: Presence of increased amount of lipofuscin, a yellow, granular cytoplasmic pigment in the renal tubules.

name: renal tubular epithelial cell swelling
renal tubular epithelial cell swell
HP:0032607.def: Tubular cross section lined entirely by tubular epithelium with convex apical cell membrane (i.e., cells are shaped like an upside down U, and lack a distinct smaller protrusion seen in blebbing as defined above) resulting in apparent complete closure of the lumen.

name: thyroidization - type tubular atrophy
thyroidization - type tubular atrophy
HP:0032608.def: A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by a thyroid-like appearance, with small round tubules with markedly flattened, simplified epithelium and uniform intratubular casts.

name: endocrine - type tubular atrophy
endocrine - type tubular atrophy
HP:0032609.def: A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by endocrine-like appearance of tubules, which are small and have narrow lumina, clear cells, and relatively thin basement membranes.

name: tubulointerstitial mycobacterial infiltration
tubulointerstitial mycobacterial infiltration
HP:0032610.def: Renal tubulointerstitial infiltration of mycobacteria identified on acid-fast or Fite stains. Can be associated with granulomatous inflammation.

name: renal tubular epithelial cell hemosiderin
renal tubular epithelial cell hemosiderin
HP:0032611.def: Tubular epithelial cells containing cytoplasmic hemosiderin, brown-golden granular pigment.

name: triphalangeal hallux
triphalangeal hallux
HP:0032612.def: A hallux (big toe) with three phalanges in a single, proximo-distal axis.

name: renal interstitial amyloid deposits
renal interstitial amyloid deposit
HP:0032613.def: Deposition of amyloid in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Amyloid is is made up of 10 nm (on average) fibrils that are most commonly composed of monoclonal light chains (AL), transthyretin (TTR), amd LECT2, or occur in the setting of long standing systemic inflammation.

name: renal glomerular amyloid deposition
renal glomerular amyloid deposition
HP:0032614.def: Amyloid deposits located in the glomeruli in a focal segmental, diffuse segmental or diffuse global fashion. This abnormality can be accompanied by mesangial involvement and in later stages also involvement of the peripheral capillaries.

name: abnormal diffusion weighted cerebral mri morphology
abnormal diffusion weight cerebral mri morphology
HP:0032615.def: A diffusion abnormality observed in diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain. Molecular diffusion refers to the notion that any type of molecule in a fluid (eg, water) is randomly displaced as the molecule is agitated by thermal energy. Restricted diffusion of water appears bright on diffusion-weighted images.
synonym: diffusion weighted magnetic resonance imaging ( dwi ) abnormality
diffusion weight magnetic resonance imaging ( dwi ) abnormality
mri diffusion abnormality of the cerebrum
mri diffusion abnormality of the cerebrum

name: renal interstitial immunoglobulin deposits
renal interstitial immunoglobulin deposit
HP:0032616.def: Accumulation of an immunoglobulin in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. The immunoglobulin may be a monoclonal Ig or the corresponding heavy-chain (HC) or light-chain (LC) subunit. By convention this definition excludes Ig-derived amyloidosis (amyloidosis can be distinguished by its affinity for Congo red staining).

name: renal interstitial hemorrhage
renal interstitial hemorrhage
HP:0032617.def: A focal collection of 20 or more red blood cells within the interstitium, that is irregular in shape (i.e., collections do not conform to the shape of tubules or capillary networks), without surrounding endothelium or tubular epithelium, and is in an area of intact core.

name: renal necrosis
renal necrosis
HP:0032618.def: Cell death (necrosis) affecting one or more parts of the kidney.

name: perinephric abscess
perinephric abscess
HP:0032619.def: A perinephric abscess is a collection of suppurative material in the perinephric space (i.e., the connective and adipose tissues surrounding the kidney).

name: intrarenal abscess
intrarenal abscess
HP:0032620.def: An encapsulated collection of pus and necrotic material within the renal parenchyma. The destruction of renal parenchyma is associated with suppurative/neutrophil-rich inflammation and necrosis.

name: hyperchromasia of renal tubular epithelial cells
hyperchromasia of renal tubular epithelial cell
HP:0032621.def: At least one tubular cross section with all tubular epithelial nuclei having a chromatin pattern resembling normal mature lymphocytes.
synonym: condensed chromatin of renal tubular epithelial cells
condense chromatin of renal tubular epithelial cell

name: tubular luminal dilatation
tubular luminal dilatation
HP:0032622.def: Dilatation (expansion beyond the normal dimension) of the cavity (lumen) of tubules of the kidney. The tubular cross section displays an attenuated brush border (apical PAS positivity greater than 10 percent of the normal expected height, but unequivocally less than normal expected height), resulting in an apparent increase in the size of lumen.

name: renal intratubular casts
renal intratubular cast
HP:0032623.def: Urinary casts are formed in the distal convoluted tubule or the collecting duct by solidification of protein in the lumen of the kidney tubules. This term refers to casts located within the tubuli of the kidney. More precisely, casts are defined as a material that completely fills and expands the tubular lumen with simplification of surrounding tubular epithelium. Casts are classified as either nuclear debris/granular brown material, red blood cell, white blood cell, myeloma, or myoglobin cast.

name: intratubular bilirubin casts
intratubular bilirubin cast
HP:0032624.def: A type of acelluar intratubular casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. On H&E (red brown), PAS (amaranth purple), trichrome (red with ragged contours), Hall (olive-emerald green).

name: intratubular erythrocyte cast
intratubular erythrocyte cast
HP:0032625.def: Casts that contain red blood cells and are located within the tubuli of the kidney.

name: intratubular vancomycin casts
intratubular vancomycin cast
HP:0032626.def: Intratubular casts composed of vancomycin aggregates and uromodulin.

name: intratubular leukocyte casts
intratubular leukocyte cast
HP:0032627.def: Casts that contain white blood cells and are located within the tubuli of the kidney.

name: intratubular dihydroxyadenuria crystals
intratubular dihydroxyadenuria crystal
HP:0032629.def: Intratubular crystals composed of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine are small needle-shaped brownish crystals that are highly birefringent under polarized light and black by Jones methenamine silver.

name: intratubular light - chain casts
intratubular light - chain cast
HP:0032630.def: The presence of casts containing immunoglobulin light chains within the lumina of the renal tubules.

name: intratubular hemoglobin casts
intratubular hemoglobin cast
HP:0032631.def: A type of acelluar intratubular casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented. On H&E (red granular), PAS (purple), trichrome (red granular), Hall (yellow brown). Stain positively for Hemoglobin A.

name: renal papillary necrosis
renal papillary necrosis
HP:0032632.def: Premature death of cells in the renal papilla (the apex of a renal pyramid which projects into the cavity of a calyx of the kidney and through which collecting ducts discharge urine). Histologically, one observes pale tissue with typical appearance of coagulative necrosis, affecting the renal papillae. Necrosis can be identified by pyknotic nuclei and simplified, flattened epithelium of proximal tubules. The tubular and glomerular basement membranes are still visible without viable nuclei.

name: intratubular hyaline casts
intratubular hyaline cast
HP:0032633.def: A type of acellular urinary cast located within the distal tubules of the kidney and that is composed only of Tamm-Horsfall glycoprotein. Correspondingly, these casts have a low refractive index. Hyaline casts may display a spectrum of morphologies, which includes fluffy, compact, convoluted or wrinkled casts. Hyaline casts have a smooth texture and usually have parallel sides with clear margins and blunted ends.

name: intratubular myoglobin cast
intratubular myoglobin cast
HP:0032634.def: Casts located within the tubuli of the kidney and that contain myoglobin. Myoglobin casts are composed of round granules that may line up in chains or aggregate in clusters. Their color ranges from pink to red-brown with hematoxylin and eosin stain, light brown to black with Jones methenamine silver stain, pink to bright magenta with periodic acid-Schiff stain, and bright red with trichrome stain. Immunoperoxidase staining with antibody to myoglobin is stronglypositive in the casts.Electron microscopy shows globular casts with an electron-dense core and a somewhat less-intense periphery. Substructure is absent. This feature may be accompanied by acute tubular injury with variable flattening of tubular epithelial cells, loss of brush borders, and intratubular sloughed epithelial cells.

name: tubulointerstitial microganismal infiltration
tubulointerstitial microganismal infiltration
HP:0032635.def: Infiltration of microorganisms into renal tubulointerstitial tissues as observed by appropriate staining procedures, e.g., bacteria on a bacterial stain (Brown and Hopps) or fungi on PAS or silver stain.

name: tubulointerstitial viral infiltration
tubulointerstitial viral infiltration
HP:0032636.def: Infiltration of viruses into renal tubulointerstitial tissues as demonstrated on renal biopsy by viral inclusions which can be seen on routine stains or with immunohistochemistry.

name: renal interstitial edema
renal interstitial edema
HP:0032637.def: Edema is characterized but the acute swelling of the stroma, with expansion of the interstitial space without the a concurrent increase in interstitial cells or extracellular matrix. Histologically this change is appreciated as interstitial areas of lower optical density.

name: elevated urine mevalonic acid level
elevate urine mevalonic acid level
HP:0032638.def: An abnormally increased amount of mevanolate in the urine. Mevanolate is that hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of mevalonic acid.

name: elevated leukocyte cystine
elevate leukocyte cystine
HP:0032639.def: An increased concentration of cystine within white blood cells.

name: elevated circulating ccl18 level
elevate circulate ccl18 level
HP:0032640.def: An increased concentration of C-C motif chemokine ligand 18 in the blood circulation.
synonym: increased c - c motif chemokine ligand 18 concentration
increase c - c motif chemokine ligand 18 concentration

name: renal interstitial granulomas
renal interstitial granuloma
HP:0032641.def: Interstital aggregates of histiciocytes, occasionally multinucleated with associated lymphoplasmacytic and occcasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined and multinucleated giant cells may be present.

name: renal interstitial necrotizing granulomas
renal interstitial necrotizing granuloma
HP:0032642.def: An organized collection of histiocytes (specifically macrophages) localized in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Through light microscopy, the activated histiocytes appear as epithelioid cells with round to oval nuclei, often with irregular contours and abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders. They may also coalesce to form multinucleated giant cells. Granulomas may be associated with a peripheral cuff of lymphoplasmacytic and occcasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined. Granulomas can present as necrotizing or non-necrotizing. Microscopically, necrotizing granulomas distinctly have central necrosis with a palisaded lymphohistiocytic reaction and a cuff of chronic inflammation.

name: renal interstitial non - necrotizing granulomas
renal interstitial non - necrotizing granuloma
HP:0032643.def: Interstital aggregates of histiciocytes, occasionally multinucleated with associated lymphoplasmacytic and occcasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined and multinucleated giant cells may be present with no necrosis.

name: renal interstitial deposits
renal interstitial deposit
HP:0032644.def: Abnormal accumulation of a metabolite, protein, or protein-derived substance in the interstitial region of the kidney.

name: renal interstitial mononuclear cell infiltration
renal interstitial mononuclear cell infiltration
HP:0032645.def: Presence of interstitial mononuclear leukocytes, i.e., white blood ceclls with a single round nucleus, including lymphocytes and monocytes but not including granulocytes (which have multilobed nuclei).

name: renal interstitial xanthogranulomatous inflammation
renal interstitial xanthogranulomatous inflammation
HP:0032646.def: Inflammation of interstitial tissues of the kidney consisting of foamy macrophages admixed with plasma cells, lymphocytes and neutrophils and occasional giant cells.

name: renal tubular epithelial cell apoptosis
renal tubular epithelial cell apoptosis
HP:0032647.def: Increased apoptosis (programmed cell death) of tubular epithelial cells. The cells arre rounded with increased eosinophilia and contain fragmented, densely basophilic nuclear debris.

name: tubularization of bowman capsule
tubularization of bowman capsule
HP:0032648.def: The presence of cuboidal to columnar epithelium (height greater than width) lining the Bowman capsule, in an absence of adjacent segmental sclerosis, crescents, or collapsing variant of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis; scored as present or absent in at least one glomerulus.

name: skewfoot
skewfoot
HP:0032649.def: A type of flat-foot characterized by hindfoot abductovalgus, metatarsus adductus, and Achilles tendon shortening. The predominant radiographic findings include forefoot adduction with lateral subluxation of the navicular on the talus and heel valgus. Very abnormal shoe wear is noted on the medial side. Calluses occurunder the metatarsal heads and thehead of the plantar-flexed talus.

HP:0032651.def: Increased concentration of chitinase-3-like protein 1 in cerebrospinal fluid.

elevate lactate : pyruvate ratio
HP:0032653.def: An abnormal increase in the molar ratio of lactate to pyruvate in the blood circulation.

name: impaired flow - mediated arterial dilatation
impair flow - mediate arterial dilatation
HP:0032654.def: Flow-mediated dilatation is a noninvasive tests of endothelial function that leverages ultrasound to measure arterial diameter and its response to an increase in shear stress, which normally causes endothelium-dependent dilatation. This term pertains to an abnormal reduction in the magnitude of dilatation. Flow-mediated dilatation is usually measured at the brachial artery.

name: decreased adipose tissue tocopherol level
decrease adipose tissue tocopherol level
HP:0032655.def: A reduced concentration of tocopherol in fat tissue.

name: febrile status epilepticus
febrile status epilepticus
HP:0032656.def: A seizure lasting 30 minutes without fully regaining consciousness, provoked by fever (temperature greater than 38.0 degrees Celcius) at the time of seizure-onset, without a prior history of afebrile seizure and with no evidence of an acute central nervous system infection or insult.

name: elevated circulating lyso - globotriaosylsphingosine concentration
elevate circulate lyso - globotriaosylsphingosine concentration
HP:0032657.def: An abnormal increase in the level of globotriaosylsphingosine (Lyso-Gb3) in the blood circulation.

name: status epilepticus with prominent motor symptoms
status epilepticus with prominent motor symptom
HP:0032658.def: Status epilepticus with prominent motor signs during the prolonged seizure.

name: non - convulsive status epilepticus with coma
non - convulsive status epilepticus with coma
HP:0032659.def: A type of status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms and in the presence of coma.

name: convulsive status epilepticus
convulsive status epilepticus
HP:0032660.def: A type of status epilepticus characterized by a prolonged bilateral tonic-clonic seizure, or repeated bilateral tonic-clonic seizures without recovery between.

name: generalized convulsive status epilepticus
generalize convulsive status epilepticus
HP:0032661.def: A type of bilateral convulsive seizure of generalized onset that is sufficiently prolonged (or repeated without recovery) to reach the threshold for status epilepticus.

name: focal - onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
focal - onset seizure evolve into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
HP:0032662.def: A type of bilateral convulsive seizure of focal onset (which could be with awareness or impaired awareness, either motor or non- motor) that is sufficiently prolonged (or repeated without recovery) to reach the threshold for status epilepticus.
synonym: focal onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
focal onset seizure evolve into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus

name: focal motor status epilepticus
focal motor status epilepticus
HP:0032663.def: Status epilepticus with focal motor signs originating within networks limited to one hemisphere. Involves musculature in any form. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement.

name: adversive status epilepticus
adversive status epilepticus
HP:0032664.def: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by continuous neck or body rotation and conjugate gaze deviation in a direction contralateral to the responsible epileptic focus. This includes some forms of tonic status epilepticus.

name: repeated focal motor seizures
repeat focal motor seizure
HP:0032665.def: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repeated motor, typically clonic events repeatedly affecting the same segments of the body with spread of clonic movements through contiguous body parts unilaterally, and repeating over a sufficiently prolonged period to reach a diagnosis of status epilepticus.

name: hyperkinetic status epilepticus
hyperkinetic status epilepticus
HP:0032666.def: Status epilepticus characterized by continuous hyperkinetic proximal limb or axial muscles producing irregular sequential ballistic movements such as pedaling pelvic thrusting, thrashing, or rocking movements.

name: myoclonic status epilepticus
myoclonic status epilepticus
HP:0032667.def: A type of motor status epilepticus with repeating bilateral sudden brief (less than 100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography.

HP:0032668.def: A type of myoclonic status epilepticus in the absence of coma.

name: myoclonic status epilepticus with coma
myoclonic status epilepticus with coma
HP:0032669.def: A type of myoclonic status epilepticus in the presence of coma.

name: tonic status epilepticus
tonic status epilepticus
HP:0032670.def: Tonic status epilepticus is a type of status epilepticus characterized by focal or bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, which may be electrographically generalized or focal.

name: non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
HP:0032671.def: A type of status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms in the absence of coma.

name: autonomic status epilepticus
autonomic status epilepticus
HP:0032672.def: Autonomic status epilepticus is a type of non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma with prominent autonomic features regardless of whether it is electrographically generalized or focal.

name: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
HP:0032673.def: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically focal. It is a prolonged focal non-motor seizure.

name: cutaneous wound
cutaneous wound
HP:0032674.def: A cutaneous wound is a defined as a disruption of normal anatomic structure and function of the skin that occured owing to an injury of the skin. Wound healing is a dynamic, interactive processinvolving soluble mediators, blood cells, extracellularmatrix, and parenchymal cells. Wound healing has three phases: inflammation, tissue formation, and tissue remodeling, that overlap in time.

name: acute cutaneous wound
acute cutaneous wound
HP:0032675.def: A cutaneous wound that is proceeding through an orderly and timely reparative process that results in sustained restoration of the anatomic and functional integrity of the skin.

name: chronic cutaneous wound
chronic cutaneous wound
HP:0032676.def: A cutaneous wound that has failed to proceed through the orderly and timely process to produce an atomic and functional integrity, or proceeded through the repair process without establishing a sustained anatomic and functional result.

name: generalized - onset motor seizure
generalize - onset motor seizure

name: eyelid myoclonia seizure
eyelid myoclonia seizure

To be classified as a focal cognitive seizure, the change in cognitive function should be specific and out of proportion to other relatively unimpaired aspects of cognition, because all cognition is impaired in a focal impaired awareness seizure.

focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia

focal emotional seizure with fear / anxiety / panic

HP:0032781.def: A focal autonomic seizure with urge to urinate / defecate characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with lacrimation
focal impair awareness autonomic seizure with lacrimation
HP:0032782.def: A focal autonomic seizure with lacrimation characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware autonomic seizure with piloerection
focal aware autonomic seizure with piloerection
HP:0032783.def: A focal autonomic seizure with piloerection (bristling of hairs due to the involuntary contraction of small muscles at the base of hair follicles) characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: focal aware autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole
focal aware autonomic seizure with palpitation / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole
HP:0032784.def: An autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: focal aware autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomena
focal aware autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomenon
HP:0032785.def: A focal autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomena characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: migrating focal seizure
migrate focal seizure
HP:0032786.def: A migrating focal seizure is a seizure that involves different body parts, usually without overlap, in a consecutive manner so that the offset of a seizure in one part coincides with its onset in another, even shifting multiple times between the sides of the body. They can be associated with autonomic manifestations.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure
focal impair awareness sensory seizure
HP:0032787.def: A focal sensory seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole
focal impair awareness autonomic seizure with palpitation / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole
HP:0032788.def: A focal autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware behavior arrest seizure
focal aware behavior arrest seizure
HP:0032789.def: A focal behavior arrest seizure characterised by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness behavior arrest seizure
focal impair awareness behavior arrest seizure
HP:0032790.def: A focal behavior arrest seizure characterised by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
synonym: focal impaired awareness behaviour arrest seizure
focal impair awareness behaviour arrest seizure

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with anomia
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with anomia
HP:0032791.def: A focal cognitive seizure with anomia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: tonic seizure
tonic seizure
HP:0032792.def: A tonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterised by unilateral or bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia
HP:0032793.def: A focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: myoclonic seizure
myoclonic seizure
HP:0032794.def: A myoclonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterised by sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.

name: generalized myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
generalize myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
HP:0032795.def: A generalized myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterised by a single or multiple jerks of limbs bilaterally, followed by tonic and clonic phases. The initial jerks can be considered to be either a brief period of clonus or myoclonus.
synonym: generalised onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
generalise onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
generalised - onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
generalise - onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
generalized onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
generalize onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
generalized - onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
generalize - onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with left - right confusion
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with left - right confusion
HP:0032796.def: A focal cognitive seizure with left-right confusion characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware sensory seizure with olfactory features
focal aware sensory seizure with olfactory feature
HP:0032797.def: Seizures characterized by olfactory phenomena at onset - usually an odor, which is often unpleasant.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with neglect
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with neglect
HP:0032798.def: A focal cognitive seizure with neglect characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness hemiclonic seizure
focal impair awareness hemiclonic seizure
HP:0032799.def: A focal hemiclonic seizure in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware sensory seizure with vestibular features
focal aware sensory seizure with vestibular feature
HP:0032800.def: A seizure characterized by symptoms of dizziness, spinning, vertigo or sense of rotation.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with memory impairment
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with memory impairment
HP:0032801.def: A focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyscalculia / acalculia
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with dyscalculia / acalculia
HP:0032802.def: A focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia / acalculia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia
HP:0032803.def: A focal cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with olfactory features
focal impair awareness sensory seizure with olfactory feature
HP:0032804.def: A focal sensory seizure with olfaction in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with vestibular features
focal impair awareness sensory seizure with vestibular feature
HP:0032805.def: A focal sensory seizure with vestibular features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with visual features
focal impair awareness sensory seizure with visual feature
HP:0032806.def: A focal sensory seizure with visual features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: neonatal seizure
neonatal seizure
HP:0032807.def: A seizure occurring within the neonatal period (28 days beyond the full term date).

name: neonatal seizure with electrographic correlate
neonatal seizure with electrographic correlate
HP:0032808.def: Neonatal seizure is a seizure type that occurs in neonatal period and is characterized by an electrographic event with sudden, repetitive, evolving stereotyped waveforms with a beginning and an end. This event can be associated or not with a clinical manifestation.

name: neonatal electro - clinical seizure
neonatal electro - clinical seizure
HP:0032809.def: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure is an electrographic event occurring in neonatal period and coupled with a clinical manifestation.

name: focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
HP:0032810.def: A seizure characterized by a sensation in the head such as light-headedness or headache as its first clinical manifestation.

name: neonatal electrographic only seizure
neonatal electrographic only seizure
HP:0032811.def: Neonatal electrographic only seizure is an electrographic event with sudden, repetitive, evolving stereotyped waveforms with a beginning and an end, which is not associated with a clinical manifestation.

name: neonatal electro - clinical non - motor seizure
neonatal electro - clinical non - motor seizure
neonatal electro - clinical motor seizure
neonatal electro - clinical motor seizure
HP:0032813.def: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure with predominant motor features.

name: neonatal electro - clinical clonic seizure
neonatal electro - clinical clonic seizure
HP:0032814.def: Neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is a regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups; it can be symmetric or asymmetric.

name: neonatal electro - clinical myoclonic seizure
neonatal electro - clinical myoclonic seizure
HP:0032815.def: Neonatal electro-clinical myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal).

name: neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure
neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure
HP:0032816.def: Neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) wich occurs at multiple sites.

name: neonatal focal myoclonic seizure
neonatal focal myoclonic seizure
HP:0032817.def: Neonatal focal myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) which occurs focally.

name: neonatal focal clonic seizure
neonatal focal clonic seizure
HP:0032818.def: Neonatal focal clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the predominant motor feature is unilateral regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups.

name: neonatal bilateral clonic seizure
neonatal bilateral clonic seizure
HP:0032819.def: Neonatal bilateral clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the clonic jerking is bilateral.

name: neonatal multifocal clonic seizure
neonatal multifocal clonic seizure
HP:0032820.def: Neonatal focal clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the predominant motor feature is a regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups, which occurs at multiple sites.

name: neonatal electro - clinical tonic seizure
neonatal electro - clinical tonic seizure
HP:0032821.def: Neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is a sustained increase in muscle tone, usually focal, that can be unilateral or bilateral, and lasting a few seconds to minutes.

name: neonatal electro - clinical autonomic seizure
neonatal electro - clinical autonomic seizure
HP:0032822.def: Neonatal electro-clinical non-motor autonomic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure with predominant features of autonomic alterations, involving cardiovascular, pupillary, gastrointestinal, sudomotor, vasomotor, and thermoregulatory functions. May present as apnea.

name: neonatal electro - clinical seizure with behavior arrest
neonatal electro - clinical seizure with behavior arrest
HP:0032823.def: Neonatal electro-clinical non-motor seizure with behavior arrest is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure characterized by an arrest of activities, freezing, immobilization, with or without apnea and/or other autonomic manifestations.
synonym: neonatal electro - clinical seizure with behaviour arrest
neonatal electro - clinical seizure with behaviour arrest
neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioural arrest
neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioural arrest

name: neonatal focal tonic seizure
neonatal focal tonic seizure
HP:0032824.def: Neonatal focal tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure with a focal sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes.

name: neonatal electro - clinical sequential seizure
neonatal electro - clinical sequential seizure
HP:0032825.def: Neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.

name: focal neonatal sequential seizure
focal neonatal sequential seizure
HP:0032826.def: Focal neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic focal signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.

name: multifocal neonatal sequential seizure
multifocal neonatal sequential seizure
HP:0032827.def: Multifocal neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic multifocal signs.

name: neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure
neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure
HP:0032828.def: Neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure where the sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes, occurs at both sides of the body symmetrically.

name: neonatal electro - clinical motor seizure with automatism
neonatal electro - clinical motor seizure with automatism
HP:0032829.def: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure with automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awarness, and in association with other features.
synonym: neonatal electroclinical motor seizure with automatism
neonatal electroclinical motor seizure with automatism

name: neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism
neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism
HP:0032830.def: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at both sides of the body asymmetrically.

name: neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure
neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure
HP:0032831.def: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure where the sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes, occurs at both sides of the body but asymmetrically.

name: neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure
neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure
HP:0032832.def: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) wich occurs at both sides of the body asymmetrically.

name: neonatal epileptic spasm
neonatal epileptic spasm
HP:0032833.def: A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. May occur in clusters.

name: neonatal seizure with unilateral automatism
neonatal seizure with unilateral automatism
HP:0032834.def: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatisms is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awarness, occurring at one side of the body.

name: neonatal seizure with bilateral symmetric automatism
neonatal seizure with bilateral symmetric automatism
HP:0032835.def: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awarness, occurring at both sides of the body symmetrically.

name: neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure
neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure
HP:0032836.def: Neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) wich occurs at both sides of the body symmetrically.

name: bilateral asymmetric neonatal sequential seizure
bilateral asymmetric neonatal sequential seizure
HP:0032837.def: Asymmetric neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting asymmetrically with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.

name: neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm
neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm
HP:0032838.def: Neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs at one side of the body.

name: bilateral symmetric neonatal sequential seizure
bilateral symmetric neonatal sequential seizure
HP:0032839.def: Symmetric neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting symmetrically but with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs.

name: neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm
neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm
HP:0032840.def: Neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs symmetrically at both sides of the body.

name: neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm
neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm
HP:0032841.def: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs asymmetrically at both sides of the body.

name: generalized - onset epileptic spasm
generalize - onset epileptic spasm
HP:0032842.def: A type of epileptic spasm of generalized onset.

name: focal - onset epileptic spasm
focal - onset epileptic spasm
HP:0032843.def: A type of epileptic spasm of focal onset.

name: focal impaired awareness epileptic spasm
focal impair awareness epileptic spasm
HP:0032844.def: A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware epileptic spasm
focal aware epileptic spasm
HP:0032845.def: A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is preserved throughout the seizure.

name: focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus
focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP:0032846.def: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by a sudden interruption in normal tonic muscle activity lasting 500 ms or less, without evidence of preceding myoclonus as the initial semiological manifestation. The interruption in muscle tone is briefer than seen in a focal atonic seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness hemifacial clonic seizure
focal impair awareness hemifacial clonic seizure
HP:0032847.def: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with impairment of awareness in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware cognitive seizure with neglect
focal aware cognitive seizure with neglect
HP:0032848.def: A focal cognitive seizure with neglect characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: aphasic status epilepticus
aphasic status epilepticus
HP:0032849.def: Aphasic status epilepticus is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma characterized by a cognitive (rather than motor) language deficit.

name: focal aware cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia
focal aware cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia
HP:0032850.def: A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: focal aware sensory seizure with visual features
focal aware sensory seizure with visual feature
HP:0032851.def: A seizure characterized by elementary visual hallucinations such as flashing or flickering lights/colours, or other shapes, simple patterns, scotomata, or amaurosis.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia
HP:0032852.def: A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with hot - cold sensations
focal impair awareness sensory seizure with hot - cold sensation
HP:0032853.def: A focal sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware hemifacial clonic seizure
focal aware hemifacial clonic seizure
HP:0032854.def: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with retained awareness throughout.

name: photosensitive myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
photosensitive myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
HP:0032855.def: Generalised myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure provoked by flashing or flickering light.
synonym: photically induced myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
photically induce myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure

name: focal aware bilateral motor seizure
focal aware bilateral motor seizure
HP:0032856.def: A type of focal bilateral motor seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal aware motor seizure with negative myoclonus
focal aware motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP:0032857.def: A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
synonym: focal motor aware seizure with negative myoclonus
focal motor aware seizure with negative myoclonus

name: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with negative myoclonus
focal impair awareness motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP:0032858.def: A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by impairement of awareness at some point during the seizure.
synonym: focal motor impaired awareness seizure with negative myoclonus
focal motor impair awareness seizure with negative myoclonus

name: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with paresis / paralysis
focal impair awareness motor seizure with paresis / paralysis
HP:0032859.def: A focal motor seizure with paresis / paralysis characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
synonym: focal motor impaired awareness seizure with paresis / paralysis
focal motor impair awareness seizure with paresis / paralysis

name: generalized non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
generalize non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
HP:0032860.def: Generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically generalized. It is a prolonged absence seizure.
synonym: generalised non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
generalise non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma

name: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness
focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness
HP:0032861.def: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness is impaired.
synonym: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of awareness
focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of awareness

name: status epilepticus with ictal paresis
status epilepticus with ictal paresis
HP:0032862.def: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by prolonged ictal paresis or inhibitory motor seizures.

name: typical absence status epilepticus
typical absence status epilepticus
HP:0032863.def: Typical absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged typical absence seizure.

name: focal aware sensory seizure with auditory features
focal aware sensory seizure with auditory feature
HP:0032864.def: A type of focal sensory seizure with auditory features during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

name: myoclonic absence status epilepticus
myoclonic absence status epilepticus
HP:0032865.def: Myoclonic absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged myoclonic absence seizure. Myoclonic absence status epilepticus consists of proximal, predominantly upper extremity myoclonic jerks corresponding with 3 Hz spike-wave discharges in the EEG.

name: oculoclonic status epilepticus
oculoclonic status epilepticus
HP:0032866.def: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repetitive and rapid saccades, in association with epileptic discharges.

name: refractory status epilepticus
refractory status epilepticus
HP:0032867.def: Refractory status epilepticus is defined as status epilepticus continuing despite two appropriately selected and dosed antiepileptic drugs, including a benzodiazepine.

name: super - refractory status epilepticus
super - refractory status epilepticus
HP:0032868.def: Super-refractory status epilepticus is defined as refractory status epilepticus continuing for 24 h or more following initiation of anesthetic medications, including cases in which seizure control is attained after induction of anesthetic drugs but recurs on weaning the patient off the anesthetic agent.

name: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness
focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness
HP:0032869.def: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness remains intact.
synonym: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with retained awareness
focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with retained awareness
focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of awareness
focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of awareness

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia
HP:0032870.def: A focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware cognitive seizure with hallucination
focal aware cognitive seizure with hallucination
HP:0032871.def: A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with illusion
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with illusion
HP:0032872.def: A focal cognitive seizure with illusion characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
focal aware sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
HP:0032873.def: A seizure characterized by a sensation in the head such as light-headedness or headache.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
HP:0032874.def: A focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: obsolete focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with impaired responsiveness
obsolete focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with impaired responsiveness
focal aware cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia
focal aware cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia
HP:0032876.def: A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: focal aware sensory seizure with hot - cold sensations
focal aware sensory seizure with hot - cold sensation
HP:0032877.def: A seizure characterized by sensations of feeling hot and then cold.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
focal impair awareness sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
HP:0032878.def: A focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness seizure with dissociation at onset
focal impair awareness seizure with dissociation at onset
HP:0032879.def: A focal cognitive epileptic seizure with dissociation at the onset of the seizure and with impairment of awareness at at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with auditory features
focal impair awareness sensory seizure with auditory feature
HP:0032880.def: A focal sensory seizure with auditory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: obsolete focal aware cognitive seizure with impaired responsiveness
obsolete focal aware cognitive seizure with impaired responsiveness
focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
HP:0032882.def: A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
focal aware cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
HP:0032883.def: A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

name: focal aware sensory seizure with somatosensory features
focal aware sensory seizure with somatosensory feature
HP:0032884.def: A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move. Awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with hallucination
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with hallucination
HP:0032885.def: A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia
HP:0032886.def: A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: generalized atonic seizure
generalize atonic seizure
HP:0032887.def: Generalized atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1-2 s, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature.

name: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with forced thinking
focal impair awareness cognitive seizure with forced thinking
HP:0032888.def: A focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware sensory seizure with gustatory features
focal aware sensory seizure with gustatory feature
HP:0032889.def: A seizure characterized by taste phenomena including acidic, bitter, salty, sweet, or metallic tastes.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with somatosensory features
focal impair awareness sensory seizure with somatosensory feature
HP:0032890.def: A focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware motor seizure with version
focal aware motor seizure with version
HP:0032891.def: A focal motor seizure with version characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
synonym: focal motor aware seizure with version
focal motor aware seizure with version

name: infection - related seizure
infection - related seizure
HP:0032892.def: Seizure associated with a presumed or proven infection (excluding infection of the central nervous system) or inflammatory state without an alternative precipitant such as metabolic derangement, and regardless of the presence or absence of a fever.

name: gastroenteritis - related afebrile seizure
gastroenteritis - relate afebrile seizure
HP:0032893.def: Afebrile (less than 38.0 degrees Celcius), brief, and generalized seizures accompanying gastroenteritis without an alternative cause.

name: seizure precipitated by febrile infection
seizure precipitate by febrile infection
HP:0032894.def: Any form of seizure occurring at the time of a fever (temperature at or above 38.0 degrees Celcius) without infection of the central nervous system, and without an alternative cause such as severe metabolic derangement, occurring at any age.

name: febrile seizure outside the age of 3 months to 6 years
febrile seizure outside the age of 3 month to 6 year
HP:0032895.def: Any type of seizure (most often a generalized tonic-clonic seizure) occurring with fever (at least 38.0 degrees Celsius) but in the absence of central nervous system infection, severe metabolic disturbance or other alternative precipitant in people beyond the typical arrange of 3 months-6 years with no prior history of afebrile seizure.

name: music - induced seizure
music - induced seizure
HP:0032896.def: Seizure precipitated by listening to music or other complex sounds.

name: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with gustatory features
focal impair awareness sensory seizure with gustatory feature
HP:0032897.def: A focal sensory seizure with gustatory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal automatism seizure
focal automatism seizure
HP:0032898.def: A focal seizure characterized at onset by coordinated motor activity. This often resembles a voluntary movement and may consist of an inappropriate continuation of preictal motor activity.

name: focal orofacial automatism seizure
focal orofacial automatism seizure
HP:0032899.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset.

name: focal manual automatism seizure
focal manual automatism seizure
HP:0032900.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset.

name: focal pedal automatism seizure
focal pedal automatism seizure
HP:0032901.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

name: focal perseverative automatism seizure
focal perseverative automatism seizure
HP:0032902.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset.

name: focal vocal automatism seizure
focal vocal automatism seizure
HP:0032903.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset.

name: focal verbal automatism seizure
focal verbal automatism seizure
HP:0032904.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset.

name: focal sexual automatism seizure
focal sexual automatism seizure
HP:0032905.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset.

name: focal head nodding automatism seizure
focal head nod automatism seizure
HP:0032906.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset.

name: focal undressing automatism seizure
focal undress automatism seizure
HP:0032907.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset.

name: focal aware undressing automatism seizure
focal aware undress automatism seizure
HP:0032908.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal impaired awareness automatism seizure
focal impair awareness automatism seizure
HP:0032909.def: A focal seizure with automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

name: focal aware automatism seizure
focal aware automatism seizure
HP:0032910.def: A type of focal automatism seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal aware orofacial automatism seizure
focal aware orofacial automatism seizure
HP:0032911.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal aware manual automatism seizure
focal aware manual automatism seizure
HP:0032912.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal aware pedal automatism seizure
focal aware pedal automatism seizure
HP:0032913.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

name: focal aware perseverative automatism seizure
focal aware perseverative automatism seizure
HP:0032914.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal aware vocal automatism seizure
focal aware vocal automatism seizure
HP:0032915.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal aware verbal automatism seizure
focal aware verbal automatism seizure
HP:0032916.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal aware sexual automatism seizure
focal aware sexual automatism seizure
HP:0032917.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal impaired awareness orofacial automatism seizure
focal impair awareness orofacial automatism seizure
HP:0032918.def: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset.

name: focal aware head nodding automatism seizure
focal aware head nod automatism seizure
HP:0032919.def: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

name: focal impaired awareness manual automatism seizure
focal impair awareness manual automatism seizure
HP:0032920.def: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by manual automatisms at onset.

name: focal impaired awareness pedal automatism seizure
focal impair awareness pedal automatism seizure
HP:0032921.def: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

name: focal impaired awareness perseverative automatism seizure
focal impair awareness perseverative automatism seizure
HP:0032922.def: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset.

name: focal impaired awareness vocal automatism seizure
focal impair awareness vocal automatism seizure
HP:0032923.def: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset.

name: focal impaired awareness verbal automatism seizure
focal impair awareness verbal automatism seizure
HP:0032924.def: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset.

name: focal impaired awareness sexual automatism seizure
focal impair awareness sexual automatism seizure
HP:0032925.def: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset.

name: focal impaired awareness head nodding automatism seizure
focal impair awareness head nod automatism seizure
HP:0032926.def: A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset.

name: focal impaired awareness undressing automatism seizure
focal impair awareness undressing automatism seizure
HP:0032927.def: A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset.

name: elevated csf neurofilament light chain concentration
elevate csf neurofilament light chain concentration
HP:0032928.def: Neurofilament light chain (NfL) is a neuronal cytoplasmic protein highly expressed in large calibre myelinated axons. Its levels increase in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and blood proportionally to the degree of axonal damage in a variety of neurological disorders, including inflammatory, neurodegenerative, traumatic and cerebrovascular diseases.

name: abnormal chondrocyte morphology
abnormal chondrocyte morphology
HP:0032929.def: Any abnormal structure of a chondrocyte, which is a polymorphic cell that forms cartilage.

name: obsolete focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with impaired attention
obsolete focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with impaired attention
increased circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase level
increase circulate pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase level
HP:0032932.def: An increased level of triacylglycerol lipase in the blood circulation (can be measured in serum or plasma).
synonym: elevated circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase activity
elevate circulate pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase activity

name: airway hyperresponsiveness
airway hyperresponsiveness
HP:0032933.def: An increased sensitivity of the airways to an inhaled constrictor agonist, a steeper slope of the dose-response curve, and a greater maximal response to the agonist.

name: spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak
spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak
HP:0032934.def: A spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak (SCSFL) is a spontaneous and unexplained leak of the cerebrospinal fluid from the dura surrounding either the brain (cranial leak) or spine (spinal leak).

name: posterior crocodile shagreen of the cornea
posterior crocodile shagreen of the cornea
HP:0032935.def: Grayish, polygonal pattern of opacities with intervening clear zones across the central cornea that resembles crocodile skin.

name: intrusion symptom
intrusion symptom
HP:0032936.def: Unintentional re-experiencing of a traumatic event involves symptoms that typically include sensory impressions and emotional responses stemming from the trauma. These symptoms seem to lack a sense of time perspective and context.

name: recurrent , involuntary , and intrusive distressing memories
recurrent , involuntary , and intrusive distressing memory
HP:0032937.def: After experiencing psychological trauma, individuals may repeatedly encounter sensory-perceptual impressions of the event that intrude into their consciousness involuntarily. These intrusive memories often manifest as visual images (such as mental pictures), but can also involve sounds, smells, tastes, and physical sensations. They are accompanied by a variety of negative emotions linked to the most intense moments of the traumatic memory.

name: recurrent trauma - related distressing dreams
recurrent trauma - related distressing dream
HP:0032938.def: Recurrent distressing dreams occur when the content and/or emotional impact of the dream is connected to a traumatic event or events.

name: physiological reactivity to cues
physiological reactivity to cue
HP:0032939.def: Marked physiological reactions to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event(s).

name: dissociation
dissociation
HP:0032940.def: Disruption or detachment of certain aspects of one's normal psychological functioning typically involves a disconnection or separation from thoughts, feelings, sensations, memories, or one's sense of identity or reality.

name: intense psychological distress to cues
intense psychological distress to cue
HP:0032941.def: Intense or prolonged psychological distress occurs when individuals are exposed to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event or events.

name: avoidance of stimuli associated with traumatic event
avoidance of stimulus associate with traumatic event
HP:0032942.def: Avoidance of or efforts to avoid distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s). Avoidance of or efforts to avoid external reminders (people, places, conversations, activities, objects, situations) that arouse distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s).

name: abnormal urine ph
abnormal urine ph
HP:0032943.def: A deviation of urine pH from the normal range of 4.5 to 7.8.

name: renal interstitial inflammation
renal interstitial inflammation
HP:0032945.def: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium potentially involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic areas, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

name: renal cortical interstitial inflammation
renal cortical interstitial inflammation
HP:0032946.def: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic renal cortex, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

name: renal medullary interstitial inflammation
renal medullary interstitial inflammation
HP:0032947.def: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the interstitium of the renal medulla, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

name: renal interstitial fibrosis
renal interstitial fibrosis
HP:0032948.def: The accumulation of collagen and related extracellular matrix (ECM) molecules in the interstitium of the kidney. The interstitium is expanded by the presence of collagen that stain blue on trichrome. Tubules are not back to back, but rather separated by fibrosis and can be atrophic.

name: renal interstitial calcium phosphate deposits
renal interstitial calcium phosphate deposit
HP:0032949.def: The presence of interstitial aggregates of purple finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate deposits.

name: abnormal renal tubular lumen morphology
abnormal renal tubular lumen morphology
HP:0032950.def: Abnormal structure or form of the lumen (opening) of kidney tubules.

name: renal tubular viral cytopathic changes
renal tubular viral cytopathic change
HP:0032951.def: Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage. Tubular destruction may be associated with necrotizing interstitial granulomas. Severe granulomatous tubulointerstitial nephritis appears to be characteristic of adenoviral infection and is quite rare in other viral infections. Focal wedge-shaped necrosis may occur in renal parenchyma. Immunostaining for adenovirus shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in infected cells.

name: usual - type tubular atrophy
usual - type tubular atrophy
HP:0032952.def: A type of renal tubular atrophy in which the tubules show thick tubular basement membranes lined by small cuboidal or flat cells. Generally accompanied by fibrosis.

name: renal tubular cytomegalovirus inclusions
renal tubular cytomegalovirus inclusion
HP:0032953.def: Characteristic intranuclear glassy-appearing basophilic inclusions with surrounding halo (owl's eye-type inclusion) and marked increase in the size of the cell (cytomegaly), particularly in tubular epithelial cells and in endothelial cells. Often accompanied by cytopathic changes including patchy interstitial pleomorphic infiltrate with lymphocytes, plasma cells, and macrophages.

name: renal tubular adenovirus inclusions
renal tubular adenovirus inclusion
HP:0032954.def: Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. The inclusions stain positive for adenovirus (e.g., Figure 3 of PMID:29273157). Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. Occasionally glomerular visceral and parietal epithelial cells can be infected. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbersof neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage.

name: renal tubular polyoma virus inclusions
renal tubular polyoma virus inclusion
HP:0032955.def: Renal ltubular nuclear inclusions have a ground-glass appearance with irregular central clearing, or a coarse, vesicular appearance. Distal tubules are involved more often than proximal tubules. There may be only medullary involvement in early stages, and parietal epithelial cells may be involved in later stages of the infection. Infected epithelial cell nuclei stain with antibody to the large T antigen of the SV40 virus, which serves as a surrogate marker of human polyomavirus infection.

name: renal tubular herpes simplex virus inclusions
renal tubular herpes simplex virus inclusion
HP:0032956.def: Renal tubular nuclear inclusions that stain positive for herpes simplex virus (HSV). HSV is typically associated with multinucleated giant cells with nuclear inclusions and may cause hemorrhagic interstitial nephritis.

name: dysmorphic hematuria
dysmorphic hematuria
HP:0032957.def: The presence of dysmorphic urinary erythrocytes. This feature can be observed by phase-contrastmicroscopy, differential interference microscopy, and bright-field microscopy. The acanthocyte or G1 cell, which is a doughnut-shaped cell with one or more blebs, is reported to constitute a special form of dysmorphic erythro-cyte (D cell) specific for glomerular hematuria.

name: urinary oval fat bodies
urinary oval fat body
HP:0032958.def: The presence in the urine of desquamated tubular epithelial cells or macrophages filled with lipid droplets.

name: intratubular calcium oxalate casts
intratubular calcium oxalate cast
HP:0032959.def: Birefringent calcium- and oxalate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney.

name: intratubular calcium phosphate casts
intratubular calcium phosphate cast
HP:0032960.def: Purple and finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney.

name: magnesium ammonium phosphate crystalluria
magnesium ammonium phosphate crystalluria
HP:0032961.def: Magnesium ammonium phosphate crystals in the urine.

name: tubular microcystic change
tubular microcystic change
HP:0032962.def: Dilated renal tubules (over twice the diameter of a normal proximal tubule) containing eosinophilic amorphous material. This feature is generally accompanied by scalloping of the cast profile. The epithelium lining the microcyst is generally flattened and does not reveal brush border.

name: complex renal cyst
complex renal cyst
HP:0032963.def: A renal cyst characterized by epithelium lined space (squamous/columnar) with septations.

name: uric acid crystalluria
uric acid crystalluria
HP:0032964.def: The presence of uric acid crystals in the urine.

name: interstitial emphysema
interstitial emphysema
HP:0032965.def: Interstitial emphysema is characterized by air dissecting within the interstitium of the lung, typically in the peribronchovascular sheaths, interlobular septa, and visceral pleura. It is most commonly seen in neonates receiving mechanical ventilation. It is rarely recognized radiographically in adults and is infrequently seen on CT scans. It appears as perivascular lucent or low attenuating halos and small cysts.

name: centrilobular emphysema
centrilobular emphysema
HP:0032966.def: A type of emphysema characterized by destroyed centrilobular alveolar walls and enlargement of respiratory bronchioles and associated alveoli. This is the commonest form of emphysema in cigarette smokers. CT findings are centrilobular areas of decreased attenuation, usually without visible walls, of nonuniform distribution and predominantly located in upper lung zones.

name: panacinar emphysema
panacinar emphysema
HP:0032967.def: Panacinar emphysema involves all portions of the acinus and secondary pulmonary lobule more or less uniformly. It predominates in the lower lobes and is the form of emphysema associated with1-antitrypsin deficiency. CT scans show a generalized decrease of the lung parenchyma with a decrease in the caliber of blood vessels in the affected lung. Severe panacinar emphysema may coexist and merge with severe centrilobular emphysema.
