name: reduced peroxisomal glutaryl - coa oxidase activity
reduce peroxisomal glutaryl - coa oxidase activity
HP:0034688.def: Diminished enzyme activity of peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase, an enzyme that metabolizes glutaryl-CoA (a metabolite of L-lysine, L-hydroxy-lysine and L-tryptophan) by dehydrogenation to glutaconyl-CoA directly followed by decarboxylation of this to crotonyl-CoA.

name: reduced sterol 27 - hydroxylase activity
reduce sterol 27 - hydroxylase activity
HP:0034689.def: Diminished activity of the enzyme sterol 27-hydroxylase, which participates in the degradation of cholesterol to bile acid. Sterol 27-hydroxylase catalyzes the first step in the normal oxidation of the steroid side chain, converting cholesterol, as well as different 7a-hydroxylated cholesterol metabolites, to 27-oxygenated steroids.

name: reduced short - chain acyl - coa dehydrogenase activity
reduce short - chain acyl - coa dehydrogenase activity
HP:0034690.def: Diminished activbity of the enzyme Short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (SCAD), a key enzyme of fatty acid beta-oxidation that catalyses the first step in mitochondrial beta-oxidation of fatty acids.

name: reduced 3 - phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
reduce 3 - phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
HP:0034691.def: Diminished activity of the enzyme 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase (PGDH), which catalyzes the first step in the pathway by converting D-3-phosphoglycerate (PGA), an intermediate in glycolysis, to phosphohydroxypyruvate concomitant with the reduction of NAD+.

name: reduced hepatic methionine adenosyltransferase activity
reduce hepatic methionine adenosyltransferase activity
HP:0034693.def: Activity of methionine adenosyltransferase in the liver below the lower limit of normal. Note that there are multiple methionine adenosyltransferase isoezymes.

name: substantia nigra dopaminergic neuron loss
substantia nigra dopaminergic neuron loss
HP:0034694.def: Degeneration and loss of neruons in the substantia nigra of the brain.

name: intramuscular lipoma
intramuscular lipoma
HP:0034696.def: A lipoma that is located within a muscle.

name: cutaneous telangiectasia
cutaneous telangiectasia
HP:0034697.def: Dilated blood vessels on the skin.

name: abnormal aromatase activity
abnormal aromatase activity
HP:0034698.def: Aromatase activity outside of the normal range.

name: elevated aromatase activity
elevated aromatase activity
HP:0034699.def: Enzyme activity of aromatase above the upper limit of normal.

name: reduced aromatase activity
reduced aromatase activity
HP:0034700.def: Enzyme activity of aromatase below the lower limit of normal.

name: corneal amyloidosis
corneal amyloidosis
HP:0034701.def: A form of amyloidosis that is located in the cornea.

name: abnormal keratinocyte morphology
abnormal keratinocyte morphology
HP:0034702.def: Any structural anomaly of the keratinocyte. The keratinocyte is the major cell type of the epidermis and is responsible for generating the protective barrier.

name: keratinocyte vacuolization
keratinocyte vacuolization
HP:0034703.def: Increased number of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in keratinocytes.

name: parotid gland adenocarcinoma
parotid gland adenocarcinoma
HP:0034704.def: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the parotid gland.

name: pulmonary vasculitis
pulmonary vasculitis
HP:0034705.def: Cellular inflammation, vessel destruction, and tissue necrosis of the blood vessels of the lung.

name: reduced hepatic d - glycerate kinase activity
reduce hepatic d - glycerate kinase activity
HP:0034706.def: Activity of D-glycerate kinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

name: lymph - node hemophagocytosis
lymph - node hemophagocytosis
HP:0034707.def: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages in a lymph node.

name: superior pubic ramus hypoplasia
superior pubic ramus hypoplasia
HP:0034708.def: Underdevelopment of the upper branch of the pubis bone (inferior pubic ramus).

name: uterine adenofibroma
uterine adenofibroma
HP:0034709.def: A rare benign mullerian mixed tumor of the uterus composed of benign epithelial and mesenchymal components.

name: pulmonary hamartoma
pulmonary hamartoma
HP:0034710.def: A benign malformation of the lung that includes an abnormal mixture of tissue components such as cartilage, epithelium, fat, or muscle which are common to the lung but without preservation of the organ architecture.

name: peripheral axonal distension
peripheral axonal distension
HP:0034711.def: An abnormal histological finding characterized by an increase in the cross-section area of peripheral nerve axons (up to 20-25 micrometers in diameter).

name: decreased circulating alpha - mannosidase activity
decrease circulate alpha - mannosidase activity
HP:0034712.def: Concentration or activity of alpha mannosidase below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

name: abnormal hepatocyte morphology
abnormal hepatocyte morphology
HP:0034713.def: A structural anomaly of the hepatocyte, which is the main cell type that makes up the liver perncyhma. Hepatocytes are usually binucleated and appear as sheets in the liver tissue.

name: hepatic melanin - like lysosomal pigmentation
hepatic melanin - like lysosomal pigmentation
HP:0034714.def: Accumulation of dark, coarsely granular pigment localized in lysosomes of centrilobular hepatocytes.

name: reduced uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity
reduce uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity
HP:0034715.def: Activity of the enzyme uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase (UROD; EC 4.1.1.37) below the lower limit of normal.

name: reduced heme oxygenase activity
reduce heme oxygenase activity
HP:0034716.def: Activity of the enzyme heme oxygenase below the lower limit of normal.

name: swollen achromatic neurons in the cerebral cortex
swell achromatic neuron in the cerebral cortex
HP:0034717.def: The presence of enlarged and swollen neurons that lack Nissl bodies (the rough endoplasmic reticulum-achromasia refers to neurons that lack Nissl bodies) in the cortex of the brain.

name: vacuolated hepatocytes
vacuolated hepatocytes
HP:0034718.def: Presence of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in hepatocytes, which normally rarely contain vacuoles.

name: lack of oocyte pronucleus formation
lack of oocyte pronucleus formation
HP:0034719.def: An abnormality of oocyte maturation characterized by the inability of oocytes to form pronuclei after in vitro fertilization procedures. Oocytes normally show two pronuclei 17 to 20 hours after in vitro insemination.

name: self - healing squamous epithelioma
self - heal squamous epithelioma
HP:0034720.def: A type of skin tumor that initially presents as a reddish macule and subsequently becomes papular, enlarged, ulcerated and ultimately heals leaving pitted scars.

name: elevated circulating pristanic acid concentration
elevate circulate pristanic acid concentration
HP:0034721.def: Concentration of pristanic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: sarcoplasmic bodies
sarcoplasmic body
HP:0034722.def: Rounded or oval structures that appeared brown on hematoxylin and eosin and red on the modified Gomori trichrome stain.

name: reduced csf cystine concentration
reduce csf cystine concentration
HP:0034724.def: Concentration of cystine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal. Cystine is sulfur-containing amino acid obtained by the oxidation of two cysteine molecules which are then linked via a disulfide bond.

name: abnormal circulating beta - mannosidase activity
abnormal circulate beta - mannosidase activity
HP:0034725.def: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase outside normal limits. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

name: elevated circulating beta - mannosidase activity
elevate circulate beta - mannosidase activity
HP:0034726.def: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase above the upper limit of normal. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

name: reduced circulating alpha - l - fucosidase activity
reduce circulate alpha - l - fucosidase activity
HP:0034727.def: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase below the lower limit of normal.

name: abnormal circulating alpha - l - fucosidase activity
abnormal circulate alpha - l - fucosidase activity
HP:0034728.def: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.

name: elevated circulating alpha - l - fucosidase activity
elevate circulate alpha - l - fucosidase activity
HP:0034729.def: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated circulating s - adenosyl - l - homocysteine concentration
elevate circulate s - adenosyl - l - homocysteine concentration
HP:0034730.def: Increased concentration of S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine in the blood circulation.

name: elevated circulating s - adenosyl - l - methionine concentration
elevate circulate s - adenosyl - l - methionine concentration
HP:0034731.def: Concentration S-adenosyl-L-methionine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: exercise - triggered malignant hyperthermia
exercise - trigger malignant hyperthermia
HP:0034732.def: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by exercise-induced life-threatening hyperthermia with a body temperature over 40 degrees C and signs of encephalopathy ranging from confusion to convulsions or coma. Incidence increases with rising ambient temperature and relative humidity. Manifestations may include rhabdomyolysis (presenting with myalgia, muscle weakness, and myoglobinuria), tachycardia, and in severe cases multiorgan failure.

name: anesthesic - triggered malignant hyperthermia
anesthesic - trigger malignant hyperthermia
HP:0034733.def: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by a rapid increase in temperature to 39-42 degrees C in response to inhalational anesthetics such as halothane or to muscle relaxants such as succinylcholine.

name: elevated csf argininosuccinic acid concentration
elevate csf argininosuccinic acid concentration
HP:0034734.def: Concentration of argininosuccinic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated csf aspartylglucosamine concentration
elevate csf aspartylglucosamine concentration
HP:0034735.def: Concentration of aspartylglucosamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated circulating alpha - oxoadipic acid concentration
elevate circulate alpha - oxoadipic acid concentration
HP:0034736.def: Concentration of alpha-oxoadipic acid in the blood above the upper limit of normal.
synonym: alpha - oxoadipic acid high in blood
alpha - oxoadipic acid high in blood

name: abnormal erythrocyte metabolite concentration
abnormal erythrocyte metabolite concentration
HP:0034737.def: A deviation from the normal range of a metabolite in red blood cells.

name: reduced erythrocyte glutathione concentration
reduce erythrocyte glutathione concentration
HP:0034738.def: Concentration of glutathione in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. Glutathione (GSH) is an important redox active biomolecule critical in the maintenance and regulation of cellular and organismal health.

name: elevated csf sarcosine concentration
elevate csf sarcosine concentration
HP:0034739.def: Concentration of sarcosine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: reduced csf methionine concentration
reduce csf methionine concentration
HP:0034740.def: Concentration of methionine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

name: elevated circulating homoarginine concentration
elevate circulate homoarginine concentration
HP:0034741.def: Concentration of homoarginine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated urinary formiminoglutamic acid level
elevate urinary formiminoglutamic acid level
HP:0034742.def: The concentration of formiminoglutamic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated csf proline concentration
elevate csf proline concentration
HP:0034743.def: Concentration of proline in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated urinary s - sulfocysteine level
elevate urinary s - sulfocysteine level
HP:0034744.def: Level of S-sulfocysteine high in urine above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated circulating s - sulfocysteine concentration
elevate circulate s - sulfocysteine concentration
HP:0034745.def: Concentration of S-sulfocysteine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: sertoli cell hyperplasia
sertoli cell hyperplasia
HP:0034746.def: Abnormal increase in the number of Sertoli cells in the testis.

name: csf infectious agent
csf infectious agent
HP:0034747.def: The presence of an infectious agent in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: csf mycobacteria
csf mycobacteria
HP:0034748.def: Mycobacterium present in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). This feature can be ascertained by CSF microscopy.

name: fungal bloodstream infection
fungal bloodstream infection
HP:0034749.def: Detection of a fungal organism (such as candida or coccidioides) in the blood stream.

name: supraclavicular lymphadenopathy
supraclavicular lymphadenopathy
HP:0034750.def: Enlarged lymph node located just above the clavicle (collarbone).

name: inguinal lymphadenopathy
inguinal lymphadenopathy
HP:0034751.def: Enlarged lymph node located in the inguinal region (groin).

name: axillary lymphadenopathy
axillary lymphadenopathy
HP:0034752.def: Enlarged lymph node located in the axillary region (armpit).

name: positive murphy sign
positive murphy sign
HP:0034753.def: Murphy's sign is elicited in patients with acute cholecystitis by asking the patient to take in and hold a deep breath while palpating the subcostal region. In practice, Murphy's sign is performed by palpating the subcostal region during inspiration. If pain is elicited and the patient suddenly stops their inspiratory effort, a positive Murphy's sign has been elicited.

name: bilious emesis
bilious emesis
HP:0034754.def: Vomiting whereby the vomit has the color of bile, yellowish-green.

name: ameliorated by nsaid
ameliorate by nsaid
HP:0034755.def: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).
synonym: ameliorated by nonsteroidal anti - inflammatory drug
ameliorate by nonsteroidal anti - inflammatory drug

name: fetal exposure history
fetal exposure history
HP:0034756.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to a medication or other substance.

name: fetal barbiturate exposure
fetal barbiturate exposure
HP:0034757.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to barbiturate medications such as phenobarbital. Barbiturates are used medically as anxiolytics, hypnotics, and anticonvulsants.

name: fetal narcotic exposure
fetal narcotic exposure
HP:0034758.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to narcotic medications such as morphine or codeine. Narcotics are used medically to treat moderate or severe pain.

name: ameliorated by ethosuximide
ameliorate by ethosuximide
HP:0034759.def: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of ethosuximide. Ethosuximide is most often used to treat absence seizures.

name: reduced epidermal extracellular matrix protein 1 protein expression
reduce epidermal extracellular matrix protein 1 protein expression
HP:0034760.def: Lower than normal amount of extracellular matrix protein 1 (ECM1) in the epidermis.

name: neurofibroma by anatomical location
neurofibroma by anatomical location
HP:0034761.def: Neurofibroma categorized according to the anatomical site of origin.

name: tongue neurofibroma
tongue neurofibroma
HP:0034762.def: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the tongue.

name: cardiac neurofibroma
cardiac neurofibroma
HP:0034763.def: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the heart.

name: gastric neurofibroma
gastric neurofibroma
HP:0034764.def: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the stomach.

name: renal neurofibroma
renal neurofibroma
HP:0034765.def: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the kidney.

name: muscle fiber polyglucosan inclusion bodies
muscle fiber polyglucosan inclusion body
HP:0034766.def: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in muscle fibers.

name: abnormal rete ridge morphology
abnormal rete ridge morphology
HP:0034767.def: Abnormal structure of the rete ridges (also known as rete pegs), which are downward projections of epithelium surrounding the connective tissue papillae in between the dermal papillae.

name: rete ridge elongation
rete ridge elongation
HP:0034768.def: Increased length of the rete rdiges of the epidermis.

name: pulmonary langerhans cell histiocytosis
pulmonary langerhans cell histiocytosis
HP:0034769.def: Accumulation of monoclonal CD1a-positive Langerhans cells in the bronchioles and alveolar interstitium that can cause damage to the lungs.

name: lumbar hypolordosis
lumbar hypolordosis
HP:0034770.def: Flattening of a curve in the spine in the lumbar (lower back) region.

name: battle sign
battle sign
HP:0034771.def: Battle sign is bruising over the mastoid process that is typically the result of head trauma. It is retroauricular or mastoid ecchymosis that is typically the result of head trauma. Battle sign typically requires significant head trauma and may indicate significant internal injury to the brain and not just the posterior cranial vault or mastoid.

name: decreased skull base length
decrease skull base length
HP:0034772.def: Reduced anterioposterior dimension of the skull base.

name: oscillopsia
oscillopsia
HP:0034773.def: A visual disturbance in which objects in the visual field appear to oscillate (jump, jiggle, vibrate).

name: decreased blink rate
decrease blink rate
HP:0034774.def: The frequency with which the eye is blinked is below the lower limit of normal.

name: abnormal blink rate
abnormal blink rate
HP:0034775.def: A deviation from the normal frequency of blinking the eye.

name: elevated blink rate
elevate blink rate
HP:0034776.def: The frequecy with which the eye is blinked is above the upper limit of normal.

name: maternal hyperthyroidism
maternal hyperthyroidism
HP:0034778.def: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of hyperthyroidism during the corresponding pregnancy.

name: perineal
perineal
HP:0034779.def: Applies to an abnormality that affects the perineum (the region of skin between the genitals and the anus).

name: gadolinium exposure
gadolinium exposure
HP:0034780.def: History of exposure to gadolinium, a contrast medium often used for magnetic resonance imaging.

name: purulent parotid gland drainage
purulent parotid gland drainage
HP:0034781.def: Excretion of pus (purulent discharge) from the opening of the parotid duct.

name: obstipation
obstipation
HP:0034782.def: Obstipation is the inability to pass either stool or flatus (gas).

name: vasculitis by anatomical site
vasculitis by anatomical site
HP:0034784.def: Vasculitis categorized according to the anatomical site where the finding is localized.

name: vasculitis by histology
vasculitis by histology
HP:0034785.def: Vasculitis categorized according to type of histological abnormality.

name: leukocytoclastic vasculitis
leukocytoclastic vasculitis
HP:0034786.def: A type of vasculitis characterized by the presence of debris of neutrophils within the blood vessel walls.

name: accumulation of lipid droplets in small - bowel enterocytes
accumulation of lipid droplet in small - bowel enterocytes
pericardial friction rub
pericardial friction rub
HP:0034788.def: A pericardial friction rub is a grating, to-and-fro sound that occurs in phase with the heart sounds.

name: abnormal muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
abnormal muscle succinate dehydrogenase stain
HP:0034790.def: Any deviation from the normal amount of staining of succinate dehydrogenase in skeletal muscle tissue.

name: small intestinal hamartoma
small intestinal hamartoma
HP:0034793.def: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the small intestine.

name: pyriform sperm head
pyriform sperm head
HP:0034794.def: Pyriform spermatozoa consist of a normally shaped acrosomal structure which can be normal in size or enlarged, while the post-acrosomal region shows severe elongation and an acute narrowing to the posterior end, ending in about the same thickness as the connecting mid-piece.

name: excess residual spermatozoal cytoplasm
excess residual spermatozoal cytoplasm
HP:0034795.def: Excess residual cytoplasm is associated with abnormal spermatozoa produced from a defective spermiation process. This abnormal excess cytoplasm should not be confused with more physiological cytoplasmic residues that can be observed in direct microscopy of the ejaculate but not in dried, fixed and stained morphology smears.

name: cardiomyocyte hyaline bodies
cardiomyocyte hyaline body
HP:0034796.def: Subsarcolemmal, eosinophilic glass-like regions within the cytoplasm of cardiomyocytes.

name: hepatic hemophagocytosis
hepatic hemophagocytosis
HP:0034797.def: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the liver.

name: csf hemophagocytosis
csf hemophagocytosis
HP:0034798.def: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

name: splenic hemophagocytosis
splenic hemophagocytosis
HP:0034799.def: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the spleen.

name: urinary bladder granulomatosis
urinary bladder granulomatosis
HP:0034800.def: The presence of multiple granulomas in the urinary bladder as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

name: epidermal necrosis
epidermal necrosis
HP:0034801.def: Death of keratinocytes in the epidermis layer of the skin, which generally manifests as extensive exfoliation (separation of the epidermis from the underlying dermis).

name: exacerbated by flexion
exacerbate by flexion
HP:0034802.def: Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by (or made more painful by) bending of a limb or joint.

name: hemolacria
hemolacria
HP:0034803.def: The presence of blood in tears.

name: corneal foreign body sensation
corneal foreign body sensation
HP:0034804.def: A perception that an object is in contact with the eye.

name: buttock pain
buttock pain
HP:0034805.def: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the buttock (round fleshy area at the lower rear area of a human trunk).

name: vaginal foreign body sensation
vaginal foreign body sensation
HP:0034806.def: A perception that an object located in the vagina.

name: paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea
paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea
HP:0034807.def: Attacks of breathlessness that occur at night and may awaken the sleeping patient.

name: eyelid pain
eyelid pain
HP:0034808.def: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eyelid.

name: abnormal sperm physiology
abnormal sperm physiology
HP:0034809.def: Abnormality of a sperm function including protection of paternal DNA, traversing the female reproductive tract, oocyte localisation, penetration of the zona pellucida, oocyte activation and centriole deposition.

name: small acrosomal area
small acrosomal area
HP:0034810.def: Reduction in size of the acrosome below the lower limit of normal. The acrosome is a unique membranous organelle located over the anterior part of the sperm nucleus. According to the World Health Organization criteria, the acrosome must be clearly visible, comprising approximately 40-70 percent of the sperm head.

name: bent sperm flagella
bent sperm flagellum
HP:0034811.def: The proportion of sperm cells whose flagella is sharply curved or has a sharp angle is above normal limits.

name: spermiation failure
spermiation failure
HP:0034812.def: Spermiation failure is indicated by apparently normal spermiogenesis, but the presence of retained Sd2 spermatids in stages III-V of human spermatogenesis, whereas maturation arrest is indicated by a lack of late Sd1 and Sd2 spermatids in the epithelium.

name: hypospermatogenesis
hypospermatogenesis
HP:0034813.def: A morphological abnormality visible upon biopsy of the germinal epithelium of the testis in which the cellularity of the germinal epithelium is reduced in general, so that all stages of germ cells (spermatogonia, spermatocytes, and spermatids) are present but reduced in number. This term applies to biopsies with some tubules showing diminished amounts of qualitatively complete spermatogenesis in combination with a vast majority of tubules that lack germ cells.

name: conjunctival membrane
conjunctival membrane
HP:0034814.def: Formation of a sheet of tissue by coagulum of exudate over the conjunctiva of the eye that if removed leaves behind a denuded bleeding surface.

name: extreme oligozoospermia
extreme oligozoospermia
HP:0034815.def: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than zero but less than 2 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than zero but less than one million sperm per milliliter.

name: mild oligozoospermia
mild oligozoospermia
HP:0034816.def: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 30 but less than 39 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 10 but less than 15 million sperm per milliliter.

name: moderate oligozoospermia
moderate oligozoospermia
HP:0034817.def: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 10 but less than 29 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 5 but less than 10 million sperm per milliliter.

name: severe oligozoospermia
severe oligozoospermia
HP:0034818.def: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 2 but less than 10 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 1 but less than 5 million sperm per milliliter.

name: iris nodule
iris nodule
HP:0034819.def: The presence of a nodule (small rounded lump of tissue) in the iris.

name: koeppe nodules
koeppe nodule
HP:0034820.def: A type of iris nodule consisting of inflammatory cell precipitates which lie at the pupillary margin.

name: bussaca nodules
bussaca nodule
HP:0034821.def: A type of iris nodule consisting of inflammatory cell precipitates which lie on the iris surface.

name: decreased csf copper concentration
decrease csf copper concentration
HP:0034823.def: Concentration of copper in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) below the lower limit of normal.

name: diffuse pulmonary lymphoid hyperplasia
diffuse pulmonary lymphoid hyperplasia
HP:0034824.def: Diffuse lymphoid hyperplasia (DLH) describes the pathological entity that lies between follicular bronchiolitis and lymphocytic interstitial pneumonia (LIP). It is pathologically characterized by a diffuse peribronchiolar proliferation of hyperplastic lymphoid follicles (BALT), extended along the lymphatics to involve the interlobular septa and pleura. Unlike LIP, DHL does not show uniform involvement of the alveolar septa.

name: ameliorated by steroid medication
ameliorate by steroid medication
HP:0034825.def: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a steroid medication such as prednisone.

name: triggered by medication exposure
trigger by medication exposure
HP:0034826.def: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by administration of a medication.

name: triggered by levothyroxin exposure
trigger by levothyroxin exposure
HP:0034827.def: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by administration of levothyroxin (thyroid hormone).

name: reduced muscle laminin alpha - 2 chain staining
reduce muscle laminin alpha - 2 chain staining
HP:0034828.def: A decreased amount of laminin alpha-2 chain in muscle tissue. This feature can be shown by immunohistochemistry or Western blotting of muscle tissue.

name: adrenal cortical sclerosis
adrenal cortical sclerosis
HP:0034829.def: Abnormal thickening of of the outer layer (cortex) of the adrenal gland due to fibrosis.

name: reduced hepatic fructose - 1,6 - phosphate aldolase activity
reduce hepatic fructose - 1,6 - phosphate aldolase activity
HP:0034830.def: Concentration or activity of fructose 1,6-bisphosphate aldolase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

name: pancreatic hamartoma
pancreatic hamartoma
HP:0034831.def: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the pancreas.

name: liver angiomyolipoma
liver angiomyolipoma
HP:0034832.def: A benign liver neoplasm composed of fat, vascular, and smooth muscle elements.

name: cardiac lipoma
cardiac lipoma
HP:0034833.def: A lipoma that is located within a the heart.

name: peripheral nerve polyglucosan inclusion bodies
peripheral nerve polyglucosan inclusion body
HP:0034834.def: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in peripheral nerve fibers.

name: cardiac polyglucosan accumulation
cardiac polyglucosan accumulation
HP:0034835.def: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in myocardial tissue.

name: cystic nephroma
cystic nephroma
HP:0034836.def: A benign cystic neoplasm of the kidney.

name: absent dermal elastic fibers
absent dermal elastic fiber
HP:0034837.def: Elastic fibers not demonstrable in skin biopsy.

name: cleavage at junction of stratum corneum and stratum granulosum
cleavage at junction of stratum corneum and stratum granulosum
HP:0034838.def: Splitting of the skin (cell-cell adhesion of keratinocytes) localized to the interface betweem the stratum corneum and stratum granulosum layers of the epidermis.

name: lymphoid hyperplasia
lymphoid hyperplasia
HP:0034839.def: An abnormal bone marrow finding characterized by many poorly circumscribed and occasionally confluent lymphoid nodules. The nodules contain small and uniform lymphocytes with rounded nuclei, clumped chromatin, and without prominent nucleoli.

name: absence of epidermal lamellar bodies
absence of epidermal lamellar body
HP:0034840.def: Lack of lamellar bodies (LBs) inthe epidermis. LBs are specialized organelles that contain pro-barrier lipids imparting a fully lamellar internal structure, but also other cargoes such as enzymes (lipid metabolizing and proteolytic), enzyme inhibitors, and antimicrobial peptides.

name: gastrointestinal granulomatosis
gastrointestinal granulomatosis
HP:0034841.def: The presence of multiple granulomas in the gastrointestinal tract (Pylorus, esophagus, jejunum, ileum, cecum, rectum, perirectal area, esophagus) as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

name: enlarged sperm head vacuole
enlarge sperm head vacuole
HP:0034842.def: Increased size of sperm vacuoles, which are surface concavities typically located at the the tip or middle area of sperm heads. According to the WHO Laboratory Manual for the Examination and Processing of Human Semen, sperm head vacuoles are considered abnormal when exceeding 20% of the cross-sectional area of the head. Vacuoles are found in almost all samples with normal sperm morphology; this term applies if the proportion of sperm with abnormally large vacuoles is above the upper limit of normal.

name: ureteral hamartoma
ureteral hamartoma
HP:0034843.def: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the ureter.

name: fetal methimazole exposure
fetal methimazole exposure
HP:0034844.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to methimazole.

name: fetal procarbazine exposure
fetal procarbazine exposure
HP:0034845.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to procarbazine.

name: fetal fluorouracil exposure
fetal fluorouracil exposure
HP:0034846.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to fluorouracil.

name: fetal cytarabine exposure
fetal cytarabine exposure
HP:0034847.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to cytarabine.

name: fetal tetracycline exposure
fetal tetracycline exposure
HP:0034848.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to tetracycline.

name: fetal quinine exposure
fetal quinine exposure
HP:0034849.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to quinine.

name: fetal cyclophosphamide exposure
fetal cyclophosphamide exposure
HP:0034850.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to cyclophosphamide.

name: fetal metronidazole exposure
fetal metronidazole exposure
HP:0034851.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to metronidazole.

name: fetal phenobarbital exposure
fetal phenobarbital exposure
HP:0034852.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to phenobarbital.

name: fetal phenytoin exposure
fetal phenytoin exposure
HP:0034853.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to phenytoin.

name: periumbilical
periumbilical
HP:0034854.def: Applies to an abnormality whose distribution and appearance are located at or near the umbilicus (belly button).

name: maternal obesity during pregnancy
maternal obesity during pregnancy
HP:0034855.def: A history of obesity, which can be defined as a body mass index of 30 or greater, in the mother of a fetus or index patient.

name: maternal amniocentesis
maternal amniocentesis
HP:0034856.def: A history of amniocentesis having been performed in the mother of a fetus or index patient.

name: typified by highly variable age of onset
typify by highly variable age of onset
HP:0034857.def: Description of conditions in which age of onset is highly variable even in family members who share the same disease-associated variant or variants.

name: abnormal leukocyte enzyme concentration or activity
abnormal leukocyte enzyme concentration or activity
HP:0034858.def: Concentration or activity of an enzyme as measured in leukocytes is above or below the limits of normal in the blood circulation.

name: reduced leukocyte beta - glucuronidase activity
reduce leukocyte beta - glucuronidase activity
HP:0034859.def: Concentration or activity of an beta-glucuronidase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

name: reduced leukocyte alpha - l - fucosidase activity
reduce leukocyte alpha - l - fucosidase activity
HP:0034860.def: Concentration or activity of an alpha-L-fucosidase as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

name: reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase b activity
reduce leukocyte arylsulfatase b activity
HP:0034861.def: Concentration or activity of an arylsulfatase B as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

name: reduced leukocyte steroid sulfatase activity
reduce leukocyte steroid sulfatase activity
HP:0034862.def: Concentration or activity of an arylsulfatase C as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

name: reduced leukocyte arylsulfatase a activity
reduce leukocyte arylsulfatase a activity
HP:0034863.def: Concentration or activity of the lysosomal enzyme arylsulfatase A (EC 3.1.6.8) as measured in leukocytes is below the limits of normal.

name: decreased alpha - galactosidase a activity
decrease alpha - galactosidase a activity
HP:0034864.def: Activity of the enzyme alpha-galactosidase outsidebelow the lower limit of normal.

name: positive fecal parasite test
positive fecal parasite test
HP:0034865.def: Demonstration of parasite in stool specimen, e.g., Parasites present on wet mount of stool.e

name: positive stool infectious agent test
positive stool infectious agent test
HP:0034866.def: Any kind of test for an infectious agent in stool positive.

name: positive stool giardia antigen
positive stool giardia antigen
HP:0034867.def: Test for giardia antigen in stool such as immune assay or DFA positive.

name: entamoeba histolytica antibody positive in stool
entamoeba histolytica antibody positive in stool
HP:0034868.def: Demonstration of antibody directed against Entamoeba histolytica in stool.

name: reduced erythrocyte free porphyrin concentration
reduce erythrocyte free porphyrin concentration
HP:0034869.def: Concentration of porphyrin in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.

name: reduced circulating urocanic acid concentration
reduce circulate urocanic acid concentration
HP:0034870.def: The concentration of urocanic acid in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased urinary epinephrine level
decrease urinary epinephrine level
HP:0034871.def: The concentration of epinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased csf epinephrine concentration
decrease csf epinephrine concentration
HP:0034872.def: Concentration of epinephrine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased circulating epinephrine concentration
decrease circulate epinephrine concentration
HP:0034873.def: Concentration of epinephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased circulating norepinephrine concentration
decrease circulate norepinephrine concentration
HP:0034874.def: Concentration of norepinephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased urinary norepinephrine level
decrease urinary norepinephrine level
HP:0034875.def: The concentration of norepinephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased urinary metaepinephrine level
decrease urinary metaepinephrine level
HP:0034876.def: The concentration of metanephrine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased csf metanephrine concentration
decrease csf metanephrine concentration
HP:0034877.def: Concentration of metanephrine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased circulating metanephrine concentration
decrease circulate metanephrine concentration
HP:0034878.def: Concentration of metanephrin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: ovarian mass
ovarian mass
HP:0034879.def: A swelling or enlargment localized to the ovary. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: adrenal mass
adrenal mass
HP:0034880.def: A swelling or enlargment localized to the adrenal gland. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: uterine mass
uterine mass
HP:0034881.def: A swelling or enlargment localized to the uterus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: prostatic calculus
prostatic calculus
HP:0034882.def: Calcium deposits in the prostate gland.

name: decreased portal vein velocity
decrease portal vein velocity
HP:0034883.def: A reduction in the velocity of portal venous flow, generally measured by Doppler ultrasound. Portal venous flow is normally towards the liver with peak systolic velocities in the range of 20-40 cm/s.

name: uterine cervix mass
uterine cervix mass
HP:0034884.def: A swelling or enlargment localized to the cervis of the uterus. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: abnormal urinary uromodulin level
abnormal urinary uromodulin level
HP:0034885.def: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for usine concentration, is outside the limits of normal.

name: decreased urinary uromodulin level
decrease urinary uromodulin level
HP:0034886.def: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: increased urine phenylacetylglutamine level
increase urine phenylacetylglutamine level
HP:0034887.def: The concentration of phenylacetylglutamine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: decreased urine guanidinoacetic acid level
decrease urine guanidinoacetic acid level
HP:0034888.def: The concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

name: positive urine infectious agent nucleid acid test
positive urine infectious agent nucleid acid test
HP:0034889.def: Detection of DNA and RNA originating from an infectious agent (bacteria, viruses, parasites and fungi) in the urine.

name: positive cmv urine nucleic acid test
positive cmv urine nucleic acid test
HP:0034890.def: Detection of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
synonym: cytomegalovirus ( cmv ) pcr in urine positive
cytomegalovirus ( cmv ) pcr in urine positive
positive cytomegalovirus urine nucleic acid test
positive cytomegalovirus urine nucleic acid test

name: positive neisseria gonorrhoeae urine nucleic acid test
positive neisseria gonorrhoeae urine nucleic acid test
HP:0034891.def: Detection of Neisseria gonorrhoeae nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.
synonym: neisseria gonorrhoeae pcr positive in urine
neisseria gonorrhoeae pcr positive in urine

name: positive enterovirus urine nucleic acid test
positive enterovirus urine nucleic acid test
HP:0034892.def: Detection of enterovirus nucleic acid in the urine by a method such as polymerase chain reaction.

name: elevated brain glycine level by mrs
elevate brain glycine level by mr
HP:0034893.def: An increase in the level of glycine in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: elevated brain polyol compounds by mrs
elevate brain polyol compound by mr
HP:0034894.def: An increase in the level of polyol compounds in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: elevated brain gamma - aminobutyric acid by mrs
elevate brain gamma - aminobutyric acid by mr
HP:0034895.def: An increase in the level of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

name: history of recent anticoagulant ingestion
history of recent anticoagulant ingestion
HP:0034896.def: Medical history of ingestion of anticoagulants prior to presentation.

name: decreased circulating antidiuretic hormone concentration
decrease circulate antidiuretic hormone concentration
HP:0034897.def: Concentration of antidiuretic hormone, also known as vasopressin, is below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

name: elevated circulating growth hormone - releasing hormone concentration
elevate circulate growth hormone - release hormone concentration
HP:0034898.def: Concentration of growth hormone-releasing hormone above the upper limit of normal in the blood circulation.

name: abnormal amniotic fluid protein concentration
abnormal amniotic fluid protein concentration
HP:0034899.def: Any deviation of the concentration of a protein in the amniotic fluid from normal limits

name: decreased amniotic fluid alpha - fetoprotein concentration
decrease amniotic fluid alpha - fetoprotein concentration
HP:0034900.def: Concentration of alpha-fetoprotein in the amniotic fluid below lower limit of normal.

name: increased circulating vitamin e concentration
increase circulate vitamin e concentration
HP:0034901.def: Concentration of vitamin E in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: abnormal circulating calcitonin concentration
abnormal circulate calcitonin concentration
HP:0034902.def: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation outside of normal limits.

name: decreased circulating calcitonin concentration
decrease circulate calcitonin concentration
HP:0034903.def: Concentration of calcitonin, a 32-amino acid polypeptide hormone that is produced primarily by the parafollicular cells of the thyroid, in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: decreased circulating thyrotropin releasing hormone concentration
decrease circulate thyrotropin release hormone concentration
HP:0034904.def: Concentration of thyrotropin releasing hormone below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.
synonym: thyrotropin releasing hormone ( trh ) low in blood
thyrotropin release hormone ( trh ) low in blood

name: elevated circulating uroporphyrin concentration
elevate circulate uroporphyrin concentration
HP:0034905.def: Concentration of uroporphyrin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: increased urine pentacarboxylporphyrin level
increase urine pentacarboxylporphyrin level
HP:0034906.def: Concentration of pentacarboxylporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: increased urine hexacarboxylporphyrin level
increase urine hexacarboxylporphyrin level
HP:0034907.def: Concentration of hexacarboxylporphyrin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: increased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
increase circulate dehydroepiandrosterone concentration
HP:0034908.def: Concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: increased erythrocyte coproporphyrin concentration
increase erythrocyte coproporphyrin concentration
HP:0034909.def: Concentration of coproporphyrin in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

name: increased erythrocyte uroproporphyrin concentration
increase erythrocyte uroproporphyrin concentration
HP:0034910.def: Concentration of uroproporphyrin in erythrocytes above the upper limit of normal.

name: decreased circulating apolipoprotein e concentration
decrease circulate apolipoprotein e concentration
HP:0034911.def: Concentration of apolipoprotein E below the lower limit of normal.

name: elevated circulating apolipoprotein e concentration
elevate circulate apolipoprotein e concentration
HP:0034912.def: Concentration of apolipoprotein E above the upper limit of normal.

name: acrosomal hypoplasia
acrosomal hypoplasia
HP:0034913.def: Reduction in the size of the acrosome of the head of spermatozoa.

name: oocyte maturation arrest
oocyte maturation arrest
HP:0034914.def: Oocyte maturation arrest (OMA) can manifest as failed in vitro fetilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) attempts using affected oocytes.

name: abnormal anus morphology
abnormal anus morphology
HP:0034915.def: A structural anomaly of the anus.

name: abnormal anus physiology
abnormal anus physiology
HP:0034916.def: A functional anomaly of the anus.

name: weak anal sphincter tone
weak anal sphincter tone
HP:0034917.def: Reduced muscle tone of the sphincter of the anus.

name: reduced muscle 2,4 - dienoyl - coa reductase activity
reduce muscle 2,4 - dienoyl - coa reductase activity
HP:0034918.def: Diminished activity of the enzyme 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase in muscle tissue.
synonym: muscle biopsy : 2,4 - dienoyl - coa reductase activity low
muscle biopsy : 2,4 - dienoyl - coa reductase activity low

name: reduced liver 2,4 - dienoyl - coa reductase activity
reduce liver 2,4 - dienoyl - coa reductase activity
HP:0034919.def: Diminished activity of the enzyme 2,4-dienoyl-CoA reductase in liver tissue.

name: nasal mucosa vasculitis
nasal mucosa vasculitis
HP:0034920.def: Inflammation of blood vessels in the mucosa of the nasal cavity.

name: pituitary blastoma
pituitary blastoma
HP:0034921.def: Pituitary blastoma is a distinctive anterior hypophyseal tumor of infants

name: peripheral axon spheroid formation
peripheral axon spheroid formation
HP:0034922.def: Axonal spheroids are bubble-like biological features that form on most degenerating axons.

name: reduced liver carboxylesterase 1 activity
reduce liver carboxylesterase 1 activity
HP:0034923.def: Activity of the enzyme carboxylesterase 1 in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

name: abnormal dermis morphology
abnormal dermis morphology
HP:0034924.def: A structural anomaly of the dermis, the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer.

name: perivascular dermis hyaline deposition
perivascular dermis hyaline deposition
HP:0034925.def: Deposition of a largely amorphous hyaline (transparent and homogeneous) substance around blood vessels in the dermis layer of the skin.

name: perivascular small intestinal hyaline deposition
perivascular small intestinal hyaline deposition
HP:0034926.def: Deposition of a largely amorphous hyaline (transparent and homogeneous) substance around blood vessels in the wall of the small intestine.

name: large keratohyaline granules
large keratohyaline granule
HP:0034927.def: Abnormally large keratohyalin granules (KHG). KHG are typically present in the stratum granulosum of the epidermal layer of the skin (and epithelium of the mucosae). KHG are protein structures found in the keratinocytes of the stratum granulosum.

name: decreased muscle lipoic acid content
decreased muscle lipoic acid content
HP:0034928.def: Reduced amount of lipoic acid in muscle tissue.

name: reduced hepatic cystathionine gamma - lyase activity
reduce hepatic cystathionine gamma - lyase activity
HP:0034929.def: Activity of cystathionine gamma-lyase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

name: digestive system neoplasm
digestive system neoplasm
HP:0034930.def: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the digestive system.

name: lumbar spondylosis
lumbar spondylosis
HP:0034931.def: Arthrosis, i.e., of degenerative joint disease, affecting the lumbar vertebral column.

name: decreased circulating acid maltase activity
decrease circulate acid maltase activity
HP:0034932.def: Activity of the enzyme acid maltase (also known as alpha-1,4-glucosidase) below the lower limit of normal.

name: increased circulating ribitol concentration
increase circulate ribitol concentration
HP:0034933.def: The concentration of ribitol in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

name: abnormal circulating 7 - dehydrocholesterol concentration
abnormal circulate 7 - dehydrocholesterol concentration
HP:0034934.def: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.

name: decreased circulating 7 - dehydrocholesterol concentration
decrease circulate 7 - dehydrocholesterol concentration
HP:0034935.def: Concentration of 7-dehydrocholesterol in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: elevated circulating lathosterol concentration
elevate circulate lathosterol concentration
HP:0034936.def: Concentration of lathosterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated circulating desmosterol concentration
elevate circulate desmosterol concentration
HP:0034937.def: Concentration of desmosterol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

name: decreased circulating sialic acid concentration
decrease circulate sialic acid concentration
HP:0034938.def: Concentration of sialic acid in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

name: purulent synovial fluid
purulent synovial fluid
HP:0034939.def: The synovial fluid (also known as synovia, i.e., the fluid found in the cavities of synovial joints) contains increased quantities of white blood cells.

name: muscle fiber calsequestrin 1 - containing inclusion bodies
muscle fiber calsequestrin 1 - contain inclusion body
HP:0034940.def: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that demonstrate immunoreactivity for calsequestrin 1.

name: palatine myxoma
palatine myxoma
HP:0034941.def: A myxoma (A benign tumor composed of myxomatous tissue composed of loosely-arranged spindle, polygonal, and stellate cells) localized to the palate. Clinically, such tumors may present as a sessile nodule on the hard palate.

name: vaginal myxoma
vaginal myxoma
HP:0034942.def: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized in the vagina.

name: decreased dermal collagen
decrease dermal collagen
HP:0034943.def: Abnormally reduced amount of collagen fibers in the dermis.

name: irregularly shaped keratohyaline granules
irregularly shape keratohyaline granule
HP:0034944.def: Abnormal shape of keratohyaline granules in dermal keratinocytes.

name: tubular shadows
tubular shadow
HP:0034945.def: Tubular shadows are characterised by a complete absence of cells in the testicular tubules, meaning that germ cells as well as somatic Sertoli cells are absent. The cells have been replaced by hyalinization.

name: multiple eyelid margin cysts
multiple eyelid margin cyst
HP:0034946.def: Presence of many apocrine hidrocystoma (cysts) on the margins of the eyelids.

name: altered location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath
alter location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath
HP:0034947.def: The fibrous sheath is a structure in the midpiece of the sperm flagellum surrounding the outer dense fibers. It comprises two longitudinal columns and tranverse ribs. In case of altered location of the longitudinal column in the fibrous sheath the symmetrical structure is lost, most commonly with the columns not being opposite to each other, which can be visualised by electron microscopy.

name: uterine myxoma
uterine myxoma
HP:0034948.def: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized to the uterus.

name: uterine cervix myxoma
uterine cervix myxoma
HP:0034949.def: A myxoma (tumor of primitive connective tissue) localized to the the cervix of the uterus.

name: typified by complete penetrance
typify by complete penetrance
HP:0034950.def: Penetrance describes the proportion of genotype positive individuals that develop disease given a lifespan of 80 years. For example, penetrance of Neurofibromatosis type 1 is close to 100%.

name: osteochondromyxoma
osteochondromyxoma
HP:0034951.def: A rare benign chondroid and osteoid matrix-producing neoplasm of bone characterized by extensive myxoid changes. OMX originate from bony cortices and have been observed in the nasal region, as well as the tibia and radius.

name: gangliocytoma
gangliocytoma
HP:0034952.def: A low-grade central nervous system tumor composed of dysplastic ganglion cells, usually presenting in children or young adults and located in the cerebral hemispheres.

name: duodenal gastrinoma
duodenal gastrinoma
HP:0034953.def: A gastrinoma, a neuroendocrine tumors characterized by the secretion of gastrin with resultant excessive gastric acid production, that is localized to the duodenum.

name: bone marrow eosinophilia
bone marrow eosinophilia
HP:0034955.def: Count of eosinophils in the bone marrow above the upper limit of normal.

name: exacerbated by lithium exposure
exacerbate by lithium exposure
HP:0034956.def: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with lithium.

name: reduced hepatic glycogen debrancher enzyme activity
reduce hepatic glycogen debrancher enzyme activity
HP:0034957.def: Activity of glycogen debrancher enzyme (also known as amylo-1,6-glucosydase, 4-alpha-glucantransferase) in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

name: asymmetrical insertion of the midpiece into the head
asymmetrical insertion of the midpiece into the head
HP:0034958.def: Insertion of the neck and midpiece into the head of a spermatozoon on an axis that diverges from the midline axis of the spermatozoon head. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this defect is above the upper limit of normal.

name: bent sperm neck
bent sperm neck
HP:0034959.def: Sharply angled insertion of the neck and midpiece into the head of a spermatozoon. This term applies if the proportion of spermatozoa with this feature is above the upper limit of normal.

name: elevated urine 3,6 - epoxydicarboxylic acid level
elevate urine 3,6 - epoxydicarboxylic acid level
HP:0034960.def: The concentration of 3,6-epoxydicarboxylic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

name: gallbladder biliary sludging
gallbladder biliary sludging
HP:0034961.def: Presence of biliary sludge (a mixture of particulate solids that have precipitated from bile) in the gallbladder. Such sediment consists of cholesterol crystals, calcium bilirubinate pigment, and other calcium salts. Sludge is usually detected on transabdominal ultrasonography.

name: exacerbated by amiodarone exposure
exacerbate by amiodarone exposure
HP:0034962.def: Applied to a sign or symptom that is worsened by treatment with amiodarone.

name: ureteral mass
ureteral mass
HP:0034963.def: A swelling or enlargment localized to the ureter. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: wide cavum septum pellucidum
wide cavum septum pellucidum
HP:0034964.def: Width of the cavum septum pellucidum above the upper limit of normal, which is defined as a separation of greater than one cm of the leaves of the cavum septum pellucidum.

name: hypoplastic trochlear nerve
hypoplastic trochlear nerve
HP:0034965.def: Underdevelopment of the trochlear nerve, which is the fourth cranial nerve and one of the ocular motor nerves that controls eye movement.

name: thymic cyst
thymic cyst
HP:0034966.def: A closed sac of tissue (cyst) located in the thymus. Thymic cysts are a rare, benign anomaly, are usually asymptomatic, and mostly occur in the anterior mediastinum .

name: uterine cyst
uterine cyst
HP:0034967.def: A closed sack of tissue (cyst) located in the uterus.

name: urinary bladder mass
urinary bladder mass
HP:0034968.def: A swelling or enlargment localized to the urinary bladder. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: endosteal scalloping
endosteal scallop
HP:0034969.def: A series of indentations or erosions on a normally smooth margin of the inner layer of the cortex (i.e. the endosteum) of bones.

name: urinary bladder hamartoma
urinary bladder hamartoma
HP:0034970.def: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the urinary bladder.

name: peritoneal mass
peritoneal mass
HP:0034971.def: A swelling or enlargment localized to the peritoneal cavity. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: fallopian tube mass
fallopian tube mass
HP:0034972.def: A swelling or enlargment localized to the Fallopian tube. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.

name: aplasia of the pyramids of the medulla oblongata
aplasia of the pyramid of the medulla oblongata
HP:0034973.def: Congenital absence of the pyramids, that is, of the paired structures located at the medial aspect of the ventral medulla that flank the anterior median fissure.

name: bathrocephaly
bathrocephaly
HP:0034974.def: A deformity of the posterior skull with bulging of the midportion of the occipital bone that is often associated with a benign variant of the mendosal suture.

name: occipital horn
occipital horn
HP:0034975.def: Downward pointing exostoses of the occipital bone situated in the tendinous insertions of the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles.

name: absent pituitary stalk
absent pituitary stalk
HP:0034976.def: A developmental defect characterized by failure to develop of the pituitary stalk. The pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.

name: abnormal pituitary stalk morphology
abnormal pituitary stalk morphology
HP:0034977.def: A structural anomaly of the pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.

name: interrupted pituitary stalk
interrupt pituitary stalk
HP:0034978.def: A developmental defect characterized by a discontinuity of the pituitary stalk. The pituitary stalk, also known as the infundibulum or infundibular stalk, is the connection between the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.

name: facial synkinesis
facial synkinesis
HP:0034979.def: Unintentional movement in one area of the face produced during intentional movement of another area of the face.

name: synkinesis
synkinesis
HP:0034980.def: Unintentional movement in one area of the body produced during intentional movement of another area of the body.

name: perianal anethesia
perianal anethesia
HP:0034982.def: Loss of sensation to the area of buttocks, perianal space and thighs.

name: phenylephrine does not induce blanching of eye redness
phenylephrine do not induce blanching of eye redness
HP:0034983.def: Instillation of 2.5% phenylephrine drops into the eye does not induce blanching of eye redness. Failure to blanch suggests redness caused by scleral vessel engorgement (e.g., scleritis) or extravascular cause (e.g., hemorrhage), not episcleritis or conjunctivitis.

name: fetal alcohol exposure
fetal alcohol exposure
HP:0034984.def: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to ethanol (alcohol).

name: reduced cellular cobalamin uptake
reduce cellular cobalamin uptake
HP:0034985.def: Diminished ability of cells to transport cobalamine from the extracellular space to the cytoplasm.

name: focal necrotic brainstem lesion
focal necrotic brainstem lesion
HP:0034986.def: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the brainstem.

name: focal necrotic optic nerve lesion
focal necrotic optic nerve lesion
HP:0034987.def: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the optic nerve.

name: focal necrotic thalamus lesion
focal necrotic thalamus lesion
HP:0034988.def: A localized area of cell death, often accompanied by infiltration of inflammatory cells, in the thalamus.

name: interstitial dermal edema
interstitial dermal edema
HP:0034989.def: Accumulation of fluid in the interstitial spaces of the skin. This finding can be appreciated my microscopic examination of a skin biopsy.

name: shoulder external rotation contracture
shoulder external rotation contracture
HP:0034991.def: A type of shoulder contracture characterized by decreased internal rotation of shoulder, that is, by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability to internally rotate the humerus at the shoulder joint (if the arm is flexed at the elbow, Internal rotation of the shoulder rotates the forearm towards the center of the body).
synonym: external rotation contracture of the shoulder joint
external rotation contracture of the shoulder joint

name: thumb adduction contracture
thumb adduction contracture
HP:0034992.def: A type of thumb contracture characterized by a chronic reduction in active and passive ability of the metacarpal-phalangeal and/or interphalangeal joints of the thumb to bring from medial side to neutral position, where the neutral position for the thumb is when the distal and proximal segments of the thumb joint are in linear alignment.

name: reduced hepatic fructose - 1,6 - bisphosphatase activity

name: cortical myoclonus

HP:0040148.def: Cortical myoclonus mainly affects the distal upper limbs and face, which reflects the largest cortical representations of these body areas. It is often focal, but may be multifocal, bilateral or generalized, as a consequence of intracortical and transcallosal spreading of abnormal activity. It typically occurs on voluntary action and may affect speech and gait. Cortical myoclonic jerks are stimulus sensitive, typically to touch, but sensitivity to visual stimuli is also described. Most patients with cortical myoclonus have both positive myoclonus and NM, occurring either independently or together as a complex of the two kinds of myoclonus. If cortical myoclonus is prolonged and lasts for hours, days or weeks, it is called epilepsia partials continua and is considered to be a rare form of focal epileptic status. Focal cortical myoclonus almost always points to an underlining lesion of the sensori-motor cortex, which produces hyperexcitability (e.g. vascular, inflammatory or neoplastic).

HP:0040217.def: An increased concentration of hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c), which is the product of nonenzymatic attachment of a hexose molecule to the N-terminal amino acid of the hemoglobin molecule. This reaction is dependent on blood glucose concentration, and therefore reflects the mean glucose concentration over the previous 8 to 12 weeks. The HbA1c level provides a better indication of long-term glycemic control than one-time blood or urinary glucose measurements.

name: reduced natural killer cell count
reduced natural killer cell count
HP:0040218.def: Less than normal number of natural killer cells, a type of lymphocyte in the innate immune system with an ability to mediate cytotoxicity and produce cytokines after the ligation of a germline-encoded activation receptor.

name: absent natural killer cells
absent natural killer cell
HP:0040219.def: Lack of natural killer cells, a type of lymphocyte in the innate immune system that contains cytoplasmic granzymes, i.e., small granules with perforin and proteases that allow natural killer cells to form pores in the cell membrane of the target cell through which the granzymes and associated molecules can enter, inducing apoptosis.

name: abnormal size of the dental root
abnormal size of the dental root
maternal thrombophilia
maternal thrombophilia
HP:0040222.def: An increased tendency towards thrombosis in the mother during a pregnancy.

name: pulmonary hemorrhage
pulmonary hemorrhage
HP:0040223.def: Pulmonary hemorrhage is a bleeding within the lungs. Older children and adults may spit blood or bloody sputum. Neonates, infants and young children usually do not spit up blood. Anemia, pulmonary infiltrates, increasingling bloody return on BAL and the presence of hemosiderin-laden macrophages in broncho-alveolar lavage (BAL) fluid or lung biopsy can diagnose lung bleeding. Alveolar macrophages contain phagocytosed red blood cells and stain positive for hemosiderin, a product of hemoglobin degradation, after about 48-72 hours following pulmonary hemorraghe. Previous or recurrent bleeding can thus be distinguished from fresh events. A differentiation into local or diffuse is of importance. Also differentiate if pulmonary hemorrhage is due to a primary lung disorder or a manifestation of a systemic disease.

name: abnormality of fibrinolysis
abnormality of fibrinolysis
HP:0040224.def: Clincial phenotype characterized by delayed bleeding accelerated break down of blood clot (fibrinolysis)

name: decrease in high molecular weight von willebrand factor multimers
decrease in high molecular weight von willebrand factor multimers
HP:0040225.def: A decrease in high molecular weight von Willebrand factor multimers.

name: decreased level of heparin co - factor ii
decrease level of heparin co - factor ii
HP:0040226.def: An abnormality of coagulation related to a decreased concentration of heparin co-factor II

name: decreased level of histidine - rich glycoprotein
decrease level of histidine - rich glycoprotein

name: decreased level of thrombomodulin
decrease level of thrombomodulin
HP:0040229.def: Thrombomodulin is a cofactor in the thrombin induced activation of Protein C. In the case of deficiency there will be less Protein C and tendency to clot

name: decreased level of tissue plasminogen activator
decrease level of tissue plasminogen activator
HP:0040230.def: The tPA protein catalyzes the conversion of plasiminogen to plasmin, and thus break down of clots. When there is a deficiency there will be an increase of thrombosis

name: delayed onset bleeding
delay onset bleed

name: factor xiii subunit a deficiency

name: factor xiii subunit b deficiency
factor xiii subunit b deficiency

name: leukocyte inclusion bodies
leukocyte inclusion body
HP:0040235.def: The presence of intraceullar inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in leukocytes.

name: hyperfibrinolysis

preauricular cyst
HP:0040297.def: Preauricular sinus is an occasional finding and most frequently appears as a small pit close to the anterior margin of the ascending portion of the helix. The opening has also been reported along the postero superior margin of the helix, the tragus or the lobule. Preauricular sinus may lead to the formation of a subcutaneous cyst that is intimately related to the tragal cartilage and the anterior crus of the helix.

HP:0040311.def: Polyarthritis refers to a joint disease that involves at least five joints. multifocal hypointensity of cerebral white matter on mri

name: distinctive finding
distinctive finding
HP:0045089.def: In clinical parlance, findings are occasionally interpreted as being distinctive or minor, reflecting a subjective clinical impression of the importance of a feature for the differential diagnosis. A minor finding is taken to be one that is likely to have high utility in distinguishing the correct diagnosis from other candidates in the differential.

name: minor finding
minor finding

A minor finding is taken to be one that is unlikely to help distinguish the correct diagnosis from other candidates in the differential.

name: malignant mesothelioma
malignant mesothelioma
HP:0100001.def: Malignant mesothelioma is a form of cancer that originates from the cells of the mesothelium, a thin tissue layer surrounding the body's internal organs. Malignant mesothelioma is almost exclusively caused by asbestos exposure, pleural mesothelioma beeing the most common form, affecting the lining of the lungs called the pleura. Other forms such as perioneal-, percardial- or testicular- mesothelioma are much rarer.

name: pleural mesothelioma
pleural mesothelioma
HP:0100002.def: A malignant mesothelioma originating from cells of the pleura (the thin layer of mesothelium lining the lungs). Pleural mesothelioma is the most common form of mesothelioma.

name: peritoneal mesothelioma
peritoneal mesothelioma
HP:0100003.def: A Malignant mesothelioma originating from cells of the peritoneum (the thin layer of mesothelium lining the abdomen). Peritoneal mesothelioma is the second most common form of mesothelioma after pleural mesothelioma.

name: pericardial mesothelioma
pericardial mesothelioma
HP:0100004.def: A Malignant mesothelioma originating from cells of the pericardium (the thin layer of mesothelium lining the heart).

name: testicular mesothelioma
testicular mesothelioma
HP:0100005.def: A Malignant mesothelioma of the testis.

name: neoplasm of the breast

name: epiretinal membrane
epiretinal membrane
HP:0100014.def: An epiretinal membrane is a thin sheet of fibrous tissue that can develop on the surface of the macular area of the retina and cause a disturbance in vision. An epiretinal membrane area can develop on the thin macular area of the retin. An epiretinal membrane is also sometimes called a macular pucker, premacular fibrosis, surface wrinkling retinopathy or cellophane maculopathy.

name: stahl ear

HP:0100015.def: The presence of a supernumerary, i.e. third, crus of the helix in the helix, arising at or above the normal bifurcation of the antihelix.

name: abnormal mesentery morphology
abnormal mesentery morphology
HP:0100016.def: Folds of membranous tissue (peritoneum, mesothelium) attached to the wall of the abdomen and enclosing viscera. Examples include the mesentery for the small intestine; the transverse mesocolon, which attaches the transverse portion of the colon to the back wall of the abdomen; and the mesosigmoid, which enfolds the sigmoid portion of the colon. Cells of the same embryologic origin also surround the other organs of the body such as the lungs (pleura) or the heart (pericardium).

name: capsular cataract
capsular cataract
HP:0100017.def: A cataract that affects the capsule of the lens.

name: nuclear cataract
nuclear cataract
HP:0100018.def: A nuclear cataract is an opacity or clouding that develops in the lens nucleus. That is, a nuclear cataract is one that is located in the center of the lens. The nucleus tends to darken changing from clear to yellow and sometimes brown.

name: cortical cataract
cortical cataract
HP:0100019.def: A cataract which affects the layer of the lens surrounding the nucleus, i.e., the lens cortex. It is identified by its unique wedge or spoke appearance.

name: posterior capsular cataract
posterior capsular cataract
HP:0100020.def: A cataract which is found in the back outer layer of the lens. This type often develops more rapidly.

name: cerebral palsy
cerebral palsy
HP:0100021.def: Cerebral palsy describes a group of permanent disorders of the development of movement and posture, causing activity limitation, that are attributed to nonprogressive disturbances that occurred in the developing fetal or infant brain. The motor disorders of cerebral palsy are often accompanied by disturbances of sensation, perception, cognition, communication, and behaviour, by epilepsy, and by secondary musculoskeletal problems.

name: abnormality of movement
abnormality of movement
HP:0100022.def: An abnormality of movement with a neurological basis characterized by changes in coordination and speed of voluntary movements.

name: recurrent hand flapping
recurrent hand flap
HP:0100023.def: A type of repetitive behavior in which the affected individual repeatedly waves the hands and/or arms rhythmically.

name: conspicuously happy disposition
conspicuously happy disposition
HP:0100024.def: An unusually happy demeanor over time, which can also be observed during inappropriate situations that should, for example, cause distress, fear, or anger.

name: overfriendliness
overfriendliness
HP:0100025.def: A form of hypersociability that presents as mostly inappropriate people-orientation and friendliness towards others on an inadequate level which might go as far as being dangerous considering for example young children following strangers without restriction.

name: arteriovenous malformation
arteriovenous malformation
HP:0100026.def: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries.

name: lingual thyroid
lingual thyroid
HP:0100029.def: An aberrant thyroid gland or Ectopic thyroid located at the base of the tongue, just posterior to the foramen cecum as a result of a failure of the thyroid to descend.

name: accessory ectopic thyroid tissue
accessory ectopic thyroid tissue
HP:0100030.def: Accessory ectopic thyroid tissue arising from remnants of the thyroglossal duct anywhere along the path of the thyroglossal duct tract.

name: neoplasm of the thyroid gland
neoplasm of the thyroid gland
HP:0100031.def: A tumor (abnormal growth of tissue) of the thyroid gland.

name: tics
tic
HP:0100033.def: Repeated, individually recognizable, intermittent movements or movement fragments that are almost always briefly suppressible and are usually associated with awareness of an urge to perform the movement.

name: motor tics
motor tic
HP:0100034.def: Movement-based tics affecting discrete muscle groups.

name: phonic tics
phonic tic
HP:0100035.def: Involuntary sounds produced by moving air through the nose, mouth, or throat. The vocal cords are not involved in all tics that produce sound.

name: pseudo - fractures
pseudo - fracture
HP:0100036.def: A band of bone material of decreased density forming alongside the surface of the cortical bone with thickening of the periosteum. Callus formation in the affected area is common and gives the appearance of a false fracture.

name: abnormality of the scalp hair
abnormality of the scalp hair
HP:0100037.def: An abnormality of the hair of head.

name: slow - growing scalp hair
slow - grow scalp hair
HP:0100038.def: Scalp hair whose growth is slower than normal.

name: thickened cortex of bones
thicken cortex of bone
HP:0100039.def: An Abnormality of cortical bone leading to an abnormal thickness of the cortex of affected bones.

synostosis involve bone of the upper limb
